### Chapter 5

**Joshua 5:1**

And it happened, when the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan and the kings of Phoenicia by the sea heard that the Lord God dried up the river Jordan from before the sons of Israel while they crossed it, then their minds melted and they were astonished, and there was no understanding in them at all from before the sons of Israel.

**Joshua 5:2**

And at that time the Lord said to Joshua, Make for yourself stone knives from sheer rock, and sit down and circumcise the sons of Israel.

**Joshua 5:3**

And Joshua made sharp stone knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at the place called Hill of Foreskins.

**Joshua 5:4**

And this is the way Joshua purified the sons of Israel, as many as had once come to be on the road, and as many as had once been uncircumcised among those who came out from Egypt.

**Joshua 5:5**

All these Joshua circumcised.

**Joshua 5:6**

For forty-two years Israel had turned about in the wilderness of Madbaritis; therefore most of them were uncircumcised, the fighting men who had come out from the land of Egypt, who disobeyed the commands of God, to whom the Lord also determined that they should not see the land that he swore to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

**Joshua 5:7**

And in place of these he set up their sons, whom Joshua circumcised because they had become uncircumcised on the road.

**Joshua 5:8**

And after they were circumcised, they had rest there, sitting in the camp until they were healed.

**Joshua 5:9**

And the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, On this day I have removed the reproach of Egypt from you. And he called the name of that place Galgala.

**Joshua 5:10**

And the sons of Israel kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, from evening, west of Jericho, beyond the Jordan, in the plain.

**Joshua 5:11**

And they ate from the grain of the land, unleavened bread and new grain, on this very day.

**Joshua 5:12**

The manna failed after they had eaten from the grain of the land, and there was no longer manna for the sons of Israel, but they harvested the land of the Phoenicians in that year.

**Joshua 5:13**

And it happened, as Joshua was in Jericho, that lifting his eyes he saw a man standing before him, and his sword was drawn in his hand. And coming near, Joshua said to him, Are you one of ours or of our adversaries?

**Joshua 5:14**

And he said to him, I am commander-in-chief of the Lord's force; now I have arrived. And Joshua fell on his face to the ground and said to him, Master, what do you command your servant?

**Joshua 5:15**

And the commander-in-chief of the Lord says to Joshua, Loose the sandal from your feet, because the place on which you stand is holy.

### Chapter 6

**Joshua 6:1**

And Jericho was shut up and fortified, and no one went out from it, nor entered into it.

**Joshua 6:2**

And the Lord said to Joshua, Behold, I give Jericho into your hand, and its king, and the mighty men being in strength within it.

**Joshua 6:3**

And you shall set the warriors around it in a circle.

**Joshua 6:5**

And it shall be, when you sound with the trumpet, let all the people cry out together, and when they cry out the walls of the city will fall of themselves, and all the people shall enter, each one rushing straight ahead into the city.

**Joshua 6:6**

And Joshua son of Nun went in to the priests

**Joshua 6:7**

and said to them, saying, Command the people to go around and encircle the city, and let the warriors pass by armed before the Lord.

**Joshua 6:8**

And let seven priests holding the seven holy trumpets go past likewise before the Lord and sound loudly, and let the ark of the covenant of the Lord follow after.

**Joshua 6:9**

And let the warriors pass by in front, and the priests bringing up the rear behind the ark of the covenant of the Lord, going and sounding trumpets.

**Joshua 6:10**

And Joshua commanded the people, saying, Do not shout, and let none of you be heard by voice until the day when he himself reports to shout, and then you shall shout.

**Joshua 6:11**

And the ark of the covenant of God went around the city and straightway went away into the camp and slept there.

**Joshua 6:12**

And on the second day Joshua rose in the morning, and the priests lifted the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

**Joshua 6:13**

And the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went before the Lord, and after these the warriors entered, and the rest of the crowd behind the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the priests sounded with the trumpets, and all the rest of the crowd encircled the city nearby.

**Joshua 6:14**

And he went away again into the camp. Thus he did for six days.

**Joshua 6:15**

And on the seventh day they rose at dawn and went around the city six times.

**Joshua 6:16**

And at the seventh circuit the priests sounded, and Joshua said to the sons of Israel, Shout, because the Lord has delivered the city to you.

**Joshua 6:17**

And the city shall be a devoted thing, it and everything in it, to the Lord Sabaoth. Only Rahab the prostitute you shall preserve, her and whatever is in her house.

**Joshua 6:18**

But you, keep yourselves very carefully from the devoted thing, lest, desiring, you yourselves take from the devoted thing and make the camp of the sons of Israel a devoted thing and crush us.

**Joshua 6:19**

And all silver or gold or bronze or iron shall be holy to the Lord. It shall be brought into the treasury of the Lord.

**Joshua 6:20**

And the priests sounded with the trumpets, and when the people heard the voice of the trumpets, all the people shouted together with a great and strong shout, and the whole wall fell around, and all the people went up into the city.

**Joshua 6:21**

And Joshua devoted it and everything that was in the city, from man to woman, from young man to old man, and from calf to beast of burden, by the mouth of the sword.

**Joshua 6:22**

And to the two young men who had spied he said, Enter into the house of the woman and bring her out from there and whatever belongs to her.

**Joshua 6:23**

And the two young men who had spied the city entered into the house of the woman and brought out Rahab the prostitute and her father and her mother and her brothers and everything that belonged to her and all her kindred, and they stationed her outside the camp of Israel.

**Joshua 6:24**

And the city was burned in burning with everything in it, except silver and gold and bronze and iron, which they gave to be brought into the treasury of the Lord.

**Joshua 6:25**

And Joshua kept alive Rahab the prostitute and all her father's house, and she dwelt among Israel until this day, because she hid the spies whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

**Joshua 6:26**

And Joshua bound them by oath on that day before the Lord, saying, Cursed is the man who will rebuild that city. In his firstborn he shall found it, and in his least one he shall set up its gates. And thus Ozan from Bethel did: in Abiron his firstborn he founded it, and in his least surviving one he set up its gates.

**Joshua 6:27**

And the Lord was with Joshua, and his name was through all the land.

### Chapter 7

**Joshua 7:1**

And the sons of Israel committed a great trespass and stole from the devoted thing, and Achar son of Charmi son of Zambri son of Zara from the tribe of Judah took from the devoted thing, and the wrath of the Lord was angered against the sons of Israel.

**Joshua 7:2**

And Joshua sent men to Ai, which is near Bethel, saying, Look over Ai. And the men went up and looked over Ai.

**Joshua 7:3**

And they returned to Joshua and said to him, Let not all the people go up, but about two thousand or three thousand men should go up and besiege the city. Do not bring all the people there, because they are few.

**Joshua 7:4**

And about three thousand men went up, and they fled from before the men of Ai.

**Joshua 7:5**

And the men of Ai killed from them thirty-six men and pursued them from the gate and crushed them on the descent, and the heart of the people was terrified and became like water.

**Joshua 7:6**

And Joshua tore his garments, and Joshua fell on the ground on his face before the Lord until evening, he and the elders of Israel, and they threw dust on their heads.

**Joshua 7:7**

And Joshua said, I pray, Lord, why did your servant bring this people across the Jordan, to hand it over to the Amorite and destroy us? If only we had remained and dwelt beside the Jordan.

**Joshua 7:8**

And what shall I say, since Israel turned neck before its enemy?

**Joshua 7:9**

And hearing, the Canaanite and all those dwelling in the land will surround us and wipe us from the land. And what will you do for your great name?

**Joshua 7:10**

And the Lord said to Joshua, Rise. Why have you fallen like this on your face?

**Joshua 7:11**

The people have sinned and transgressed the covenant that I covenanted with them, and, stealing from the devoted thing, they put it into their vessels.

**Joshua 7:12**

The sons of Israel will certainly not be able to stand against the face of their enemies. They will turn neck before their enemies, because they have become a devoted thing. I will not add to be with you any longer unless you remove the devoted thing from among you.

**Joshua 7:13**

Rise, sanctify the people and tell them to sanctify themselves for tomorrow. These things says the Lord God of Israel: The devoted thing is among you. You will not be able to stand before your enemies until you remove the devoted thing from among you.

**Joshua 7:14**

And you shall be gathered in the morning by tribes, and it shall be, the tribe that the Lord points out, you shall bring by clans, and the clan that the Lord points out, you shall bring by house, and the house that the Lord points out, you shall bring by man.

**Joshua 7:15**

And whoever is pointed out shall be burned with fire, he and everything that belongs to him, because he transgressed the covenant of the Lord and did lawless deed in Israel.

**Joshua 7:16**

And Joshua rose early and brought the people by tribes, and the tribe of Judah was pointed out.

**Joshua 7:17**

And it was brought by clans, and the clan of Zara was pointed out and brought by man.

**Joshua 7:18**

And Achar son of Zambri son of Zara was pointed out.

**Joshua 7:19**

And Joshua said to Achar, Give glory today to the Lord God of Israel and give confession, and report to me what you did, and do not hide it from me.

**Joshua 7:20**

And Achar answered Joshua and said, Truly I sinned before the Lord God of Israel. Thus and thus I did.

**Joshua 7:21**

I saw in the spoil a fine variegated cloak and two hundred silver didrachmas and one golden tongue of fifty didrachmas, and desiring them I took them. And behold, they are hidden in the ground in my tent, and the silver is hidden underneath them.

**Joshua 7:22**

And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran into the tent in the camp, and these things were hidden in the tent, and the silver underneath them.

**Joshua 7:23**

And they brought them out from the tent and carried them to Joshua and the elders of Israel and placed them before the Lord.

**Joshua 7:24**

And Joshua took Achar son of Zara and brought him up to the Valley of Achor, and his sons and his daughters and his calves and his beasts of burden and all his sheep and his tent and all his possessions, and all the people with him, and they brought them up to Emekachor.

**Joshua 7:25**

And Joshua said to Achar, Why did you destroy us? May the Lord destroy you, just as also today. And all Israel stoned him with stones.

**Joshua 7:26**

And they raised over him a great heap of stones, and the Lord ceased from the wrath of anger. Because of this he named it Emekachor until this day.

### Chapter 8

**Joshua 8:1**

And the Lord said to Joshua, Do not fear, nor be cowardly. Take with you all the warriors, and rising, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hands the king of Ai and his land.

**Joshua 8:2**

And you shall do to Ai in the way you did to Jericho and its king, except its spoil and cattle you shall plunder for yourself. But set for yourself an ambush behind the city.

**Joshua 8:3**

And Joshua and all the warrior people rose to go up to Ai, and Joshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty in strength, and sent them by night.

**Joshua 8:4**

And he commanded them, saying, You lie in ambush behind the city. Do not be far from the city, and all of you be ready.

**Joshua 8:5**

And I and all those with me will come near the city, and it shall be, when those dwelling in Ai come out to meet us, just as also before, then we shall flee from before their face.

**Joshua 8:6**

And when they come out behind us, we will draw them away from the city, and they will say, These flee from before us, just as also before.

**Joshua 8:7**

But you shall rise from the ambush and go into the city.

**Joshua 8:8**

According to this word you shall do. Behold, I have commanded you.

**Joshua 8:9**

And Joshua sent them, and they went into the ambush and sat between Bethel and Ai, west of Ai.

**Joshua 8:10**

And Joshua rose early in the morning and inspected the people, and he and the elders went up before the face of the people toward Ai.

**Joshua 8:11**

And all the warrior people with him went up, and going they came opposite the city from the east.

**Joshua 8:12**

And the ambush of the city was from the west.

**Joshua 8:14**

And it happened, when the king of Ai saw, he hurried and went out to meet them straight for battle, he and all the people with him, and he did not know that there was an ambush behind the city against him.

**Joshua 8:15**

And Joshua and Israel saw and withdrew from before their face.

**Joshua 8:16**

And they pursued behind the sons of Israel, and they were drawn away from the city.

**Joshua 8:17**

No one was left in Ai who did not pursue behind Israel, and they left the city open and pursued behind Israel.

**Joshua 8:18**

And the Lord said to Joshua, Stretch out your hand with the spear that is in your hand toward the city, because I have delivered it into your hands. And the ambush will rise up quickly from its place. And Joshua stretched out his hand, the spear, toward the city.

**Joshua 8:19**

And the ambush rose up quickly from its place and came out when he stretched out his hand, and they came against the city and seized it, and hurrying they burned the city with fire.

**Joshua 8:20**

And the inhabitants of Ai, looking around behind them, were seeing smoke going up from the city into heaven, and they no longer had where to flee here or there.

**Joshua 8:21**

And Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that the smoke of the city had gone up into heaven, and turning around they struck the men of Ai.

**Joshua 8:22**

And these came out from the city to meet them, and they came to be in the midst of the camp, these from here and those from there, and they struck until none of them was left saved or escaped.

**Joshua 8:23**

And they seized the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

**Joshua 8:24**

And when the sons of Israel stopped killing all those in Ai, those in the plains and in the mountain on the descent, where they pursued them from it to the end, then Joshua returned to Ai and struck it by the mouth of the sword.

**Joshua 8:25**

And those who fell on that day, from man to woman, were twelve thousand, all those dwelling in Ai.

**Joshua 8:27**

Except the cattle and the spoils in the city, everything that the sons of Israel plundered according to the command of the Lord, in the way the Lord ordered Joshua.

**Joshua 8:28**

And Joshua burned the city with fire and made it an uninhabited mound forever, until this day.

**Joshua 8:29**

And the king of Ai he hung on a forked tree, and he was on the tree until evening, and when the sun set Joshua ordered and they took his body down from the tree and threw it into the pit and raised over him a heap of stones until this day.

### Chapter 9

**Joshua 9:1**

And as the kings of the Amorites in the beyond of the Jordan heard, those in the hill country and those in the plain and those on all the coast of the great sea and those by Anti-Lebanon, the Hittites and Canaanites and Pherezites and Hivites and Amorites and Gergesites and Jebusites,

**Joshua 9:2**

they came all together at the same time to make war against Joshua and Israel.

**Joshua 9:3**

And those dwelling in Gibeon heard everything that the Lord did to Jericho and Ai,

**Joshua 9:4**

and they themselves also acted with cunning, and going they prepared provisions and made ready, and taking old sacks on their donkeys and old wine skins, torn and tied up,

**Joshua 9:5**

and their sandals were old and worn through in their feet, and their garments were worn out on them, and the bread of their provisions was dry and moldy and eaten.

**Joshua 9:6**

And they came to Joshua at the camp of Israel in Galgala and said to Joshua and Israel, We have come from a land far away, and now make a covenant with us.

**Joshua 9:7**

And the sons of Israel said to the Horite, See, perhaps you dwell among me, and how shall I make a covenant with you?

**Joshua 9:8**

And they said to Joshua, We are your servants. And Joshua said to them, Who are you, and from where have you come?

**Joshua 9:9**

And they said, Your servants have come from a very distant land in the name of the Lord your God, for we heard his name and everything that he did in Egypt,

**Joshua 9:10**

and everything that he did to the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who dwelt in Astaroth and in Edrain.

**Joshua 9:11**

And hearing, our elders and all those dwelling in our land said to us, saying, Take provisions for yourselves for the road and go to meet them and say to them, We are your servants, and now make a covenant with us.

**Joshua 9:12**

These breads, hot, we provisioned them on the day when we went out to come to you, but now they are dried out and have become eaten.

**Joshua 9:13**

And these wine skins that we filled new, these have burst, and our garments and our sandals have worn out because of the very long road.

**Joshua 9:14**

And the leaders took from their provisions and did not ask the Lord.

**Joshua 9:15**

And Joshua made peace with them and covenanted with them to keep them alive, and the leaders of the assembly swore to them.

**Joshua 9:16**

And it happened after three days after making covenant with them that they heard that they are near them and dwell among them.

**Joshua 9:17**

And the sons of Israel set out and came to their cities, and their cities were Gibeon and Kephira and Beeroth and City of Jarin.

**Joshua 9:18**

And the sons of Israel did not fight them, because all the leaders swore to them by the Lord God of Israel, and all the assembly grumbled against the leaders.

**Joshua 9:19**

And the leaders said to all the assembly, We swore to them by the Lord God of Israel, and now we cannot touch them.

**Joshua 9:20**

This we will do: keep them alive and preserve them, and wrath shall not be against us because of the oath that we swore to them.

**Joshua 9:21**

They shall live and shall be woodcutters and water carriers for all the assembly, just as the leaders said to them.

**Joshua 9:22**

And Joshua summoned them and said to them, Why did you deceive me, saying, We are very far from you, while you are locals from those dwelling among us?

**Joshua 9:23**

And now cursed are you. From you servant shall certainly not fail, nor woodcutter for me and for my God.

**Joshua 9:24**

And they answered Joshua, saying, It was reported to us what the Lord your God ordered Moses his servant, to give you this land and utterly destroy us and all those dwelling on it from before your face, and we feared greatly for our lives from before you and did this thing.

**Joshua 9:25**

And now, behold, we are under your hand. As it pleases you and as it seems good to you, do to us.

**Joshua 9:26**

And they did thus to them, and Joshua rescued them on that day from the hands of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them.

**Joshua 9:27**

And Joshua made them on that day woodcutters and water carriers for all the assembly and for the altar of God. Because of this those dwelling in Gibeon became woodcutters and water carriers for the altar of God until this day and for the place that the Lord may choose.

### Chapter 10

**Joshua 10:1**

And when Adonibezek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua took Ai and utterly destroyed it, in the way they did Jericho and its king, thus they did Ai and its king, and that those dwelling in Gibeon defected to Joshua and to Israel,

**Joshua 10:2**

then they feared greatly among them, for they knew that Gibeon is a great city, like one of the metropolises, and all its men are strong.

**Joshua 10:3**

And Adonibezek king of Jerusalem sent to Ailam king of Hebron and to Phidon king of Jerimoth and to Jeptha king of Lachish and to Dabir king of Odollam, saying,

**Joshua 10:4**

Come up to me and help me, and let us war against Gibeon, because they defected to Joshua and to the sons of Israel.

**Joshua 10:5**

And the five kings of the Jebusites went up, king of Jerusalem and king of Hebron and king of Jerimoth and king of Lachish and king of Odollam, they and all their people, and they besieged Gibeon and were besieging it.

**Joshua 10:6**

And those dwelling in Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp of Israel in Galgala, saying, Do not let your hands grow weak from your servants. Come up to us quickly and rescue us and help us, because all the kings of the Amorites dwelling in the hill country are gathered against us.

**Joshua 10:7**

And Joshua went up from Galgala, he and all the warrior people with him, every strong one in might.

**Joshua 10:8**

And the Lord said to Joshua, Do not fear them, because I have delivered them into your hands. None of them shall be left before you.

**Joshua 10:9**

And Joshua came upon them suddenly; all the night he marched in from Galgala.

**Joshua 10:10**

And the Lord amazed them from before the sons of Israel and crushed them with a great crushing in Gibeon, and they pursued them on the road of the ascent of Horonin and were cutting them down as far as Azeka and as far as Makkeda.

**Joshua 10:11**

And as they fled from before the sons of Israel on the descent of Horonin, the Lord threw on them hailstones from heaven as far as Azeka, and those who died through the hailstones became more than those whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword in the war.

**Joshua 10:12**

Then Joshua spoke to the Lord on the day when God delivered the Amorite under the hands of Israel, when he crushed them in Gibeon and they were crushed from before the sons of Israel, and Joshua said, Let the sun stand over Gibeon, and the moon over the valley of Ailon.

**Joshua 10:13**

And the sun stood, and the moon stood in place, until God defended their enemies. And the sun stood in the midst of heaven; it did not go forward to the setting, to the end of one day.

**Joshua 10:14**

And there was no day like this, neither before nor after, for God to hear a human, because the Lord fought together with Israel.

**Joshua 10:16**

And these five kings fled and hid in the cave in Makkeda.

**Joshua 10:17**

And it was reported to Joshua, saying, The five kings have been found hidden in the cave in Makkeda.

**Joshua 10:18**

And Joshua said, Roll stones onto the mouth of the cave and appoint men to guard over them.

**Joshua 10:19**

But you, do not stand still; pursue behind your enemies and seize their rear, and do not let them enter into their cities, because the Lord our God has delivered them into our hands.

**Joshua 10:20**

And it happened, when Joshua and every son of Israel stopped cutting them down with a very great slaughter to the end, and those being saved were saved into the fortified cities,

**Joshua 10:21**

then all the people returned to Joshua at Makkeda unharmed, and none of the sons of Israel so much as growled with his tongue.

**Joshua 10:22**

And Joshua said, Open the cave and bring out these five kings to me from the cave.

**Joshua 10:23**

And they brought out the five kings from the cave, the king of Jerusalem and the king of Hebron and the king of Jerimoth and the king of Lachish and the king of Odollam.

**Joshua 10:24**

And when they brought them out to Joshua, Joshua called all Israel and the leaders of the war who went with him, saying to them, Come forward and put your feet on their necks. And coming forward, they put their feet on their necks.

**Joshua 10:25**

And Joshua said to them, Do not fear them, nor be cowardly. Act like men and be strong, because thus the Lord will do to all your enemies against whom you make war.

**Joshua 10:26**

And Joshua killed them and hanged them on five trees, and they were hanging on the trees until evening.

**Joshua 10:27**

And it happened toward sunset that Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave into which they fled there, and rolled stones onto the cave until this day.

**Joshua 10:28**

And they took Makkeda on that day and killed it with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed every breathing thing in it, and no one was left in it who was saved and escaped, and they did to the king of Makkeda in the way they did to the king of Jericho.

**Joshua 10:29**

And Joshua and all Israel with him went from Makkeda to Lebna and besieged Lebna.

**Joshua 10:30**

And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel, and they took it and its king and killed it with the edge of the sword and every breathing thing in it, and no one was left in it, not one saved and escaped, and they did to its king in the way they did to the king of Jericho.

**Joshua 10:31**

And Joshua and all Israel with him went from Lebna to Lachish and besieged it and were besieging it.

**Joshua 10:32**

And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel, and he took it on the second day and killed it with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed it in the way they did to Lebna.

**Joshua 10:33**

Then Ailam king of Gazer went up to help Lachish, and Joshua struck him with the edge of the sword, him and his people, until none of them were left saved and escaped.

**Joshua 10:34**

And Joshua and all Israel with him went from Lachish to Odollam and besieged it and were besieging it.

**Joshua 10:35**

And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel, and he took it on that day and killed it with the edge of the sword, and every breathing thing in it they killed in the way they did to Lachish.

**Joshua 10:36**

And Joshua and all Israel with him went to Hebron and besieged it.

**Joshua 10:37**

And he struck it with the edge of the sword and every breathing thing that was in it; there was no one saved, in the way they did to Odollam. They utterly destroyed it and everything that was in it.

**Joshua 10:38**

And Joshua and all Israel turned back to Dabir and besieged it,

**Joshua 10:39**

and they took it and its king and its villages and struck it with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed it and every breathing thing in it, and they did not leave in it any saved one, in the way they did to Hebron and its king, so they did to Dabir and its king.

**Joshua 10:40**

And Joshua struck all the land, the hill country and the Negeb and the plain and the Asedoth and their kings. He left no saved one among them, and every breathing life he utterly destroyed, in the way the Lord God of Israel commanded.

**Joshua 10:41**

From Kadesh-Barnea as far as Gaza, all Gosom as far as Gibeon.

**Joshua 10:42**

And all their kings and their land Joshua struck at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought together with Israel.

### Chapter 11

**Joshua 11:1**

And when Jabin king of Hasor heard, he sent to Jobab king of Marron and to the king of Symoon and to king Aziph,

**Joshua 11:2**

and to the kings near great Sidon in the hill country and in the Raba opposite Keneroth and in the plain and in Napheddor,

**Joshua 11:3**

and to the coastal Canaanites from the east and to the coastal Amorites and Hivites and Jebusites and Pherezites in the mountain and the Hittites under Hermon in the land of Massipha.

**Joshua 11:4**

And they went out, they and their kings with them, like the sand of the sea in multitude, and horses and very many chariots.

**Joshua 11:5**

And all these kings gathered and came together and camped by the water of Marron to make war against Israel.

**Joshua 11:6**

And the Lord said to Joshua, Do not fear from before them, because tomorrow at this hour I am delivering them routed before Israel. Their horses you shall hamstring, and their chariots you shall burn with fire.

**Joshua 11:7**

And Joshua and all the warrior people came upon them at the water of Marron suddenly and fell upon them in the hill country.

**Joshua 11:8**

And the Lord delivered them under the hands of Israel, and as they struck them they pursued them as far as great Sidon and as far as Maserom and as far as the plains of Massoch toward the east, and they cut them down until none of them was left saved.

**Joshua 11:9**

And Joshua did to them in the way the Lord commanded him: their horses he hamstrung, and their chariots he burned with fire.

**Joshua 11:10**

And Joshua turned back at that time and took Hasor, and its king, for Hasor was formerly ruling all these kingdoms.

**Joshua 11:11**

And they killed every breathing thing in it with the sword and utterly destroyed all, and no breathing thing was left in it, and they burned Hasor with fire.

**Joshua 11:12**

And Joshua took all the cities of the kings and their kings, and killed them with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed them in the way Moses servant of the Lord commanded.

**Joshua 11:13**

But all the cities that had been mounded up Israel did not burn, except Hasor alone Joshua burned.

**Joshua 11:14**

**Joshua 11:16**

**Joshua 11:17**

**Joshua 11:18**

**Joshua 11:19**

And there was no city that Israel did not take; they took all in war.

**Joshua 11:20**

**Joshua 11:21**

**Joshua 11:22**

**Joshua 11:23**

### Chapter 17

**Joshua 17:1**

And the boundaries of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh came to be, because he was firstborn to Joseph, to Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, father of Gilead, for he was a warrior in Gileaditis and in Bashanitis.

**Joshua 17:2**

And it came to be for the remaining sons of Manasseh according to their clans, for the sons of Jezer and the sons of Chelez and the sons of Jeziel and the sons of Sychem and the sons of Symarim and the sons of Opher. These are the males according to their clans.

**Joshua 17:3**

**Joshua 17:4**

**Joshua 17:5**

And their line fell from Anassa and the plain of Labek from Gilead, which is beyond the Jordan,

**Joshua 17:6**

**Joshua 17:7**

And the boundary of the sons of Manasseh came to be Delanath, which is opposite the sons of Anath, and the boundary goes to Jamin and Jassib to the spring of Thaphthoth.

**Joshua 17:8**

**Joshua 17:9**

And the boundaries will go down to the ravine of Karana to the south by the ravine of Jariel, terebinth, to Ephraim in the midst of the city of Manasseh, and the boundary of Manasseh is to the north by the torrent, and its outlet shall be the sea.

**Joshua 17:10**

From the south to Ephraim and to the north Manasseh, and the sea shall be their boundary, and by Asher they shall join on the north and by Issachar on the east.

**Joshua 17:11**

And Manasseh shall have in Issachar and in Asher Bethsan and its villages and those dwelling in Dor and its villages and those dwelling in Mageddo and its villages and the third of Napheta and its villages.

**Joshua 17:12**

And the sons of Manasseh were not able to destroy these cities, and the Canaanite began to dwell in that land.

**Joshua 17:13**

And it happened when the sons of Israel grew strong, they made the Canaanites subject, but did not utterly destroy them.

**Joshua 17:14**

And the sons of Joseph spoke back to Joshua, saying, Why did you give us one lot and one measuring line as an inheritance, while I am a numerous people and God blessed me?

**Joshua 17:15**

And Joshua said to them, If you are a numerous people, go up into the forest and clear a place for yourself, if the hill-country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.

**Joshua 17:16**

And they said, The hill-country of Ephraim will not suffice for us, and the Canaanite dwelling in it has chosen iron horse and chariot, in Bethsan and in its villages, in the valley of Jezrael.

**Joshua 17:17**

And Joshua said to the sons of Joseph, If you are a numerous people and have great strength, there shall not be for you one lot,

**Joshua 17:18**

because the forest shall be yours, for it is forest, and you shall clear it, and it shall be yours, and when you destroy the Canaanite, because he has chosen iron horse and chariot, for you prevail over him.

### Chapter 18

**Joshua 18:1**

And all the congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh, and they pitched there the tent of testimony, and the land was subdued by them.

**Joshua 18:2**

And there were left among the sons of Israel seven tribes that had not inherited.

**Joshua 18:3**

And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, How long will you grow slack to inherit the land that the Lord our God gave?

**Joshua 18:4**

Give from among you three men from each tribe, and let them arise and pass through the land and map it out before me according to how it should be divided, and let them come to me.

**Joshua 18:5**

And he divided it for them into seven portions: Judah shall stand for them on the boundary from the south, and the sons of Joseph shall stand for them from the north.

**Joshua 18:6**

And you shall divide the land into seven portions and bring it to me here, and I will cast for you a lot before the Lord our God.

**Joshua 18:7**

For there is no portion for the sons of Levi among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is his portion. And Gad and Reuben and the half tribe of Manasseh took their inheritance beyond the Jordan toward the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.

**Joshua 18:8**

And the men arose and went, and Joshua commanded the men going to survey the land, saying, Go and survey the land and come back to me, and here I will cast for you a lot before the Lord in Shiloh.

**Joshua 18:9**

And the men went and surveyed the land, and they viewed it and wrote it down by its cities in seven portions in a book, and they brought it to Joshua.

**Joshua 18:10**

And Joshua cast for them a lot in Shiloh before the Lord.

**Joshua 18:11**

And the lot of the tribe of Benjamin came out first according to their clans, and the boundaries of their lot came out between Judah and between the sons of Joseph.

**Joshua 18:12**

**Joshua 18:13**

**Joshua 18:14**

And the boundary shall pass through and go around on the side facing the sea from the south, from the mountain opposite Baithoron to the south, and its outlet shall be at Kariathbaal, this is Kariathiarin, a city of the sons of Judah. This is the side toward the sea.

**Joshua 18:15**

And the side toward the south is from the side of Kariathbaal, and the boundary shall pass to Gasein, to the spring of the water of Naphtho.

**Joshua 18:16**

And the boundary shall go down to the side of the mountain that is opposite the valley of Onnam, which is on the side of Emekraphain to the north, and it shall go down to Gaienna on the south of Jebousai from the south, and it shall go down to the spring of Rogel.

**Joshua 18:17**

And it shall pass to the spring of Baithsamyis and pass to Galiloth, which is opposite the ascent of Aithamin, and shall go down to the stone of Baion of the sons of Reuben.

**Joshua 18:18**

And it shall pass along the shoulder of Baitharaba on the north and shall go down.

**Joshua 18:19**

to the boundary on the south of Baithagla on the north, and the outlet of the boundary shall be at the ridge of the Salt Sea on the north, by the part of the Jordan on the south. These are the boundaries from the south.

**Joshua 18:20**

And the Jordan shall bound it on the eastern side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, its boundaries all around according to their clans.

**Joshua 18:21**

And the cities of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans came to be Jericho and Baitheglio and Amekasis,

**Joshua 18:22**

and Baithabara and Sara and Besana,

**Joshua 18:23**

and Aiin and Phara and Ephratha,

**Joshua 18:24**

and Karapha and Kephira and Moni and Gabaa, twelve cities and their villages.

**Joshua 18:25**

Gabaon and Rama and Beerotha,

**Joshua 18:26**

and Massema and Miron and Amoke,

**Joshua 18:27**

and Phira and Kaphan and Nakan and Selakan and Thareela,

**Joshua 18:28**

and Jebous, this is Jerusalem, and Gabbaothiariim, thirteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans.

### Chapter 19

**Joshua 19:1**

And the second lot came out for the sons of Simeon, and their inheritance came to be in the midst of the allotments of the sons of Judah.

**Joshua 19:2**

And their lot came to be Bersabee and Samaa and Koladam,

**Joshua 19:3**

and Arsola and Bola and Asom,

**Joshua 19:4**

and Elthoula and Boula and Herma,

**Joshua 19:5**

and Sikelak and Baithmachereb and Sarsousin,

**Joshua 19:6**

and Batharoth and their fields, thirteen cities and their villages.

**Joshua 19:7**

Eremmon and Thalcha and Ether and Asan, four cities and their villages.

**Joshua 19:8**

all around their cities as far as Barek, going toward Bameth to the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their clans.

**Joshua 19:9**

From the allotment of Judah came the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, because the share of the sons of Judah became greater than theirs, and the sons of Simeon inherited in the midst of their allotment.

**Joshua 19:10**

And the third lot came out for Zebulun according to their clans. The boundaries of their inheritance shall be Esedek.

**Joshua 19:11**

Gola, their boundary, the sea and Maragella, and it shall join to Baitharaba at the ravine that is opposite Jekman.

**Joshua 19:12**

And it turned back from Seddouk opposite the east to Baithsamyis, to the boundaries of Chaselothaith, and it shall pass to Dabiroth and go up to Phaggai.

**Joshua 19:13**

And from there it shall go around opposite eastward to Gebere, to the city Katasem, and shall pass to Remmona Amathar Aouza.

**Joshua 19:14**

And the boundary shall go around to the north at Amoth, and its outlet shall be at Gaiphael,

**Joshua 19:15**

and Katanath and Nabaal and Symoon and Jericho and Baithman.

**Joshua 19:16**

This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun according to their clans, the cities and their villages.

**Joshua 19:17**

And for Issachar the fourth lot came out.

**Joshua 19:18**

And their boundaries came to be Iezel and Chasaloth and Sounan,

**Joshua 19:19**

and Agin and Siona and Reeiroth and Anachereth,

**Joshua 19:20**

and Dabiron and Kison and Rebes,

**Joshua 19:21**

and Remmas and Jeon and Tomman and Aimarek and Bersaphes,

**Joshua 19:22**

and the boundary shall join to Gaithbor and to Salim by the sea and Baithsamyis, and the outlet of its boundaries shall be the Jordan.

**Joshua 19:23**

This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their clans, the cities and their villages.

**Joshua 19:24**

And the fifth lot came out for Asher.

**Joshua 19:25**

And their boundaries came to be Exeleketh and Aleph and Baithok and Keaph,

**Joshua 19:26**

and Elimelech and Amiiel and Maasa, and it shall join to Carmel by the sea and to Sion and Labanath.

**Joshua 19:27**

And it shall turn back from the rising of the sun to Baithegenech and join to Zebulun, and from Gai to Phthaiel northward, and the boundary shall enter Saphtbaithme and Inael and pass to Choba Masomel,

**Joshua 19:28**

and Elbon and Raab and Ememaon and Kanthan, as far as great Sidon.

**Joshua 19:29**

And the boundary shall turn to Rama and as far as the spring of Masphassat and the Tyrians, and the boundary shall turn to Iasiph, and its outlet shall be the sea, and from Leb and Echozob,

**Joshua 19:30**

and Archob and Aphek and Raau,

**Joshua 19:31**

This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their clans, the cities and their villages.

**Joshua 19:32**

And for Naphtali the sixth lot came out.

**Joshua 19:33**

And their boundaries came to be Moolam and Mola and Besemiin and Arme and Nabok and Jephthamai, as far as Dodam, and its outlets came to be the Jordan.

**Joshua 19:34**

And the boundary shall turn to the sea at Enath-thabor and pass from there to Jakana, and it shall join to Zebulun from the south and Asher shall join by the sea, and the Jordan from the rising of the sun.

**Joshua 19:35**

And the fortified cities of the Tyrians were Tyre and Omatha, Daketh and Kenereth,

**Joshua 19:36**

and Armaith and Arael and Asor,

**Joshua 19:37**

and Kades and Assari and the spring of Asor,

**Joshua 19:38**

and Kerōe and Megala Arim and Baiththame and Thessamys.

**Joshua 19:39**

This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali.

**Joshua 19:40**

And for Dan the seventh lot came out.

**Joshua 19:41**

And their boundaries came to be Sarath and Asa, cities of Sammans,

**Joshua 19:42**

and Salabin and Ammon and Silatha,

**Joshua 19:43**

and Ailon and Thamnatha and Akkaron,

**Joshua 19:44**

and Alkatha and Bege thon and Gebeelan,

**Joshua 19:45**

and Azor and Banaibakat and Gethremmon,

**Joshua 19:46**

and from the sea Hierakon, the boundary near Joppa.

**Joshua 19:47**

This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their clans, their cities and their villages. And the sons of Dan did not drive out the Amorite who hemmed them in on the mountain, and the Amorites did not allow them to go down into the valley, and they pressed the boundary of their portion away from them.

**Joshua 19:48**

And the sons of Judah went and fought Lachis and captured it and struck it with the edge of the sword and settled in it and called its name Lasendak. And the Amorite remained dwelling in Elom and in Salamin, and the hand of Ephraim weighed heavily on them, and they became tributary to them.

**Joshua 19:49**

And they went to take possession of the land according to their boundary, and the sons of Israel gave Joshua son of Naue an inheritance among them.

**Joshua 19:50**

By command of God they gave him the city he asked, Thamnasarach, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, and he built the city and lived in it.

**Joshua 19:51**

These are the divisions that Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Naue and the heads of the fathers among the tribes of Israel apportioned by lots in Shiloh before the Lord at the doors of the tent of testimony, and they went to take possession of the land.

### Chapter 20

**Joshua 20:1**

And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,

**Joshua 20:2**

Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, Appoint the cities of refuge of which I spoke to you through Moses,

**Joshua 20:3**

a refuge for the killer who struck down a life unintentionally, and the cities shall be for you as a refuge, and the killer shall not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

**Joshua 20:7**

And they set apart Kades in Galilee in the mountain of Naphtali, and Sychem in the mountain of Ephraim, and the city Arbok, this is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

**Joshua 20:8**

And beyond the Jordan they gave Bosor in the wilderness in the plain from the tribe of Reuben, and Arēmōth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Gaulon in Bashanitis from the tribe of Manasseh.

**Joshua 20:9**

These are the appointed cities for the sons of Israel and for the resident foreigner staying among them, that everyone striking a life unintentionally might flee there, so that he may not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

### Chapter 21

**Joshua 21:1**

And the heads of the fathers' houses of the sons of Levi approached Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Naue and the heads of the fathers' houses from the tribes of Israel.

**Joshua 21:2**

And they said to them in Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in and pasturelands for our cattle.

**Joshua 21:3**

And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites, in their inheriting, by command of the Lord, the cities and their pasturelands.

**Joshua 21:4**

And the lot came out for the clan of Kaath, and for the sons of Aaron the priests, the Levites, from the tribe of Judah and from the tribe of Simeon and from the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities by lot.

**Joshua 21:5**

And for the sons of Kaath who were left, from the tribe of Ephraim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities by lot.

**Joshua 21:6**

And for the sons of Gedson, from the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

**Joshua 21:7**

And for the sons of Merari according to their clans, from the tribe of Reuben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities by lot.

**Joshua 21:8**

And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their pasturelands, just as the Lord commanded Moses, by lot.

**Joshua 21:9**

And the tribe of the sons of Judah and the tribe of the sons of Simeon and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin gave the cities that were called out

**Joshua 21:10**

for the sons of Aaron from the clan of Kaath of the sons of Levi, because for these the lot came to be.

**Joshua 21:11**

And they gave them Kariatharbok, metropolis of the Anakim, this is Hebron, in the hill-country of Judah, and its pasturelands around it.

**Joshua 21:12**

And Joshua gave the fields of the city and its villages to the sons of Caleb son of Jephonne in possession.

**Joshua 21:13**

And to the sons of Aaron they gave Hebron, city of refuge for the manslayer, and its set-apart lands with it, and Lemna and its set-apart lands toward it,

**Joshua 21:14**

and Ailom and its set-apart lands, and Tema and its set-apart lands,

**Joshua 21:15**

and Gella and its set-apart lands, and Dabir and its set-apart lands,

**Joshua 21:16**

and Asa and its set-apart lands, and Tany and its set-apart lands, and Baithsamyis and its set-apart lands, nine cities from these two tribes.

**Joshua 21:17**

And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gabaon and its set-apart lands, and Gatheth and its set-apart lands,

**Joshua 21:18**

and Anathoth and its set-apart lands, and Gamala and its set-apart lands, four cities.

**Joshua 21:19**

All the cities of the sons of Aaron the priests were thirteen.

**Joshua 21:20**

And for the clans of the sons of Kaath, the Levites, who were left from the sons of Kaath, the cities of their boundaries came from the tribe of Ephraim.

**Joshua 21:21**

And they gave them the city of refuge for the manslayer, Sychem, and its set-apart lands, and Gazara and the lands toward it and its set-apart lands,

**Joshua 21:22**

and Kabsaim and the set-apart lands toward it, and upper Baithoron and its set-apart lands, four cities.

**Joshua 21:23**

And from the tribe of Dan, Elkothaim and its set-apart lands, and Gethedan and its set-apart lands,

**Joshua 21:24**

and Ailon and its set-apart lands, and Getheremmon and its set-apart lands, four cities.

**Joshua 21:25**

And from the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach and its set-apart lands, and Iebatha and its set-apart lands, two cities.

**Joshua 21:26**

All the cities were ten, and the set-apart lands toward them, for the clans of the sons of Kaath who were left over.

**Joshua 21:27**

And to the sons of Gedson, the Levites, from the half tribe of Manasseh, the cities set apart for the manslayers: Gaulon in Bashanitis and its set-apart lands, and Bosora and its set-apart lands, two cities.

**Joshua 21:28**

And from the tribe of Issachar, Kison and its set-apart lands, and Debba and its set-apart lands,

**Joshua 21:29**

and Remmath and its set-apart lands, and the spring of letters and its set-apart lands, four cities.

**Joshua 21:30**

And from the tribe of Asher, Basellan and its set-apart lands, and Dabbōn and its set-apart lands,

**Joshua 21:31**

and Chelkath and its set-apart lands, and Raab and its set-apart lands, four cities.

**Joshua 21:32**

And from the tribe of Naphtali, the city set apart for the manslayer, Kades in Galilee, and its set-apart lands, and Emmath and its set-apart lands, and Themmōn and its set-apart lands, three cities.

**Joshua 21:33**

All the cities of Gedson according to their clans were thirteen cities.

**Joshua 21:34**

And to the clan of the sons of Merari, the Levites, the rest, from the tribe of the sons of Zebulun, Maan and its pasturelands, and Kades and its pasturelands,

**Joshua 21:35**

and Demna and its pasturelands, and Sella and its pasturelands, four cities.

**Joshua 21:36**

And beyond the Jordan by Jericho, from the tribe of Reuben, the city of refuge for the manslayer, Bosor in the wilderness in Misor, and its pasturelands, and Iazēr and its pasturelands,

**Joshua 21:37**

and Dekmōn and its pasturelands, and Mapha and its pasturelands, four cities.

**Joshua 21:38**

And from the tribe of Gad, the city of refuge for the manslayer, Ramoth in Gilead and its pasturelands, and Kamin and its pasturelands,

**Joshua 21:39**

and Esebōn and its pasturelands, and Iazēr and its pasturelands, all four cities.

**Joshua 21:40**

All the cities for the sons of Merari according to their clans, the ones left over from the tribe of Levi, and their boundaries came to be twelve cities.

**Joshua 21:41**

All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel were forty-eight cities and their pasturelands.

**Joshua 21:42**

Around these cities each city had its pasturelands around the city, all these cities. And Joshua finished dividing the land within their boundaries. And the sons of Israel gave Joshua a share by command of the Lord; they gave him the city he asked, Thamnasarach, they gave it to him in the hill-country of Ephraim. And Joshua built the city and lived in it. And Joshua took the stone knives with which he circumcised the sons of Israel who were born on the way in the wilderness and placed them in Thamnasarach.

**Joshua 21:43**

And the Lord gave to Israel all the land that he swore to give to their fathers, and they inherited it and dwelt in it.

**Joshua 21:44**

And the Lord gave them rest all around, just as he swore to their fathers. No one stood against them from all their enemies; the Lord gave all their enemies into their hands.

**Joshua 21:45**

Not one word fell from all the good words that the Lord spoke to the sons of Israel; all came to pass.

### Chapter 22

**Joshua 22:1**

Then Joshua called together the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh,

**Joshua 22:2**

and said to them, You have heard all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and you obeyed my voice according to all that I commanded you.

**Joshua 22:3**

You have not forsaken your brothers these many days until this day, and you have kept the commandment of the Lord your God.

**Joshua 22:4**

And now the Lord our God has given our brothers rest, as he told them. Now then, turn back and go to your houses and to the land of your possession that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan.

**Joshua 22:5**

Only take great care to do the commandments and the law that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded us to do: to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, and to cling to him and serve him with all your mind and with all your soul.

**Joshua 22:6**

And Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their houses.

**Joshua 22:7**

And to the half tribe of Manasseh Moses gave a share in Bashanitis, and to the other half Joshua gave a share with their brothers beyond the Jordan by the sea. And when Joshua sent them away to their houses, he blessed them,

**Joshua 22:8**

and they went away to their houses with much wealth and very much livestock and silver and gold and iron and much clothing, and they divided the plunder of their enemies with their brothers.

**Joshua 22:9**

And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of the sons of Manasseh went from the sons of Israel from Shiloh in the land of Canaan to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession which they inherited by command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

**Joshua 22:10**

And they came to Galgala of the Jordan, which is in the land of Canaan, and the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, a great altar to behold.

**Joshua 22:11**

And the sons of Israel heard people saying, Behold, the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben and the half tribe of Manasseh built an altar on the borders of the land of Canaan, at Galaad of the Jordan, on the far side of the sons of Israel.

**Joshua 22:12**

And all the sons of Israel gathered in Shiloh so as to go up to make war against them.

**Joshua 22:13**

And the sons of Israel sent to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the high priest,

**Joshua 22:14**

and ten leaders with him, one leader from each fathers' house from all the tribes of Israel; these were heads of fathers' houses, commanders of thousands in Israel.

**Joshua 22:15**

And they came to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben and to the half tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead and spoke to them, saying,

**Joshua 22:16**

Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord, What is this trespass by which you have trespassed before the God of Israel, turning away today from the Lord by building for yourselves an altar, so that you become rebels against the Lord?

**Joshua 22:17**

Is the sin of Phogor too little for us, from which we have not been cleansed until this day, and a plague came to be in the congregation of the Lord?

**Joshua 22:18**

And will you turn away today from the Lord? And it shall be, if you revolt today from the Lord, then tomorrow wrath will be on all Israel.

**Joshua 22:19**

And now, if the land of your possession is too little for you, cross over into the land of the possession of the Lord, where the tent of the Lord camps, and inherit among us. But do not become rebels against God, and do not turn away from the Lord by your building for yourselves an altar apart from the altar of the Lord our God.

**Joshua 22:20**

Did not Achar son of Zara commit a trespass from the accursed thing, and wrath came upon all the congregation of Israel? Yet that one man did not die alone in his own sin.

**Joshua 22:21**

And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered and spoke to the commanders of thousands of Israel, saying,

**Joshua 22:22**

God is God, the Lord, and God is God, the Lord. He himself knows, and Israel itself shall know. If in revolt we have trespassed before the Lord, may he not rescue us in this.

**Joshua 22:23**

And if we built for ourselves an altar so as to turn away from the Lord our God, so as to offer on it sacrifices of whole burnt offerings or so as to make on it a sacrifice of salvation, the Lord himself shall require it.

**Joshua 22:24**

But because of caution over this matter we did this, saying, So that tomorrow your children may not say to our children, What have you to do with the Lord God of Israel?

**Joshua 22:25**

For the Lord set the Jordan as a boundary between us and you, and you have no share of the Lord. And your children will estrange our children, so that they no longer worship the Lord.

**Joshua 22:26**

And we said to do this, to build this altar, not for offerings nor for sacrifices,

**Joshua 22:27**

but so that this may be a witness between us and you and between our generations after us, to render service to the Lord before him in our offerings and in our sacrifices and in our sacrifices of salvation, and your children will not say to our children tomorrow, You have no share in the Lord.

**Joshua 22:28**

And we said, if ever it happens and they speak to us and to our generations tomorrow, then we shall say, See the likeness of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for offerings nor for sacrifices, but it is a witness between you and us and between our sons.

**Joshua 22:29**

May it never be for us to turn away from the Lord in these days, to revolt from the Lord, so as to build for ourselves an altar for offerings and sacrifices of well-being and the sacrifice of salvation besides the altar of the Lord that is before his tent.

**Joshua 22:30**

And when Phinehas the priest and all the leaders of the congregation of Israel who were with him heard the words that the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them.

**Joshua 22:31**

And Phinehas the priest said to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half tribe of Manasseh, Today we know that the Lord is with us, because you did not trespass against the Lord in a trespass, and because you rescued the sons of Israel from the hand of the Lord.

**Joshua 22:32**

And Phinehas the priest and the leaders returned from the sons of Reuben and from the sons of Gad and from the half tribe of Manasseh, from the land of Gilead to the land of Canaan to the sons of Israel, and they answered them with the words.

**Joshua 22:33**

And it pleased the sons of Israel, and they spoke to the sons of Israel and blessed the God of the sons of Israel, and said that they would no longer go up against them in war to destroy the land of the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh, and they dwelt upon it.

**Joshua 22:34**

And Joshua named the altar of the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half tribe of Manasseh, and said, It is a witness between them that the Lord is their God.

### Chapter 23

**Joshua 23:1**

And it came to be after many days, after the Lord gave Israel rest from all their enemies all around, and Joshua was old, advanced in days,

**Joshua 23:2**

that Joshua called all the sons of Israel and their council and their leaders and their scribes and their judges, and said to them, I have grown old, I am advanced in days.

**Joshua 23:3**

And you have seen all that the Lord your God did to all these nations from before you, because the Lord your God is the one who fought for you.

**Joshua 23:4**

See, I have allotted to you these nations left over to you by lots for your tribes, from the Jordan and all the nations that I destroyed, and from the great sea it shall bound westward.

**Joshua 23:5**

And the Lord your God himself will destroy them from before you until they perish, and he will send to them the wild beasts until he destroys them and their kings from before you, and you shall inherit their land just as the Lord your God spoke to you.

**Joshua 23:6**

Therefore be very strong to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, so that you do not turn aside to the right or to the left,

**Joshua 23:7**

so that you do not enter among these nations that are left over, and the names of their gods shall not be named among you, and you shall certainly not bow down to them nor serve them.

**Joshua 23:8**

But to the Lord your God you shall cling, just as you have done until this day.

**Joshua 23:9**

And the Lord destroyed from before you great and strong nations, and no one stood against you until this day.

**Joshua 23:10**

One of you chased a thousand, because the Lord your God was fighting for you, just as he said to you.

**Joshua 23:11**

And take great care to love the Lord your God.

**Joshua 23:12**

For if you turn back and attach yourselves to these nations left over with you and make marriages with them and mingle with them and they with you,

**Joshua 23:13**

know that the Lord will certainly not continue to destroy these nations from before you, and they shall become snares for you and scandals and nails in your heels and darts in your eyes until you perish from this good land that the Lord your God gave you.

**Joshua 23:14**

And behold, I am departing on the way, just as all on the earth, and you shall know in your heart and in your soul that not one word has failed from all the words that the Lord your God spoke concerning all that belongs to you; none of them has fallen away.

**Joshua 23:15**

And it shall be, just as all the good words that the Lord spoke to you have come upon you, so the Lord your God will bring upon you all the evil words until he destroys you from this good land that the Lord gave you.

**Joshua 23:16**

when you transgress the covenant of the Lord your God that he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them.

### Chapter 24

**Joshua 24:1**

And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shiloh and called together their elders and their scribes and their judges, and he set them before God.

**Joshua 24:2**

And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: From the beginning your fathers lived beyond the river, Thara the father of Abraham and the father of Nachor, and they served other gods.

**Joshua 24:3**

And I took your father Abraham from beyond the river and led him through all the land, and I multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac.

**Joshua 24:4**

And to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau, and to Esau I gave Mount Seir for his inheritance, and Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt and became there a great and numerous and strong nation.

**Joshua 24:5**

And the Egyptians afflicted them, and the Lord struck Egypt with the things he did among them, and after these things he brought you out.

**Joshua 24:6**

Out of Egypt you came, and you entered the Red Sea, and the Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and horses to the Red Sea.

**Joshua 24:7**

And we cried out to the Lord, and he put cloud and gloom between us and between the Egyptians, and he brought the sea upon them and covered them, and your eyes saw what the Lord did in the land of Egypt, and you were in the wilderness many days.

**Joshua 24:8**

And he brought you into the land of the Amorites who dwell beyond the Jordan, and they arrayed themselves against you, and the Lord gave them into your hands, and you inherited their land and destroyed them from before you.

**Joshua 24:9**

And Balak son of Sepphor, king of Moab, rose up and made war against Israel, and he sent and called Balaam to curse you.

**Joshua 24:10**

And the Lord your God was not willing to destroy you, and with blessing he blessed you and delivered you from their hands and gave them over.

**Joshua 24:11**

And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho, and those dwelling in Jericho fought against you: the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite and the Hittite and the Girgashite, and the Lord gave them into your hands.

**Joshua 24:12**

And he sent ahead of you the hornet, and it drove them out from before you, twelve kings of the Amorites, not by your sword nor by your bow.

**Joshua 24:13**

And he gave you a land on which you did not labor, and cities that you did not build, and you settled in them, and you eat vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.

**Joshua 24:14**

And now fear the Lord and serve him in uprightness and in righteousness, and remove the foreign gods that your fathers served beyond the river and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.

**Joshua 24:15**

But if it does not please you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve, whether the gods of your fathers beyond the river or the gods of the Amorites among whom you dwell on their land. But I and my house will serve the Lord, because he is holy.

**Joshua 24:16**

And the people answered and said, May it never be for us to forsake the Lord so as to serve other gods.

**Joshua 24:17**

The Lord our God, he is God; he brought up us and our fathers out of Egypt and preserved us in all the way in which we went and among all the nations through whom we passed.

**Joshua 24:18**

And the Lord drove out the Amorite and all the nations dwelling in the land from before us. Therefore we also will serve the Lord, for he is our God.

**Joshua 24:19**

And Joshua said to the people, You will not be able to serve the Lord, because he is a holy and jealous God; he will not forgive your sins and your lawless deeds.

**Joshua 24:20**

Whenever you forsake the Lord and serve other gods, then coming upon you he will mistreat you and consume you in return for the good things he did for you.

**Joshua 24:21**

And the people said to Joshua, No, but we will serve the Lord.

**Joshua 24:22**

And Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you chose the Lord, to serve him.

**Joshua 24:23**

And now remove the foreign gods among you and direct your heart toward the Lord God of Israel.

**Joshua 24:24**

And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the Lord and we will listen to his voice.

**Joshua 24:25**

And Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day and gave them law and judgment in Shiloh before the tent of the God of Israel.

**Joshua 24:26**

And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and Joshua took a great stone and set it up under the terebinth before the Lord.

**Joshua 24:27**

And Joshua said to the people, Behold, this stone shall be among you as a witness, because it has heard all that was spoken to it by the Lord, whatever he spoke to us today, and it shall be among you as a witness at the last days, whenever you lie against the Lord my God.

**Joshua 24:28**

And Joshua sent the people away, and each went to his own place.

**Joshua 24:29**

And Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who lengthened time after Joshua and who saw all the works of the Lord that he did for Israel.

**Joshua 24:30**

And it came to be after these things that Joshua son of Naue, servant of the Lord, died at one hundred ten years.

**Joshua 24:31**

And they buried him at the borders of his inheritance in Thamnathasachara in the hill-country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaas. There they put with him into the tomb in which they buried him the stone knives with which he circumcised the sons of Israel in Galgala when he brought them out of Egypt, just as the Lord commanded them, and there they are until this day.

**Joshua 24:32**

And the sons of Israel brought up the bones of Joseph out of Egypt, and they buried them in Sikimoi, in the portion of the field that Jacob acquired from the Amorites dwelling in Sikimoi for a hundred lambs, and he gave it to Joseph as a portion.

**Joshua 24:33**

And after these things Eleazar son of Aaron the high priest died, and they buried him in Gabaath of Phinehas his son, which he gave him in the hill-country of Ephraim. On that day the sons of Israel took the ark of God and carried it among themselves, and Phinehas served as priest in place of Eleazar his father until he died, and he was buried in his own Gabaath. And the sons of Israel went away each to his own place and to his own city, and the sons of Israel worshiped Astarte and Astaroth and the gods of the nations around them, and the Lord gave them into the hands of Eglom king of Moab, and he ruled over them eighteen years.

## Judges

### Chapter 1

**Judges 1:1**

And it came to be after the death of Joshua that the sons of Israel inquired of the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanite, leading to fight against him?

**Judges 1:2**

And the Lord said, Judah shall go up. See, I have given the land into his hand.

**Judges 1:3**

And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me in my lot and let us fight against the Canaanite, and I also will go with you in your lot. And Simeon went with him.

**Judges 1:4**

And Judah went up, and the Lord gave the Canaanite and the Perizzite into his hand, and he struck them at Bezek, ten thousand men.

**Judges 1:5**

And they found Adonibezek at Bezek and fought against him, and they struck the Canaanite and the Perizzite.

**Judges 1:6**

And Adonibezek fled, and they pursued after him and took him and cut off the tips of his hands and his feet.

**Judges 1:7**

And Adonibezek said, Seventy kings with the tips of their hands and feet cut off used to gather what was under my table. As I did, so God repaid me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

**Judges 1:8**

And the sons of Judah fought against Jerusalem and took it, and they struck it with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.

**Judges 1:9**

And after this the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanite dwelling in the hill-country and the south and the plain.

**Judges 1:10**

And Judah went against the Canaanite dwelling in Hebron, and Hebron came out opposite them; the name of Hebron before was Kariatharboksepher. And he struck Sesi and Achiman and Tholmi, offspring of Enak.

**Judges 1:11**

And from there they went against those dwelling in Dabir, and the name of Dabir before was City of Letters.

**Judges 1:12**

And Caleb said, Whoever strikes the City of Letters and takes it first, I will give him my daughter Ascha as wife.

**Judges 1:13**

And Gothoniēl son of Kenez, younger brother of Caleb, took it first, and he gave him his daughter Ascha as wife.

**Judges 1:14**

And it came to be when she went in, she urged him to ask from her father for the field, and she groaned upon the pack animal and cried out from the pack animal, You gave me into a south land. And Caleb said to her, What is wrong with you?

**Judges 1:15**

And Ascha said to him, Give me a blessing, because you gave me into a south land, and you shall give me a redemption of water. And Caleb gave her according to her heart, the redemption of the heights and the redemption of the low places.

**Judges 1:16**

And the sons of Jōbab the Kenite, father-in-law of Moses, went up from the City of Palms with the sons of Judah into the wilderness that is in the south at the descent of Arad, and he went and dwelt with the people.

**Judges 1:17**

And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanite dwelling at Sephaeth and devoted it to destruction and utterly destroyed it, and they called the name of the city Extermination.

**Judges 1:18**

And Judah did not inherit Gaza and its boundary, and Ascalon and its boundary, and Akkaron and its boundary, and Azotus and its pasturelands.

**Judges 1:19**

And the Lord was with Judah, and he inherited the hill-country, because he was not able to inherit those dwelling in the valley, because Rēchab had deployed it.

**Judges 1:20**

And they gave Hebron to Caleb, just as Moses spoke, and he inherited from there the three cities and removed from there the three sons of Enak.

**Judges 1:21**

And the sons of Benjamin did not remove the Jebusite dwelling in Jerusalem, and the Jebusite dwelt with the sons of Benjamin until this day.

**Judges 1:22**

And the sons of Joseph also went up to Baethel, and Judah was with them.

**Judges 1:23**

And the house of Israel encamped against Baethel; the name of the city before was Louza.

**Judges 1:24**

And the watchers saw a man coming out of the city and took him and said to him, Show us the entrance of the city, and we will deal mercifully with you.

**Judges 1:25**

And he showed them the entrance of the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword, but the man and all his kin they sent away.

**Judges 1:26**

And the man went into the land of the Hittites and built there a city and called its name Louza. This is its name until this day.

**Judges 1:27**

And Manasseh did not inherit Baithsan, which is city of Scythians, nor its daughters, nor its pasturelands, nor Ekthanaad and its daughters, nor those dwelling in Dor and its daughters, and those dwelling in Balaam and its daughters, and those dwelling in Magedō and its daughters, nor those dwelling in Jeblaam nor its daughters. And the Canaanite began to dwell in this land.

**Judges 1:28**

And it came to be when Israel grew strong, it made the Canaanite subject to tribute, but in removing, it did not remove him.

**Judges 1:29**

And Ephraim did not remove the Canaanite dwelling in Gazer, and the Canaanite dwelt in its midst in Gazer and became subject to tribute.

**Judges 1:30**

And Zebulun did not remove those dwelling in Kedrōn and those dwelling in Enaala, and the Canaanite dwelt in its midst and became subject to tribute.

**Judges 1:31**

And Asher did not remove those dwelling in Akchō, and they became tributary to him, and those dwelling in Dōr and those dwelling in Sidon and those dwelling in Aaalaph and Achazib and Chelba and Aphek and Roōb.

**Judges 1:32**

And Asher dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite dwelling in the land, because he was not able to remove him.

**Judges 1:33**

And Naphtali did not remove those dwelling in Baithsamyis nor those dwelling in Baitheneth, and Israel dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite dwelling in the land, but those dwelling in Baithsamyis and Baitheneth became subject to tribute for them.

**Judges 1:34**

And the Amorite pressed the sons of Dan into the mountain, because he did not allow him to go down into the valley.

**Judges 1:35**

And the Amorite began to dwell in the mountain of Myrsinōn, where the bears and the foxes are, and the hand of the house of Joseph weighed heavily on the Amorite, and he became subject to tribute.

**Judges 1:36**

And the boundary of the Amorite, the Idumean, was above Akrabin, from the rock and upward.

### Chapter 2

**Judges 2:1**

And an angel of the Lord went up from Galgala to the place of Weeping and to Baethel and to the house of Israel and said to them, The Lord brought you up out of Egypt and brought you into the land that he swore to your fathers to give you, and he said to you, I will never scatter my covenant with you forever.

**Judges 2:2**

And you shall not make a covenant with those dwelling in this land, and you shall certainly not bow down to their gods, but you shall shatter their carved images and dig down their altars. And you did not listen to my voice when you did these things.

**Judges 2:3**

And I said, I will not continue to move away the people that I said I would destroy from before you, and they shall be for you in constriction, and their gods shall be for you as a snare.

**Judges 2:4**

And it came to be, as the angel of the Lord spoke these words to all Israel, the people raised their voice and wept.

**Judges 2:5**

Because of this the name of that place was called Weeping, and there they sacrificed to the Lord.

**Judges 2:6**

And Joshua sent the people away, and the sons of Israel went, each to his house and to his inheritance, to inherit the land.

**Judges 2:7**

And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who lived long after Joshua, who knew all the great work of the Lord that he did for Israel.

**Judges 2:8**

And Joshua son of Naue, servant of the Lord, died, being one hundred ten years old.

**Judges 2:9**

And they buried him in the boundary of his inheritance in Thamnathares in the hill-country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaas.

**Judges 2:10**

And that whole generation was added to their fathers, and another generation arose after them, those who did not know the Lord and the work that he did for Israel.

**Judges 2:11**

And the sons of Israel did evil before the Lord and served the Baals.

**Judges 2:12**

And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they went after other gods from the gods of the peoples around them and bowed down to them, and they provoked the Lord.

**Judges 2:13**

And they forsook the Lord and served Baal and the Astartes.

**Judges 2:14**

And the Lord burned with anger against Israel and gave them into the hand of plunderers, and they plundered them, and he sold them into the hand of their enemies all around, and they were not able to stand before their enemies.

**Judges 2:15**

In all the ways in which they prostituted themselves, the hand of the Lord was against them for harm, just as the Lord spoke and just as the Lord swore, and he pressed them very hard.

**Judges 2:16**

And the Lord raised up judges for them, and they saved them from the hand of those plundering them.

**Judges 2:17**

Yet even to their judges they did not listen, because they prostituted themselves after other gods and bowed down to them and provoked the Lord, and they quickly turned aside from the way in which their fathers walked, to listen to the commandments of the Lord. They did not do so.

**Judges 2:18**

And when the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge and saved them from the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge, because the Lord was moved by their groaning from before those besieging them and mistreating them.

**Judges 2:19**

And it came to be when the judge died, they turned back and again corrupted themselves beyond their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They did not cast off their practices, and they did not depart from their hard way.

**Judges 2:20**

And the Lord burned with anger against Israel and said, Because this nation forsook my covenant that I commanded their fathers and did not listen to my voice,

**Judges 2:21**

I also will not continue to remove a man from before them from the nations that Joshua left and allowed to remain,

**Judges 2:22**

in order to test Israel by them, whether they will keep the way of the Lord to walk in it, just as their fathers kept it, or not.

**Judges 2:23**

And the Lord left these nations so as not to remove them quickly, and he did not give them into the hand of Joshua.

### Chapter 3

**Judges 3:1**

And these are the nations Joshua left to test Israel by them, all who had not known all the wars of Canaan,

**Judges 3:2**

only for the generations of the sons of Israel, to teach them war, only those before them had not known them:

**Judges 3:3**

the five satrapies of the foreigners and all the Canaanite and the Sidonian and the Hivite dwelling on Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lobōēmath.

**Judges 3:4**

And it came to be in order to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commandments of the Lord that he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

**Judges 3:5**

And the sons of Israel dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite,

**Judges 3:6**

and they took their daughters for themselves as wives and gave their daughters to their sons and served their gods.

**Judges 3:7**

And the sons of Israel did evil before the Lord and forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the groves.

**Judges 3:8**

And the Lord burned with anger against Israel and sold them into the hands of Chousarsathōm king of Syrian Mesopotamia, and they served him eight years.

**Judges 3:9**

And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, and the Lord raised up a savior for Israel and saved them, Gothoniēl son of Kenez, younger brother of Caleb, and he listened to him.

**Judges 3:10**
