and Elia and Zabadia sons of Ieraam, sons of Gedor.

**1 Chronicles 12:9**

And from Gadites men separated themselves to Dauid from wilderness, mighty men, men of battle line for war, carrying shields and spears, and their faces were lion faces, and they were swift as gazelles on mountains.

**1 Chronicles 12:10**

Azer chief, Abdias second, Eliab third,

**1 Chronicles 12:11**

Masemannē fourth, Ieremia fifth,

**1 Chronicles 12:12**

Eththi sixth, Eliab seventh,

**1 Chronicles 12:13**

Ioanan eighth, Eliazer ninth,

**1 Chronicles 12:14**

Ieremia tenth, Machabannai eleventh.

**1 Chronicles 12:15**

These from sons of Gad were chiefs of army; least one was over hundred, and greatest over thousand.

**1 Chronicles 12:16**

These crossed Jordan in first month, when it was filled over all its banks, and they drove out all dwelling in valleys from east to west.

**1 Chronicles 12:17**

And some from sons of Beniamin and Iouda came for help to Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 12:18**

And Dauid went out to meet them and said to them, If you have come to me in peace, let my heart be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, though no truth of hand is against me, may God of our fathers see and rebuke.

**1 Chronicles 12:19**

And spirit clothed Amasai, chief of thirty, and he said, Go, and your people, Dauid son of Iessai. Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, because your God has helped you. And Dauid received them and set them as chiefs of forces.

**1 Chronicles 12:20**

And from Manasse some joined Dauid when Philistines came against Saul for battle, and he did not help them, because by counsel commanders of Philistines sent him away, saying, At cost of heads of those men he will return to his lord Saul.

**1 Chronicles 12:21**

When he went to Sekelag, there joined him from Manasse: Edna and Iozabath and Iodiēl and Michaēl and Iosabeth and Elimouth and Selathi, heads of thousands of Manasse.

**1 Chronicles 12:22**

And they fought alongside Dauid against raiding band, because all were mighty of strength, and they became leaders in army, in force.

**1 Chronicles 12:23**

Because day by day they kept coming to Dauid, into great force, like force of God.

**1 Chronicles 12:24**

And these were names of chiefs of army who came to Dauid in Chebron to turn kingdom of Saul to him according to word of Lord.

**1 Chronicles 12:25**

Sons of Iouda, shield-bearers and spear-bearers, six thousand eight hundred, mighty for battle line.

**1 Chronicles 12:26**

From sons of Symeon, mighty in strength for battle line, seven thousand one hundred.

**1 Chronicles 12:27**

From sons of Leui, four thousand six hundred.

**1 Chronicles 12:28**

And Iōadae leader for Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred.

**1 Chronicles 12:29**

And Sadok, young man mighty in strength, and from his father’s house, twenty-two chiefs.

**1 Chronicles 12:30**

And from sons of Beniamin, brothers of Saul, three thousand, and still most of them were keeping watch of house of Saul.

**1 Chronicles 12:31**

And from sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty in strength, men of name by houses of their fathers.

**1 Chronicles 12:32**

And from half tribe of Manasse, eighteen thousand who were named by name to come make Dauid king.

**1 Chronicles 12:33**

And from sons of Issachar, knowing understanding for times, knowing what Israel should do, their chiefs were two hundred, and all their brothers with them.

**1 Chronicles 12:34**

And from Zabulon, going out for battle line with every weapon of war, fifty thousand to help Dauid, not double-hearted.

**1 Chronicles 12:35**

And from Nephthali, one thousand chiefs, and with them with shields and spears, thirty-seven thousand.

**1 Chronicles 12:36**

And from Danites, drawing up for battle, twenty-eight thousand eight hundred.

**1 Chronicles 12:37**

And from Aser, going out to help in war, forty thousand.

**1 Chronicles 12:38**

And from beyond Jordan, from Reuben and Gad and from half tribe of Manasse, with every weapon of war, one hundred twenty thousand.

**1 Chronicles 12:39**

All these were men of war, drawing up battle line with peaceful soul, and they came to Chebron to make Dauid king over all Israel, and remnant of Israel were one soul to make Dauid king.

**1 Chronicles 12:40**

And they were there three days, eating and drinking, because their brothers had prepared for them.

**1 Chronicles 12:41**

And those bordering them, even as far as Issachar and Zabulon and Nephthali, were bringing to them on camels and donkeys and mules and on calves provisions, meal, fig cakes, raisins, wine and oil, calves and sheep in abundance, because gladness was in Israel.

### Chapter 13

**1 Chronicles 13:1**

And Dauid took counsel with commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every leader.

**1 Chronicles 13:2**

And Dauid said to all assembly of Israel, If this seems good to you, and if it has been prospered from Lord our God, let us send to our brothers left behind in all land of Israel, and with them to priests and Levites in cities of their possession, and let them gather to us.

**1 Chronicles 13:3**

And let us bring ark of our God to us, because from days of Saul they did not seek it.

**1 Chronicles 13:4**

And all assembly said to do so, because word was upright in eyes of all people.

**1 Chronicles 13:5**

And Dauid assembled all Israel from borders of Egypt and as far as entrance of Hamath, to bring ark of God from city of Iarim.

**1 Chronicles 13:6**

And Dauid brought it up, and all Israel went up to City of Dauid, which belonged to Iouda, to bring up from there ark of God, Lord seated upon cheroubim, where his name was called upon it.

**1 Chronicles 13:7**

And they placed ark of God on new wagon from house of Aminadab, and Oza and his brothers were leading wagon.

**1 Chronicles 13:8**

And Dauid and all Israel were playing before God with all strength, and with songs and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets.

**1 Chronicles 13:9**

And they came as far as threshing floor, and Oza stretched out his hand to grasp ark, because calf turned it aside.

**1 Chronicles 13:10**

And Lord’s anger grew hot against Oza, and he struck him there because he stretched out his hand upon ark, and he died there before God.

**1 Chronicles 13:11**

And Dauid was troubled because Lord had broken out with breach against Oza, and he called that place Breach-of-Oza until this day.

**1 Chronicles 13:12**

And Dauid feared God on that day, saying, How shall I bring ark of God to myself?

**1 Chronicles 13:13**

And Dauid did not bring back ark to himself into City of Dauid, but turned it aside into house of Abeddara the Geththite.

**1 Chronicles 13:14**

And ark of God stayed in house of Abeddara three months, and God blessed Abeddaram and all his things.

### Chapter 14

**1 Chronicles 14:1**

And Chiram king of Tyre sent messengers to Dauid, and cedar woods and builders of walls and carpenters of wood to build him house.

**1 Chronicles 14:2**

And Dauid knew that Lord had established him over Israel, because his kingdom was exalted on high for sake of his people Israel.

**1 Chronicles 14:3**

And Dauid took yet more wives in Ierousalem, and more sons and daughters were born to Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 14:4**

And these were names of children born to him in Ierousalem: Samaa, Isobaam, Nathan, Salomon,

**1 Chronicles 14:5**

and Ibaar and Elisae and Eliphalet,

**1 Chronicles 14:6**

and Nage and Naphag and Ianouou,

**1 Chronicles 14:7**

and Elisamae and Balegdae and Eliphalet.

**1 Chronicles 14:8**

And Philistines heard that Dauid had been anointed king over all Israel, and all Philistines went up to seek Dauid, and Dauid heard and went out to meet them.

**1 Chronicles 14:9**

And Philistines came and fell upon valley of giants.

**1 Chronicles 14:10**

And Dauid inquired through God, saying, Shall I go up against Philistines, and will you give them into my hands? And Lord said to him, Go up, and I will give them into your hands.

**1 Chronicles 14:11**

And he went up to Baalpharasin, and Dauid struck them there. And Dauid said, God broke through my enemies by my hand like breaking of waters. Therefore name of that place was called Breach-of-Pharasin.

**1 Chronicles 14:12**

And they left their gods there, and Dauid said to burn them with fire.

**1 Chronicles 14:13**

And Philistines added yet again and again fell upon valley of giants.

**1 Chronicles 14:14**

And Dauid again inquired of God, and God said to him, You shall not go after them; turn away from them and come upon them near pear trees.

**1 Chronicles 14:15**

And when you hear sound of shaking in tops of pear trees, then you shall go out into battle, because God has gone out before you to strike camp of Philistines.

**1 Chronicles 14:16**

And he did as God commanded him, and he struck camp of Philistines from Gabaon as far as Gazara.

**1 Chronicles 14:17**

And name of Dauid became in all land, and Lord put his fear upon all nations.

### Chapter 15

**1 Chronicles 15:1**

And he made houses for himself in City of Dauid, and he prepared place for ark of God and made tent for it.

**1 Chronicles 15:2**

Then Dauid said, It is not for any to carry ark of God except Levites, because Lord chose them to carry ark of Lord and to minister to him forever.

**1 Chronicles 15:3**

And Dauid assembled all Israel in Ierousalem to bring up ark of Lord to place which he prepared for it.

**1 Chronicles 15:4**

And Dauid gathered sons of Aaron and Levites:

**1 Chronicles 15:5**

from sons of Kaath, Ouriēl chief, and his brothers, one hundred twenty;

**1 Chronicles 15:6**

from sons of Merari, Asaia chief, and his brothers, two hundred fifty;

**1 Chronicles 15:7**

from sons of Gērsam, Ioēl chief, and his brothers, one hundred fifty;

**1 Chronicles 15:8**

from sons of Elisaphan, Samaias chief, and his brothers, two hundred;

**1 Chronicles 15:9**

from sons of Chebron, Eliēl chief, and his brothers, eighty;

**1 Chronicles 15:10**

from sons of Oziēl, Aminadab chief, and his brothers, one hundred twelve.

**1 Chronicles 15:11**

And Dauid called Sadok and Abiathar the priests, and Levites Ouriēl, Asaia, Ioēl, Samaian, Eliēl, Aminadab,

**1 Chronicles 15:12**

and he said to them, You are chiefs of fathers of Levites. Sanctify yourselves, you and your brothers, and bring up ark of God of Israel, which I prepared for it.

**1 Chronicles 15:13**

Because when you were not there at first, our God made breach among us, because we did not seek him according to ordinance.

**1 Chronicles 15:14**

And priests and Levites sanctified themselves to bring up ark of God of Israel.

**1 Chronicles 15:15**

And sons of Levites took ark of God as Moyses commanded by word of God, according to writing, with carrying-poles upon them.

**1 Chronicles 15:16**

And Dauid said to chiefs of Levites, Station their brothers, singers with instruments of songs, lyres and harps and cymbals, to raise sound with voice of gladness.

**1 Chronicles 15:17**

And Levites stationed Haiman son of Ioēl, and from his brothers Asaph son of Barachia, and from sons of Merari, their brothers, Aithan son of Kisaiou,

**1 Chronicles 15:18**

and with them their brothers of second rank: Zacharias and Oziēl and Semiramoth and Iiēl and Ouni and Eliab and Banaia and Maasaia and Mattathia and Eliphalia and Makenia and Abdedom and Iiēl and Ozias, gatekeepers.

**1 Chronicles 15:19**

And singers Haiman, Asaph, and Aithan had bronze cymbals to make sound heard.

**1 Chronicles 15:20**

Zacharias and Oziēl, Semiramoth, Iiēl, Ouni, Eliab, Masaias, Banaias, with harps on alamoth.

**1 Chronicles 15:21**

And Mattathias and Eliphalias and Makenias and Abdedom and Iiēl and Ozias with lyres on the eighth, to lead strongly.

**1 Chronicles 15:22**

And Chonenia, chief of Levites, was chief over songs, because he was understanding.

**1 Chronicles 15:23**

And Barachia and Ēlkana were gatekeepers of ark.

**1 Chronicles 15:24**

And Sobnia and Iosaphat and Nathanaēl and Amasai and Zacharia and Banai and Eliezer, the priests, were blowing trumpets before ark of God, and Abdedom and Iia were gatekeepers of ark of God.

**1 Chronicles 15:25**

And Dauid and elders of Israel and commanders of thousands were going to bring up ark of covenant of Lord from house of Abdedom with gladness.

**1 Chronicles 15:26**

And it came to pass, when God strengthened Levites carrying ark of covenant of Lord, they sacrificed seven calves and seven rams.

**1 Chronicles 15:27**

And Dauid was girded with linen robe, and all Levites carrying ark of covenant of Lord, and singers, and Chonenia chief of songs of singers; and upon Dauid was linen robe.

**1 Chronicles 15:28**

And all Israel were bringing up ark of covenant of Lord with signal and sound of shophar and with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.

**1 Chronicles 15:29**

And it came to pass, ark of covenant of Lord came as far as City of Dauid, and Melchol daughter of Saul looked through window and saw king Dauid dancing and playing, and she despised him in her soul.

### Chapter 16

**1 Chronicles 16:1**

And they brought in ark of God and set it in middle of tent which Dauid pitched for it, and they offered whole burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

**1 Chronicles 16:2**

And Dauid finished offering whole burnt offerings and peace offerings and blessed people in name of Lord.

**1 Chronicles 16:3**

And he distributed to every man of Israel, from man to woman, to each man one loaf of bread, one bakery-cake, and one raisin-cake.

**1 Chronicles 16:4**

And he appointed before ark of covenant of Lord from Levites, ministers proclaiming aloud and giving thanks and praising Lord God of Israel:

**1 Chronicles 16:5**

Asaph leader, and second to him Zacharias, Iiēl, Semiramoth, Iiēl, Mattathias, Eliab, and Banaias and Abdedom and Iiēl with instruments, harps and lyres, and Asaph sounding aloud with cymbals,

**1 Chronicles 16:6**

and Banaias and Oziēl the priests with trumpets continually before ark of covenant of God.

**1 Chronicles 16:7**

On that day then Dauid first appointed by hand of Asaph and his brothers to praise Lord.

**1 Chronicles 16:8**

Give thanks to Lord; call upon him in his name; make known among peoples his practices.

**1 Chronicles 16:9**

Sing to him and hymn to him; tell all his wonders, those things Lord did.

**1 Chronicles 16:10**

Praise in his holy name; heart seeking his good pleasure shall rejoice.

**1 Chronicles 16:11**

Seek Lord and grow strong; seek his face continually.

**1 Chronicles 16:12**

Remember his wonders which he did, his marvels and judgments of his mouth,

**1 Chronicles 16:13**

seed of Israel, his servants, sons of Iakob, his chosen ones.

**1 Chronicles 16:14**

He is Lord our God; in all earth are his judgments.

**1 Chronicles 16:15**

Remembering forever his covenant, his word which he commanded for thousand generations,

**1 Chronicles 16:16**

which he covenanted with Abraam, and his oath to Isaak,

**1 Chronicles 16:17**

and he set it for Iakob as ordinance, for Israel as everlasting covenant,

**1 Chronicles 16:18**

saying, To you I will give land of Chanaan, measuring-line of your inheritance.

**1 Chronicles 16:19**

When they were few in number, as they were diminished and sojourned in it,

**1 Chronicles 16:20**

and they went from nation to nation and from kingdom to another people,

**1 Chronicles 16:21**

he did not let man oppress them, and he rebuked kings concerning them:

**1 Chronicles 16:22**

Do not touch my anointed ones, and do not do evil among my prophets.

**1 Chronicles 16:23**

Sing to Lord, all earth; announce his salvation from day to day.

**1 Chronicles 16:25**

For Lord is great and greatly praised; he is fearful above all gods.

**1 Chronicles 16:26**

For all gods of nations are idols, but our God made heaven.

**1 Chronicles 16:27**

Glory and praise are before him; strength and boasting are in his place.

**1 Chronicles 16:28**

Give to Lord, families of nations; give to Lord glory and strength.

**1 Chronicles 16:29**

Give to Lord glory of his name; take gifts and bring them before him, and worship Lord in his holy courts.

**1 Chronicles 16:30**

Let all earth fear from before him; let earth be set right and not be shaken.

**1 Chronicles 16:31**

Let heaven rejoice and earth exult, and let them say among nations, Lord reigns.

**1 Chronicles 16:32**

Sea shall thunder with its fullness, and tree of field and all things in it.

**1 Chronicles 16:33**

Then trees of forest shall rejoice from before Lord, because he came to judge earth.

**1 Chronicles 16:34**

Give thanks to Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.

**1 Chronicles 16:35**

And say, Save us, God of our salvation, and deliver us from nations, to praise your holy name and to boast in your praises.

**1 Chronicles 16:36**

Blessed Lord God of Israel from age and unto age. And all people shall say, Amen, and they praised Lord.

**1 Chronicles 16:37**

And they left there before ark of covenant of Lord Asaph and his brothers to minister before ark continually, each day’s matter for its day,

**1 Chronicles 16:38**

and Abdedom and his brothers, sixty-eight, and Abdedom son of Idithon and Ossa as gatekeepers,

**1 Chronicles 16:39**

and Sadok the priest and his brothers the priests before tent of Lord at high place in Gabaon,

**1 Chronicles 16:40**

to offer whole burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of whole burnt offerings continually, morning and evening, and according to all things written in the law of the Lord, whatever he commanded for the sons of Israel by the hand of Moyses servant of God,

**1 Chronicles 16:41**

and with him Haiman and Idithon and rest of chosen ones named by name to praise Lord, because his mercy is forever,

**1 Chronicles 16:42**

and with them trumpets and cymbals for sounding aloud, and instruments of songs of God; sons of Idithon were at gate.

**1 Chronicles 16:43**

And all people went each to his house, and Dauid returned to bless his house.

### Chapter 17

**1 Chronicles 17:1**

And it came to pass, as Dauid settled in his house, Dauid said to Nathan prophet, Behold, I dwell in cedar house, but ark of covenant of Lord is under curtains.

**1 Chronicles 17:2**

And Nathan said to Dauid, Do all that is in your soul, because God is with you.

**1 Chronicles 17:3**

And it came to pass in that night, word of Lord came to Nathan, saying,

**1 Chronicles 17:4**

Go and speak to Dauid my servant, Thus says Lord, You shall not build me house for me to dwell in it.

**1 Chronicles 17:5**

Because I have not dwelt in house from day when I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been in tent and in dwelling-place.

**1 Chronicles 17:6**

In all places where I went through among all Israel, did I ever speak to one tribe of Israel, to shepherd my people, saying, Why have you not built me cedar house?

**1 Chronicles 17:7**

And now thus you shall say to my servant Dauid, Thus says Lord Almighty, I took you from fold, from behind sheep, to be ruler over my people Israel.

**1 Chronicles 17:8**

And I was with you in all places where you went, and I destroyed all your enemies from before you, and I made for you name like name of great ones on earth.

**1 Chronicles 17:9**

And I will appoint place for my people Israel and plant him, and he shall dwell by himself and not be anxious anymore, and unrighteousness shall not again afflict him as from beginning,

**1 Chronicles 17:10**

and from days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I humbled all your enemies, and I will increase you, and Lord will build house for you.

**1 Chronicles 17:11**

And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who shall be from your belly, and I will prepare his kingdom.

**1 Chronicles 17:12**

He shall build me house, and I will set upright his throne forever.

**1 Chronicles 17:13**

I will be to him for father, and he shall be to me for son, and I will not remove my mercy from him, as I removed it from those before you.

**1 Chronicles 17:14**

And I will make him faithful in my house and in his kingdom forever, and his throne shall stand upright forever.

**1 Chronicles 17:15**

According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 17:16**

And king Dauid came and sat before Lord and said, Who am I, Lord God, and what is my house, that you loved me unto forever?

**1 Chronicles 17:17**

And these things were made small before you, O God, and you spoke concerning house of your servant for long distance, and you looked upon me as vision of man, and you exalted me, Lord God.

**1 Chronicles 17:18**

What more shall Dauid add to you to glorify? And you know your servant.

**1 Chronicles 17:19**

And according to your heart you did all this greatness.

**1 Chronicles 17:20**

Lord, there is none like you, and there is none besides you, according to all things we heard with our ears.

**1 Chronicles 17:21**

And there is no nation on earth like your people Israel, whom God led to redeem for himself as people, to make for himself great and manifest name, to drive out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt.

**1 Chronicles 17:22**

And you gave your people Israel to yourself as people forever, and you, Lord, became God to them.

**1 Chronicles 17:23**

And now, Lord, let your word which you spoke concerning your servant and concerning his house be made faithful forever.

**1 Chronicles 17:24**

Let them say, Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel, and let house of Dauid your servant be established before you.

**1 Chronicles 17:25**

Because you, Lord, opened ear of your servant to build him house. Therefore your servant found courage to pray before you.

**1 Chronicles 17:26**

And now, Lord, you are that God, and you spoke these good things concerning your servant.

**1 Chronicles 17:27**

And now you began to bless house of your servant, that it may be forever before you, because you, Lord, blessed; bless forever.

### Chapter 18

**1 Chronicles 18:1**

And it came to pass after these things, Dauid struck Philistines and routed them, and he took Geth and its villages from hand of Philistines.

**1 Chronicles 18:2**

And he struck Moab, and Moab became servants to Dauid, bringing gifts.

**1 Chronicles 18:3**

And Dauid struck Adraazar king of Souba Hamath, as he was going to set his hand upon river Euphrates.

**1 Chronicles 18:4**

And Dauid captured from them one thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand footmen, and Dauid hamstrung all chariots, but left of them one hundred chariots.

**1 Chronicles 18:5**

And Syrian from Damascus came to help Adraazar king of Souba, and Dauid struck among Syrians twenty-two thousand men.

**1 Chronicles 18:6**

And Dauid put garrison in Syria by Damascus, and they became servants to Dauid, bringing gifts, and Lord kept saving Dauid in all places he went.

**1 Chronicles 18:7**

And Dauid took golden armlets which were on servants of Adraazar and brought them to Ierousalem.

**1 Chronicles 18:8**

And from Metabēchas and from chosen cities of Adraazar, Dauid took very much bronze. From it Salomon made bronze sea and pillars and bronze vessels.

**1 Chronicles 18:9**

And Thōa king of Hamath heard that Dauid struck all force of Adraazar king of Souba.

**1 Chronicles 18:10**

And he sent Idouram his son to king Dauid to ask about peace and to bless him because he fought Adraazar and struck him, because Adraazar was man of war against Thōa, with every silver and gold vessel.

**1 Chronicles 18:11**

These also king Dauid consecrated to Lord, with silver and gold which he took from all nations, from Idoumaia and Moab and sons of Ammon and Philistines and Amalek.

**1 Chronicles 18:12**

And Abessa son of Sarouia struck Idoumaia in valley of salt pits, eighteen thousand.

**1 Chronicles 18:13**

And he put garrisons in valley, and all Idoumaians became servants of Dauid, and Lord kept saving Dauid in all places he went.

**1 Chronicles 18:14**

And Dauid reigned over all Israel, and he was doing judgment and righteousness for all his people.

**1 Chronicles 18:15**

And Ioab son of Sarouia was over army, and Iosaphat son of Achiloud was recorder,

**1 Chronicles 18:16**

and Sadok son of Achitob and Achimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Sousa was scribe,

**1 Chronicles 18:17**

and Banaias son of Iodae was over Chereththite and Pheleththite, and sons of Dauid were first successors of king.

### Chapter 19

**1 Chronicles 19:1**

And it came to pass after these things, Naas king of sons of Ammon died, and Anan his son reigned in his place.

**1 Chronicles 19:2**

And Dauid said, I will do mercy with Anan son of Naas, as his father did mercy with me. And Dauid sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And servants of Dauid came into land of sons of Ammon to comfort him.

**1 Chronicles 19:3**

And rulers of Ammon said to Anan, Does Dauid honor your father before you because he sent comforters to you? Did not his servants come to you to search city and spy out land?

**1 Chronicles 19:4**

And Anan took servants of Dauid and shaved them and cut away half their cloaks as far as garment and sent them away.

**1 Chronicles 19:5**

And men came to report to Dauid concerning men, and he sent to meet them, because men had been greatly dishonored. And king said, Sit in Iericho until your beards grow, and then return.

**1 Chronicles 19:6**

And sons of Ammon saw that people of Dauid had been shamed, and Anan and sons of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Syria of Mesopotamia and from Syria of Moocha and from Souba.

**1 Chronicles 19:7**

And they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots and king of Moocha and his people, and they came and camped opposite Maidaba. And sons of Ammon gathered from their cities and came to battle.

**1 Chronicles 19:8**

And Dauid heard and sent Ioab and all army of mighty men.

**1 Chronicles 19:9**

And sons of Ammon came out and drew up for battle by gate of city, and kings who came camped by themselves in plain.

**1 Chronicles 19:10**

And Ioab saw that front of battle had come against him before and behind, and he chose from every young man of Israel, and they drew up against Syrians.

**1 Chronicles 19:11**

And rest of people he gave into hand of Abessa his brother, and they drew up opposite sons of Ammon.

**1 Chronicles 19:12**

And he said, If Syrians prevail over me, you shall be for salvation to me, and if sons of Ammon prevail over you, I will save you.

**1 Chronicles 19:13**

Act like man, and let us strengthen ourselves for our people and for cities of our God, and Lord will do what is good in his eyes.

**1 Chronicles 19:14**

And Ioab drew up, and people with him, opposite Syrians for battle, and they fled from him.

**1 Chronicles 19:15**

And sons of Ammon saw that Syrians fled, and they too fled from before Ioab and from before Abessa his brother and came into city. And Ioab came to Ierousalem.

**1 Chronicles 19:16**

And Syria saw that Israel routed him, and they sent messengers and brought out Syrians from beyond river, with Sophach commander of force of Adraazar before them.

**1 Chronicles 19:17**

And it was reported to Dauid, and he gathered all Israel and crossed Jordan and came against them and drew up against them. And Syria drew up opposite Dauid and fought him.

**1 Chronicles 19:18**

And Syria fled from before Dauid, and Dauid killed from Syria seven thousand chariots and forty thousand footmen, and he killed Sophach commander of force.

**1 Chronicles 19:19**

And servants of Adraazar saw that they had fallen before Israel, and they made covenant with Dauid and served him. And Syria did not want to help sons of Ammon anymore.

### Chapter 20

**1 Chronicles 20:1**

And it came to pass in following year, at time when kings go out, Ioab led all force of army and ruined land of sons of Ammon and came and besieged Rabbah, while Dauid stayed in Ierousalem. And Ioab struck Rabbah and tore it down.

**1 Chronicles 20:2**

And Dauid took crown of Molchol their king from his head, and its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and in it was precious stone, and it was upon head of Dauid. And he brought out spoils of city very many.

**1 Chronicles 20:3**

And people in it he brought out and cut with saws and with iron picks, and thus Dauid did to all sons of Ammon. And Dauid and all his people returned to Ierousalem.

**1 Chronicles 20:4**

And it came to pass after these things, there was still war in Gazer with Philistines. Then Sobochai the Ousathite struck Saphou from sons of giants, and he humbled him.

**1 Chronicles 20:5**

And there was yet war with Philistines, and Ellanan son of Iair struck Leemi brother of Goliath the Geththite, and wood of his spear was like beam of weavers.

**1 Chronicles 20:6**

And there was still war in Geth, and there was oversized man, and his fingers were six and six, twenty-four, and he was descendant of giants.

**1 Chronicles 20:7**

And he reproached Israel, and Ionathan son of Samaa brother of Dauid struck him.

**1 Chronicles 20:8**

These were born to Rapha in Geth; all were four giants, and they fell by hand of Dauid and by hand of his servants.

### Chapter 21

**1 Chronicles 21:1**

And slanderer stood up against Israel and stirred Dauid to number Israel.

**1 Chronicles 21:2**

And king Dauid said to Ioab and to chiefs of force, Go, number Israel from Bersabee to Dan, and bring to me, and I shall know their number.

**1 Chronicles 21:3**

And Ioab said, May Lord add to his people a hundredfold as they are, and are not eyes of my lord the king seeing that all are servants to my lord? Why does my lord seek this, so that it should not become sin for Israel?

**1 Chronicles 21:4**

But word of king prevailed over Ioab. And Ioab went out and passed through all border of Israel and came to Ierousalem.

**1 Chronicles 21:5**

And Ioab gave number of mustering of people to Dauid, and all Israel was one million one hundred thousand men drawing sword, and Iouda was four hundred eighty thousand men drawing sword.

**1 Chronicles 21:6**

But Levi and Beniamin he did not count among them, because word of king overpowered Ioab.

**1 Chronicles 21:7**

And thing appeared evil before God concerning this matter, and he struck Israel.

**1 Chronicles 21:8**

And Dauid said to God, I sinned greatly because I did this thing, and now please take away evil of your servant, because I acted very foolishly.

**1 Chronicles 21:9**

And Lord spoke to Gad, seer of Dauid, saying,

**1 Chronicles 21:10**

Go and speak to Dauid, saying, Thus says Lord, I lift three things upon you; choose one of them for yourself, and I will do it to you.

**1 Chronicles 21:11**

And Gad came to Dauid and said to him, Thus says Lord, Choose for yourself:

**1 Chronicles 21:12**

either three years of famine, or three months for you to flee from before your enemies while sword of your enemies destroys, or three days sword of Lord and death in land, and angel of Lord destroying in all inheritance of Israel. And now see what word I should answer to one who sent me.

**1 Chronicles 21:13**

And Dauid said to Gad, All three press me very hard. Let me now fall into hands of Lord, because his mercies are very many; but into hands of men I shall not fall.

**1 Chronicles 21:14**

And Lord gave death in Israel, and seventy thousand men fell from Israel.

**1 Chronicles 21:15**

And God sent angel into Ierousalem to destroy it, and as he destroyed, Lord saw and relented over evil and said to angel destroying, It is enough for you; let go your hand. And angel of Lord was standing at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite.

**1 Chronicles 21:16**

And Dauid lifted his eyes and saw angel of Lord standing between earth and between heaven, with his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Ierousalem. And Dauid and elders clothed in sackcloth fell on their faces.

**1 Chronicles 21:17**

And Dauid said to God, Was it not I who said to number among people? And I am one who sinned; I acted evilly with evil. But these sheep, what did they do? Lord God, let your hand be on me and on house of my father, and not on your people for destruction, Lord.

**1 Chronicles 21:18**

And angel of Lord said to Gad to tell Dauid to go up and set altar to Lord at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite.

**1 Chronicles 21:19**

And Dauid went up according to word of Gad, which he spoke in name of Lord.

**1 Chronicles 21:20**

And Orna turned and saw king, and his four sons with him were hiding themselves, and Orna was threshing wheat.

**1 Chronicles 21:21**

And Dauid came to Orna, and Orna came out from threshing floor and bowed to Dauid with face to ground.

**1 Chronicles 21:22**

And Dauid said to Orna, Give me place of your threshing floor, and I will build on it altar to Lord. For silver at full worth give it to me, and plague will stop from people.

**1 Chronicles 21:23**

And Orna said to Dauid, Take for yourself, and let my lord the king do good in his sight. Behold, I have given calves for whole burnt offering, and plow and wagons for wood, and wheat for sacrifice; I have given all.

**1 Chronicles 21:24**

And king Dauid said to Orna, No, because by buying I will buy for full worth in silver, because I shall not take what is yours for Lord, to offer free whole burnt offering to Lord.

**1 Chronicles 21:25**

And Dauid gave to Orna in his place six hundred shekels of weight in gold.

**1 Chronicles 21:26**

And Dauid built there altar to Lord and offered whole burnt offerings and peace offerings, and cried out to Lord, and he answered him with fire from heaven upon altar of whole burnt offering and consumed whole burnt offering.

**1 Chronicles 21:27**

And Lord spoke to angel, and he put sword into sheath.

**1 Chronicles 21:28**

At that time, when Dauid saw that Lord answered him at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite, he sacrificed there.

**1 Chronicles 21:29**

And tent of Lord which Moyses made in wilderness, and altar of whole burnt offerings, were at that time at high place in Gabaon.

**1 Chronicles 21:30**

And Dauid was not able to go before it to seek God, because he hurried in fear from before sword of angel of Lord.

### Chapter 22

**1 Chronicles 22:1**

And Dauid said, This is house of Lord God, and this is altar for whole burnt offering for Israel.

**1 Chronicles 22:2**

**1 Chronicles 22:3**

And Dauid prepared much iron for nails of doors and gates and hinges, and bronze in abundance without weight,

**1 Chronicles 22:4**

and cedar woods without number, because Sidonians and Tyrians brought cedar woods in abundance to Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 22:5**

And Dauid said, Salomon my son is tender youth, and house to build for Lord must be for greatness beyond, for name and for glory in all earth; I will prepare for him. And Dauid prepared in abundance before his death.

**1 Chronicles 22:6**

And he called Salomon his son and charged him to build house to Lord God of Israel.

**1 Chronicles 22:7**

And Dauid said, Salomon, my child, it was upon my heart to build a house for name of Lord God,

**1 Chronicles 22:8**

but word of Lord came upon me, saying, You poured out blood in abundance and made great wars; you shall not build house to my name, because you poured out much blood on earth before me.

**1 Chronicles 22:9**

Behold, son is born to you. He shall be man of rest, and I will give him rest from all enemies around, because Salomon shall be his name, and peace and quietness I will give upon Israel in his days.

**1 Chronicles 22:10**

He shall build house to my name, and he shall be to me for son, and I to him for father, and I will set upright throne of his kingdom in Israel forever.

**1 Chronicles 22:11**

And now, my son, Lord shall be with you and prosper you, and you shall build house to Lord your God as he spoke concerning you.

**1 Chronicles 22:12**

Only may Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and strengthen you over Israel, to keep and to do law of Lord your God.

**1 Chronicles 22:13**

Then you shall prosper if you keep doing ordinances and judgments which Lord commanded Moyses for Israel. Act like man and be strong; do not fear and do not be dismayed.

**1 Chronicles 22:14**

And behold, in my poverty I prepared for house of Lord one hundred thousand talents of gold and one thousand thousand talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight, because it is in abundance, and wood and stones I prepared, and to these add more.

**1 Chronicles 22:15**

And with you are workers in abundance, craftsmen and builders of stone and carpenters of wood and every wise man in every work,

**1 Chronicles 22:16**

**1 Chronicles 22:17**

And Dauid commanded all rulers of Israel to help Salomon his son:

**1 Chronicles 22:18**

Is not Lord with you and has he not given you rest all around? Because he gave inhabitants of land into hands, and land is subdued before Lord and before his people.

**1 Chronicles 22:19**

Now set your hearts and your souls to seek the Lord your God, and rise and build a sanctuary to the Lord your God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy vessels of God into the house being built for the name of the Lord.

**1 Chronicles 23:1**

**1 Chronicles 23:26**

**1 Chronicles 23:31**

**1 Chronicles 23:32**

Twelfth for twelfth month, Choldai the Netouphathi for Gothoniēl, and over his division twenty-four thousand.

And over tribes of Israel: for Reuben, leader Eliezer son of Zechri; for Symeon, Saphatias son of Maacha;

**1 Chronicles 27:17**

for Levi, Asabias son of Kamouēl; for Aaron, Sadok;

**1 Chronicles 27:18**

for Iouda, Eliab from brothers of Dauid; for Issachar, Ambri son of Michaēl;

**1 Chronicles 27:19**

for Zabulon, Samaias son of Abdiou; for Nephthali, Ierimōth son of Esriēl;

**1 Chronicles 27:20**

for Ephraim, Ōsē son of Oziou; for half tribe of Manasse, Ioēl son of Phadaia;

**1 Chronicles 27:21**

for half tribe of Manasse in Galaad, Iaddai son of Zabdiou; for sons of Beniamin, Asiēl son of Abennēr;

**1 Chronicles 27:22**

for Dan, Azaraiēl son of Iōram. These were patriarchs of tribes of Israel.

**1 Chronicles 27:23**

And Dauid did not take their number from twenty years and under, because Lord said to multiply Israel like stars of heaven.

**1 Chronicles 27:24**

And Ioab son of Sarouia began numbering among people and did not finish, and because of these things wrath came upon Israel, and number was not entered in book of matters of days of king Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 27:25**

And over king’s treasuries was Asmōth son of Ōdiēl, and over treasuries in field and in villages and in settlements and in towers was Ionathan son of Oziou.

**1 Chronicles 27:26**

And over those farming ground, those working soil, was Esdri son of Choloub.

**1 Chronicles 27:27**

And over vineyards was Semei from Rama, and over treasuries in vineyards of wine was Zachri son of Sephni.

**1 Chronicles 27:28**

And over olive groves and sycamines in lowland was Balanas the Gedōrite, and over treasuries of oil was Iōas.

**1 Chronicles 27:29**

And over cattle feeding in Asidōn was Satrais the Sarōnite, and over cattle in farmyards was Sōphat son of Adli.

**1 Chronicles 27:30**

And over camels was Ōbil the Ismaēlite, and over donkeys was Iadias from Merathōn.

**1 Chronicles 27:31**

And over sheep was Iaziz the Hagarite. All these were stewards of possessions of king Dauid.

**1 Chronicles 27:32**

And Ionathan, Dauid’s uncle, was counselor, understanding man and scribe, and Iiēl son of Achamani was with sons of king.

**1 Chronicles 27:33**

And Achitophel was counselor of king, and Chousi was first friend of king.

**1 Chronicles 27:34**

And after him: Achitophel, then Iōdae son of Banaiou and Abiathar, and Ioab commander-in-chief of king.

### Chapter 28

**1 Chronicles 28:1**

And Dauid assembled all rulers of Israel, rulers of judges and rulers of courses around body of king and rulers of thousands and of hundreds and treasurers and those over his possessions and mighty lords and fighters of army, in Ierousalem.

**1 Chronicles 28:2**

And Dauid stood in midst of assembly and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. It came upon my heart to build house of rest for ark of covenant of Lord and footstool of our Lord, and I prepared fitting things for dwelling.

**1 Chronicles 28:3**

But God said, You shall not build me a house to have my name called upon it, because you are man of war and have poured out blood.

**1 Chronicles 28:4**

And Lord God of Israel chose me from all house of my father to be king over Israel forever, and in Iouda he chose kingdom, and from house of Iouda house of my father, and among sons of my father he desired in me to make me king over all Israel.

**1 Chronicles 28:5**

And from all my sons, because Lord gave me many sons, he chose in Salomon my son to seat him upon throne of kingdom of Lord over Israel.

**1 Chronicles 28:6**

And God said to me, Salomon your son shall build my house and my court, because I chose him to be son to me, and I will be father to him.

**1 Chronicles 28:7**

And I will set his kingdom right forever, if he is strong to keep my commandments and my judgments, as this day.

**1 Chronicles 28:8**

And now, before all assembly of Lord and in ears of our God, keep and seek all commandments of Lord our God, so that you may inherit good land and leave inheritance to your sons after you forever.

**1 Chronicles 28:9**

And now, Salomon my son, know God of your fathers and serve him with complete heart and willing soul, because Lord examines all hearts and knows every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; and if you forsake him, he will forsake you to end.

**1 Chronicles 28:10**

See now, because Lord chose you to build him house for sanctuary. Be strong and do.

**1 Chronicles 28:11**

And Dauid gave to Salomon his son pattern of temple and of its houses and its treasuries and upper rooms and inner storehouses and house of propitiation,

**1 Chronicles 28:12**

and pattern which he had in his spirit of courts of house of Lord and all storerooms around, for treasuries of house of Lord and treasuries of holy things,

**1 Chronicles 28:13**

and of chambers of courses of priests and Levites, for every work of service of house of Lord and of storehouses of vessels of service of worship of house of Lord,

**1 Chronicles 28:14**

and weight of their weighing, both of gold and silver things,

**1 Chronicles 28:15**

weight of lampstands and of lamps he gave him,

**1 Chronicles 28:16**

he likewise gave him weight of tables of presentation, each golden table, and likewise silver ones,

**1 Chronicles 28:17**

and for flesh-hooks and bowls and golden cups, and weight of gold and of silver for each kefphoure according to weight,

**1 Chronicles 28:18**

and for altar of incense, weight from refined gold he showed him, and pattern of chariot of cheroubim spreading wings and overshadowing ark of covenant of Lord.

**1 Chronicles 28:19**

All in writing of hand of Lord, Dauid gave to Salomon according to understanding given to him for working of pattern.

**1 Chronicles 28:20**

And Dauid said to Salomon his son, Be strong and act like man and do. Do not fear and do not be dismayed, because Lord my God is with you. He will not let go of you and will not forsake you until you finish every work of service of house of Lord.

**1 Chronicles 28:21**

And behold, courses of priests and Levites for every service of house of God are with you, and with you in every work are all willing men in wisdom for every craft, and rulers and all people for all your words.

### Chapter 29

**1 Chronicles 29:1**

And king Dauid said to all assembly, Salomon my son, in whom alone Lord chose, is young and tender, and work is great, because building not for man but for Lord God.

**1 Chronicles 29:2**

With all my strength I prepared for house of my God gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, shoham stones and filling stones and precious stones and varied stones and every precious stone and much Parian stone.

**1 Chronicles 29:3**

And still, because I delighted in house of my God, I have gold and silver which I kept for myself, and behold, I gave it for house of my God in addition to what I prepared for house of holy things,

**1 Chronicles 29:4**

three thousand talents of gold from Souphir and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay walls of sanctuary with them,

**1 Chronicles 29:5**

by hand of craftsmen. And who is willing to fill his hands for Lord today?

**1 Chronicles 29:6**

And chiefs of fathers and rulers of sons of Israel and commanders of thousands and of hundreds and leaders of works and stewards of king were made willing.

**1 Chronicles 29:7**

And they gave for works of house of Lord five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand gold pieces, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

**1 Chronicles 29:8**

And those with whom stone was found gave it to treasuries of house of Lord by hand of Iiēl the Gērsōnite.

**1 Chronicles 29:9**

And people rejoiced over their willingness, because with full heart they were made willing to Lord, and king Dauid rejoiced greatly.

**1 Chronicles 29:10**

And king Dauid blessed Lord before assembly, saying, Blessed are you, Lord God of Israel our father, from age and unto age.

**1 Chronicles 29:11**

Yours, Lord, are greatness and power and boasting and victory and strength, because you rule all things in heaven and on earth; before your face every king and nation is troubled.

**1 Chronicles 29:12**

From you are riches and glory; you rule all things, Lord, ruler of every beginning, and in your hand are strength and lordship, and in your hand, Almighty One, to magnify and strengthen all things.

**1 Chronicles 29:13**

And now, Lord, we give thanks to you and praise name of your boasting.

**1 Chronicles 29:14**

And who am I, and who are my people, that we grew strong to be willing to you in this way? Because all things are yours, and from your things we gave to you.

**1 Chronicles 29:15**

Because we are sojourners before you and temporary residents, as all our fathers were. Our days on earth are like shadow, and there is no staying.

**1 Chronicles 29:16**

Lord our God, all this abundance which I prepared to build house for your holy name is from your hand, and all things are yours.

**1 Chronicles 29:17**

And I knew, Lord, that you examine hearts and love righteousness. In simplicity of heart I was willing for all these things, and now I saw your people found here willingly giving to you with gladness.

**1 Chronicles 29:18**

Lord God of Abraam and Isaak and Israel our fathers, keep these things in thought of heart of your people forever, and direct their hearts toward you.

**1 Chronicles 29:19**

And to Salomon my son give good heart to do your commandments and your testimonies and your ordinances, and to bring building of your house to completion.

**1 Chronicles 29:20**

And Dauid said to all assembly, Bless Lord your God. And all assembly blessed Lord God of their fathers, and bowing knees they worshiped Lord and king.

**1 Chronicles 29:21**

And Dauid sacrificed sacrifices to Lord and offered whole burnt offerings to God on next day after first day: one thousand calves, one thousand rams, one thousand lambs, and their libations, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

**1 Chronicles 29:22**

And they ate and drank before Lord on that day with joy, and they made Salomon son of Dauid king a second time, and anointed him to Lord as king and Sadok to priesthood.

**1 Chronicles 29:23**

And Salomon sat on throne of Dauid his father and prospered, and all Israel listened to him.

**1 Chronicles 29:24**

Rulers and mighty lords and all sons of king Dauid his father submitted to him.

**1 Chronicles 29:25**

And Lord magnified Salomon exceedingly before all Israel and gave him royal glory such as did not happen on any king before him.

**1 Chronicles 29:26**

And Dauid son of Iessai reigned over Israel.

**1 Chronicles 29:27**

Forty years: in Chebron seven years and in Ierousalem thirty-three years.

**1 Chronicles 29:28**

And he died in good old age, full of days, riches, and glory, and Salomon his son reigned in his place.

**1 Chronicles 29:29**

And rest of matters of king Dauid, first and last, are written in words of Samuel seer and in words of Nathan prophet and in words of Gad seer,

**1 Chronicles 29:30**

concerning all his kingdom and his mighty rule and times which came upon him and upon Israel and upon all kingdoms of earth.

## 2 Chronicles

### Chapter 1

**2 Chronicles 1:1**

And Salomon son of Dauid was strengthened over his kingdom, and Lord his God was with him and magnified him on high.

**2 Chronicles 1:2**

And Salomon spoke to all Israel, to commanders of thousands and of hundreds and to judges and to all rulers before Israel, to chiefs of fathers.

**2 Chronicles 1:3**

And Salomon and all assembly with him went to high place in Gabaon, because there was tent of testimony of God which Moyses servant of Lord made in wilderness.

**2 Chronicles 1:4**

But Dauid brought up ark of God from city Kariathiarim, because he prepared tent for it in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 1:5**

And bronze altar which Beseleēl son of Ourios son of Ōr made was there before tent of Lord, and Salomon and assembly sought it.

**2 Chronicles 1:6**

And there Salomon brought up upon bronze altar before Lord, the one in tent, and brought up upon it one thousand whole burnt offerings.

**2 Chronicles 1:7**

In that night God appeared to Salomon and said to him, Ask what I should give you.

**2 Chronicles 1:8**

And Salomon said to God, You did great mercy with Dauid my father and made me king in his place.

**2 Chronicles 1:9**

And now, Lord God, let your name be made faithful upon Dauid my father, because you made me king over numerous people like dust of earth.

**2 Chronicles 1:10**

Now give me wisdom and understanding, and I shall go out before this people and come in, because who can judge this great people of yours?

**2 Chronicles 1:11**

And God said to Salomon, Because this came to be in your heart, and you did not ask wealth, riches, or glory, nor life of your adversaries, nor many days, but asked wisdom and understanding for yourself so that you may judge my people over whom I made you king,

**2 Chronicles 1:12**

wisdom and understanding I give to you, and wealth and riches and glory I will give to you such as none among kings before you had, and after you there shall not be thus.

**2 Chronicles 1:13**

And Salomon came from high place in Gabaon to Ierousalem, from before tent of testimony, and reigned over Israel.

**2 Chronicles 1:14**

And Salomon gathered chariots and horsemen, and he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he placed them in cities of chariots, and people were with king in Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 1:15**

And king made gold and silver in Ierousalem like stones, and cedars in Iouda like sycamines in lowland in abundance.

**2 Chronicles 1:16**

And export of horses for Salomon was from Egypt, and merchants of king were trading and buying at price.

**2 Chronicles 1:17**

And they were bringing up and bringing out from Egypt chariot for six hundred silver and horse for one hundred fifty, and thus for all kings of Chettites and kings of Syria they brought by their hands.

**2 Chronicles 1:18**

And Salomon spoke of building house to name of Lord and house for his kingdom.

### Chapter 2

**2 Chronicles 2:1**

And Salomon gathered seventy thousand men and eighty thousand stonecutters in mountain and three thousand six hundred overseers over them.

**2 Chronicles 2:2**

And Salomon sent to Chiram king of Tyre, saying, As you did with Dauid my father and sent him cedars to build house for himself to dwell in it,

**2 Chronicles 2:3**

behold, I his son am building house to name of Lord my God, to sanctify it to him, to burn incense of spices before him and perpetual presentation and to offer whole burnt offerings continually morning and evening and on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts of Lord our God. This is forever upon Israel.

**2 Chronicles 2:4**

And house which I am building is great, because our God is great above all gods.

**2 Chronicles 2:5**

And who will have strength to build him house? Because heaven and heaven of heavens do not bear his glory. And who am I building him house, except to burn incense before him?

**2 Chronicles 2:6**

And now send me wise man, one knowing how to work in gold and silver and bronze and iron and purple and scarlet and blue, and knowing how to carve carving, together with wise men with me in Iouda and in Ierousalem, whom Dauid my father prepared.

**2 Chronicles 2:7**

And send me cedar woods and juniper woods and pine woods from Lebanon, because I know your servants know how to cut woods from Lebanon, and behold, your servants are with my servants,

**2 Chronicles 2:8**

to prepare woods for me in abundance, because house which I am building is great and glorious.

**2 Chronicles 2:9**

And behold, for workers, those cutting woods for food, I gave grain to your servants, twenty thousand kors, and barley, twenty thousand kors, and wine, twenty thousand measures, and oil, twenty thousand measures.

**2 Chronicles 2:10**

And Chiram king of Tyre answered in writing and sent to Salomon, Because Lord loved his people, he gave you king over them.

**2 Chronicles 2:11**

And Chiram said, Blessed Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth, who gave to king Dauid wise son, knowing understanding and knowledge, who will build house to Lord and house for his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 2:12**

And now I have sent to you wise man, knowing understanding, Chiram my father,

**2 Chronicles 2:13**

whose mother was from daughters of Dan and whose father was Tyrian man, knowing how to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron, in stones and woods, and to weave in purple and in blue and in fine linen and in scarlet, and to carve carvings and devise every design whatever you give him, together with your wise men and wise men of Dauid my lord your father.

**2 Chronicles 2:14**

And now let my lord send to his servants grain and barley and oil and wine which my lord spoke of.

**2 Chronicles 2:15**

And we shall cut woods from Lebanon according to all your need, and we shall bring them on rafts by sea to Ioppē, and you shall bring them up to Ierousalem.

**2 Chronicles 2:16**

And Salomon gathered all sojourning men in land of Israel, after number by which Dauid his father numbered them, and they were found to be one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

**2 Chronicles 2:17**

And he made from them seventy thousand carriers of burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters and three thousand six hundred overseers over people.

### Chapter 3

**2 Chronicles 3:1**

And Salomon began building house of Lord in Ierousalem on mountain of Amoria, where Lord appeared to Dauid his father, in place which Dauid prepared at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite.

**2 Chronicles 3:2**

And he began building in second month, in fourth year of his reign.

**2 Chronicles 3:3**

And these are foundations which Salomon laid for building house of God: length by first measure, sixty cubits, and width twenty cubits.

**2 Chronicles 3:4**

And vestibule before house, length according to breadth of house, twenty cubits, and height one hundred twenty cubits, and he overlaid it inside with pure gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:5**

And great house he paneled with cedar woods and overlaid it with pure gold and carved upon it palms and chains.

**2 Chronicles 3:6**

And he adorned house with precious stones for glory, and with gold, gold from Pharouaim.

**2 Chronicles 3:7**

And he gilded house and walls and doorposts and ceilings and doors with gold, and carved cheroubim on walls.

**2 Chronicles 3:8**

And he made house of holy of holies, its length according to breadth, twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits, and he overlaid it with pure gold, for cheroubim, six hundred talents.

**2 Chronicles 3:9**

And weight of nails, weight of one, fifty shekels of gold, and upper rooms he gilded with gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:10**

And he made in house of holy of holies two cheroubim, work from woods, and gilded them with gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:11**

And wings of cheroubim were twenty cubits in length; one wing five cubits touching wall of house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.

**2 Chronicles 3:12**

And wing of one cheroub was five cubits touching wall of house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.

**2 Chronicles 3:13**

And wings of cheroubim spread out were twenty cubits, and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward house.

**2 Chronicles 3:14**

And he made veil of blue and purple and scarlet and fine linen, and wove cheroubim in it.

**2 Chronicles 3:15**

And he made before house two pillars, thirty-five cubits high, and their capitals five cubits.

**2 Chronicles 3:16**

And he made chains in debir and put them on heads of pillars, and he made one hundred pomegranates and put them on chains.

**2 Chronicles 3:17**

And he set pillars before temple, one at right and one at left, and he called name of right one Uprightness and name of left one Strength.

### Chapter 4

**2 Chronicles 4:1**

And he made bronze altar, twenty cubits long and twenty cubits broad and ten cubits high.

**2 Chronicles 4:2**

And he made cast sea, ten cubits across, round all around, and its height five cubits, and its circuit thirty cubits.

**2 Chronicles 4:3**

And likeness of calves under it around encircled it, ten cubits surrounding laver all around, two kinds having cast calves in their casting.

**2 Chronicles 4:4**

Which they made: twelve calves, three facing north and three facing west and three facing south and three facing east, and sea was above them, and their hind parts were inward.

**2 Chronicles 4:5**

And its thickness was a handbreadth, and its rim like rim of cup, carved lily blossoms, holding three thousand measures, and it was finished.

**2 Chronicles 4:6**

And he made ten lavers and set five on right and five on left, to wash in them works of whole burnt offerings and rinse in them, and sea was for priests to wash in it.

**2 Chronicles 4:7**

And he made ten gold lampstands according to their ordinance and set them in temple, five on right and five on left.

**2 Chronicles 4:8**

And he made ten tables and set them in temple, five on right and five on left, and he made one hundred golden bowls.

**2 Chronicles 4:9**

And he made court of priests and great court and doors for court, and their door-panels plated with bronze.

**2 Chronicles 4:10**

And he set sea from corner of house on right, toward east, opposite.

**2 Chronicles 4:11**

And Chiram made flesh-hooks and firepans and grate of altar and all its vessels, and Chiram finished making all work which Salomon the king made in house of God:

**2 Chronicles 4:12**

two pillars, and upon them bowl-capitals on heads of pillars, two, and two nets to cover two bowl-capitals which were on heads of pillars,

**2 Chronicles 4:13**

and four hundred golden pomegranates for two nets, two sets of pomegranates on one net to cover two bowl-capitals which were above pillars,

**2 Chronicles 4:14**

and he made ten stands and made lavers upon stands,

**2 Chronicles 4:15**

and one sea and twelve calves under it,

**2 Chronicles 4:16**

and footstools and forks and cauldrons and flesh-hooks and all their vessels, which Chiram made and brought to king Salomon for house of Lord, of pure bronze.

**2 Chronicles 4:17**

In region of Jordan king cast them in thickness of earth, in house of Sokchōth and between Sirdatha.

**2 Chronicles 4:18**

And Salomon made all these vessels in very great abundance, because weight of bronze did not fail.

**2 Chronicles 4:19**

And Salomon made all vessels of house of Lord, and golden altar and tables, and on them breads of presentation,

**2 Chronicles 4:20**

and lampstands and lamps for light according to ordinance and before debir, of pure gold,

**2 Chronicles 4:21**

and their tongs and their lamps and bowls and censers and firepans of pure gold,

**2 Chronicles 4:22**

and inner door of house into holy of holies, and doors of house of temple, golden.

### Chapter 5

**2 Chronicles 5:1**

And all work which Salomon made in house of Lord was finished, and Salomon brought in holy things of Dauid his father, silver and gold and vessels, and gave them into treasure of house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 5:2**

Then Salomon assembled elders of Israel and all rulers of tribes, leaders of fathers of sons of Israel, in Ierousalem, to bring up ark of covenant of Lord from City of Dauid, this is Sion.

**2 Chronicles 5:3**

And every man of Israel was assembled to king at feast, this seventh month.

**2 Chronicles 5:4**

And all elders of Israel came, and all Levites took ark.

**2 Chronicles 5:5**

And they brought up ark and tent of testimony and all holy vessels in tent; priests and Levites brought them up.

**2 Chronicles 5:6**

And king Salomon and all congregation of Israel, those fearing and gathered with him before ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep which cannot be numbered and cannot be reckoned from multitude.

**2 Chronicles 5:7**

And priests brought in ark of covenant of Lord to its place, into debir of house, into holy of holies, under wings of cheroubim.

**2 Chronicles 5:8**

And cheroubim were spreading out their wings over place of ark, and cheroubim were covering ark and its carrying-poles above.

**2 Chronicles 5:9**

And carrying-poles projected, and heads of poles were seen from holy place before debir, but were not seen outside, and they were there until this day.

**2 Chronicles 5:10**

There was nothing in ark except two tablets which Moyses put in Chōrēb, when Lord made covenant with sons of Israel as they came out from land of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 5:11**

And it came to pass when priests came out from holy place, because all priests found there had sanctified themselves; they were not arranged by courses.

**2 Chronicles 5:12**

And Levites, singers, all sons of Asaph, Haiman, Idithoun, and their sons and their brothers, clothed in linen robes with cymbals and harps and lyres, were standing opposite altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests blowing trumpets.

**2 Chronicles 5:13**

And one sound came to be in blowing trumpets and in singing psalms and in sounding one voice, to give thanks and praise to Lord. And as they raised voice with trumpets and cymbals and instruments of songs and said, Give thanks to Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever, house was filled with cloud of glory of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 5:14**

And priests were not able to stand to minister from presence of cloud, because glory of Lord filled house of God.

### Chapter 6

**2 Chronicles 6:1**

Then Salomon said, Lord said he would dwell in thick darkness.

**2 Chronicles 6:2**

And I built holy house to your name for you, ready for dwelling forever.

**2 Chronicles 6:3**

And king turned his face and blessed all assembly of Israel, and all assembly of Israel stood there.

**2 Chronicles 6:4**

And he said, Blessed Lord God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to Dauid my father and with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

**2 Chronicles 6:5**

From day when I brought my people out of land of Egypt, I did not choose city from all tribes of Israel to build house for my name to be there, and I did not choose man to be ruler over my people Israel,

**2 Chronicles 6:6**

but I chose Ierousalem for my name to be there, and I chose Dauid to be over my people Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:7**

And it came upon heart of Dauid my father to build house to name of Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:8**

And Lord said to Dauid my father, Because it came upon your heart to build house to my name, you did well that it came upon your heart.

**2 Chronicles 6:9**

Nevertheless, you shall not build house, but your son who shall come out from your loins, he shall build house to my name.

**2 Chronicles 6:10**

And Lord raised up his word which he spoke, and I came to be in place of Dauid my father and sat upon throne of Israel, as Lord spoke, and I built house to name of Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:11**

And there I put ark, in which is covenant of Lord which he made with Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:12**

And he stood before altar of Lord in presence of all assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

**2 Chronicles 6:13**

For Salomon made bronze platform and set it in midst of court of sanctuary, its length five cubits and breadth five cubits and height three cubits, and he stood upon it and fell on his knees before all assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

**2 Chronicles 6:14**

And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven and on earth, keeping covenant and mercy for your servants walking before you with whole heart,

**2 Chronicles 6:15**

what you kept for your servant Dauid my father, what you spoke to him saying, and you spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, as this day.

**2 Chronicles 6:16**

And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for your servant Dauid my father what you spoke to him, saying, Man shall not fail for you from before me sitting on throne of Israel, if only your sons keep their way to walk in my law as you walked before me.

**2 Chronicles 6:17**

And now, Lord God of Israel, let your word be made faithful, which you spoke to your servant Dauid.

**2 Chronicles 6:18**

For will God truly dwell with men upon earth? If heaven and heaven of heaven are not sufficient for you, then what is this house which I built?

**2 Chronicles 6:19**

And you shall look upon prayer of your servant and upon my petition, Lord God, to hear petition and prayer which your servant prays before you today,

**2 Chronicles 6:20**

that your eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon this place where you said your name would be called there, to hear prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

**2 Chronicles 6:21**

And you shall hear petition of your servant and your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place, and you shall hear from place of your dwelling, from heaven, and you shall hear and be merciful.

**2 Chronicles 6:22**

If man sins against his neighbor and takes oath upon him to swear him, and comes and swears before altar in this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:23**

then you shall hear from heaven and do and judge your servants, repaying lawless one, to return his ways upon his head, and justifying righteous one, to give to him according to his righteousness.

**2 Chronicles 6:24**

And if your people Israel are crushed before enemy when they sin against you, and they turn and give thanks to your name and pray and entreat before you in this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:25**

then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to sins of your people Israel and return them to land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 6:26**

When heaven is shut and rain does not come because they sin against you, and they pray toward this place and praise your name and turn from their sins because you humbled them,

**2 Chronicles 6:27**

then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to sins of your servants and your people Israel, because you will show them good way in which they shall walk, and you will give rain upon your land which you gave to your people for inheritance.

**2 Chronicles 6:28**

If famine comes on land, if death comes, if blight and jaundice come, locust and caterpillar, if enemy afflicts them before their cities, according to every plague and every pain,

**2 Chronicles 6:29**

then every prayer and every petition which happens to every man and to all your people Israel, if a man knows his own touch and his own weakness and spreads out his hands toward this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:30**

then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and be gracious and give to each man according to his ways, as you know his heart, because you alone know heart of sons of men,

**2 Chronicles 6:31**

so that they may fear your ways all days which they live upon face of land which you gave to our fathers.

**2 Chronicles 6:32**

And every foreigner who is not from your people Israel, and comes from far land because of your great name and your strong hand and your uplifted arm, and comes and prays toward this place,

**2 Chronicles 6:33**

then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and do according to all things whatever foreigner calls upon you for, so that all peoples of earth may know your name and fear you as your people Israel and know that your name is called upon this house which I built.

**2 Chronicles 6:34**

If your people go out to battle against their enemies on way where you send them, and they pray to you by way of this city which you chose and house which I built to your name,

**2 Chronicles 6:35**

then hear from heaven their petition and their prayer and do their justice.

**2 Chronicles 6:36**

Because they will sin against you, for there will not be man who will not sin, and you will strike them and hand them over before enemies, and those taking them captive shall take them captive to land of enemies, far or near,

**2 Chronicles 6:37**

and they will turn heart in their land where they were taken, and indeed turn and entreat you in their captivity, saying, We sinned, we acted unjustly, we acted lawlessly,

**2 Chronicles 6:38**

and turn toward you with all heart and all soul in land of those who took them captive, and pray by way of their land which you gave to their fathers and city which you chose and house which I built to your name,

**2 Chronicles 6:39**

then hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, their prayer and their petition and do judgments and be merciful to your people who sinned against you.

**2 Chronicles 6:40**

Now, Lord, let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to petition of this place.

**2 Chronicles 6:41**

And now rise up, Lord God, into your resting place, you and ark of your strength. Let your priests, Lord God, put on salvation, and let your sons rejoice in good things.

**2 Chronicles 6:42**

Lord God, do not turn away face of your anointed one; remember mercies of Dauid your servant.

### Chapter 7

**2 Chronicles 7:1**

And when Salomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, and glory of Lord filled house.

**2 Chronicles 7:2**

And priests were not able to enter house of Lord at that time, because glory of Lord filled house.

**2 Chronicles 7:3**

And all sons of Israel saw fire coming down and glory of Lord upon house, and they fell upon face to ground on pavement and worshiped and praised Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.

**2 Chronicles 7:4**

And king and all people were sacrificing sacrifices before Lord.

**2 Chronicles 7:5**

And Salomon sacrificed sacrifice of twenty-two thousand calves and one hundred twenty thousand cattle, and king and all people dedicated house of God.

**2 Chronicles 7:6**

And priests stood at their charges, and Levites with instruments of songs of Lord, of Dauid king, for giving thanks before Lord, because his mercy is forever, with hymns of Dauid by their hand, and priests were blowing trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

**2 Chronicles 7:7**

And Salomon sanctified middle of court in house of Lord, because there he made whole burnt offerings and fat of peace offerings, because bronze altar which Salomon made was not able to receive whole burnt offerings and grain offerings and fats.

**2 Chronicles 7:8**

And Salomon made feast at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, very great assembly, from entrance of Hamath and as far as river of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 7:9**

And on eighth day he made dismissal, because dedication of altar he made seven days, feast.

**2 Chronicles 7:10**

And on twenty-third of seventh month he sent people to their tents rejoicing and with good heart over good things which Lord did to Dauid and to Salomon and to Israel his people.

**2 Chronicles 7:11**

And Salomon finished house of Lord and house of king, and all things which Salomon desired in his soul to do in house of Lord and in his house prospered.

**2 Chronicles 7:12**

And God appeared to Salomon by night and said to him, I heard your prayer and chose in this place for myself as house of sacrifice.

**2 Chronicles 7:13**

If I shut heaven and rain does not come, and if I command locust to eat tree, and if I send death among my people,

**2 Chronicles 7:14**

and my people upon whom my name has been called are put to shame, and they pray and seek my face and turn from their evil ways, then I will hear from heaven and be merciful to their sins and heal their land.

**2 Chronicles 7:15**

Now my eyes shall be open and my ears attentive to prayer of this place.

**2 Chronicles 7:16**

And now I have chosen and sanctified this house for my name to be there forever, and my eyes and my heart shall be there all days.

**2 Chronicles 7:17**

And you, if you walk before me as Dauid your father and do according to all things I commanded you and keep my ordinances and my judgments,

**2 Chronicles 7:18**

then I will set up throne of your kingdom as I covenanted with Dauid your father, saying, Man leading in Israel shall not be removed from you.

**2 Chronicles 7:19**

And if you turn away and forsake my ordinances and my commandments which I gave before you and go and serve other gods and worship them,

**2 Chronicles 7:20**

then I will lift you out of land which I gave them, and this house which I sanctified to my name I will cast away from my face and give it for parable and tale among all nations.

**2 Chronicles 7:21**

And this exalted house, everyone passing by it will be astonished and say, For what reason did Lord do thus to this land and to this house?

**2 Chronicles 7:22**

And they shall say, Because they forsook Lord God of their fathers, who brought them out from land of Egypt, and laid hold of other gods and worshiped them and served them, therefore he brought upon them all this evil.

### Chapter 8

**2 Chronicles 8:1**

And it came to pass after twenty years in which Salomon built house of Lord and his own house,

**2 Chronicles 8:2**

and cities which Chiram gave to Salomon, Salomon built them and settled sons of Israel there.

**2 Chronicles 8:3**

And Salomon came to Aimath Sōba and prevailed over it.

**2 Chronicles 8:4**

And he built Thedmor in wilderness and all strong cities which he built in Hamath.

**2 Chronicles 8:5**

And he built Baithōrōn the upper and Baithōrōn the lower, fortified cities, walls, gates, and bars,

**2 Chronicles 8:6**

and Baalath and all strong cities which belonged to Salomon and all cities of chariots and cities of horsemen and whatever Salomon desired according to desire to build in Ierousalem and in Lebanon and in all his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 8:7**

All people left over from Chettite and Amorite and Pherezite and Heuite and Iebousite, who were not from Israel,

**2 Chronicles 8:8**

from their sons left after them in land whom sons of Israel did not destroy, Salomon brought them up as tribute until this day.

**2 Chronicles 8:9**

But from sons of Israel Salomon did not make servants for his kingdom, because they were men of war and rulers and mighty men and rulers of chariots and horsemen.

**2 Chronicles 8:10**

And these were chiefs of officers of king Salomon, two hundred fifty overseeing work among people.

**2 Chronicles 8:11**

And Salomon brought daughter of Pharaoh up from City of Dauid into house which he built for her, because he said, My wife shall not dwell in City of Dauid king of Israel, because holy is place where ark of Lord entered.

**2 Chronicles 8:12**

Then Salomon brought up whole burnt offerings to Lord on altar which he built opposite temple.

**2 Chronicles 8:13**

And according to matter of each day, for offering according to commandments of Moyses, on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts three times of year, in feast of unleavened bread and in feast of weeks and in feast of tents.

**2 Chronicles 8:14**

And he established according to ordinance of Dauid divisions of priests according to their services, and Levites in their charges to praise and minister before priests according to matter of day in its day, and gatekeepers in their divisions for gate and gate, because thus were commandments of Dauid man of God.

**2 Chronicles 8:15**

They did not pass by commands of king concerning priests and Levites in every matter and concerning treasuries.

**2 Chronicles 8:16**

And all work was prepared from day house was founded until Salomon finished house of Lord.

**2 Chronicles 8:17**

Then Salomon went to Gasiōngaber and to Ailath by sea in land of Idoumaia.

**2 Chronicles 8:18**

And Chiram sent by hands of his servants ships and servants knowing sea, and they went with servants of Salomon to Sōphira and took from there four hundred fifty talents of gold and came to king Salomon.

### Chapter 9

**2 Chronicles 9:1**

And queen of Saba heard name of Salomon and came to test Salomon with riddles in Ierousalem, with very weighty force, and camels carrying spices and gold in abundance and precious stone, and she came to Salomon and spoke with him all things in her soul.

**2 Chronicles 9:2**

And Salomon declared to her all her matters, and no matter passed from Salomon which he did not declare to her.

**2 Chronicles 9:3**

And queen of Saba saw wisdom of Salomon and house which he built,

**2 Chronicles 9:4**

and foods of his tables and seating of his servants and standing of his ministers and their clothing and his cupbearers and their apparel and whole burnt offerings which he offered in house of Lord, and she was beside herself.

**2 Chronicles 9:5**

And she said to king, True was word which I heard in my land concerning your matters and concerning your wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:6**

And I did not believe words until I came and my eyes saw, and behold, half multitude of your wisdom was not reported to me. You added beyond report which I heard.

**2 Chronicles 9:7**

Blessed your men; blessed these servants of yours standing before you continually and hearing your wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:8**

Blessed be the Lord your God, who delighted in you to set you on his throne as king for the Lord your God. Because the Lord your God loved Israel to establish him forever, he gave you over them as king to do judgment and righteousness.

**2 Chronicles 9:9**

And she gave to king one hundred twenty talents of gold and spices in very great abundance and precious stone, and there were no spices like those which queen of Saba gave to king Salomon.

**2 Chronicles 9:10**

And servants of Salomon and servants of Chiram were bringing gold to Salomon from Souphir and pine woods and precious stone.

**2 Chronicles 9:11**

And king made from pine woods stairways for house of Lord and for house of king and lyres and harps for singers, and such things were not seen before in land of Iouda.

**2 Chronicles 9:12**

And king Salomon gave to queen of Saba all her desires which she asked, besides all which she brought to king Salomon, and she returned to her land.

**2 Chronicles 9:13**
