But I said in my prosperity, I will by no means be shaken into age.

**Psalms 29:8**

Lord, in your will you supplied strength to my beauty; but you turned your face away and I became troubled.

**Psalms 29:9**

To you, Lord, I will cry, and to my God I will beg.

**Psalms 29:10**

What profit in my blood, in my going down into corruption? Will dust confess to you or announce your truth?

**Psalms 29:11**

Lord heard and had mercy on me; Lord became my helper.

**Psalms 29:12**

You turned my mourning into dance for me; you tore my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,

**Psalms 29:13**

so that my glory might sing to you and by no means be pierced through. Lord my God, into age I will confess to you.

### Chapter 30

**Psalms 30:1**

For end. Psalm of David, of ecstasy.

**Psalms 30:2**

Upon you, Lord, I hoped; may I not be ashamed into age. In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me.

**Psalms 30:3**

Incline your ear to me; hurry to deliver me. Become to me God defender and house of refuge to save me.

**Psalms 30:4**

Because you are my strength and my refuge, and for sake of your name you will lead me and nourish me.

**Psalms 30:5**

You will bring me out from this snare which they hid for me, because you are my defender.

**Psalms 30:6**

Into your hands I will entrust my spirit. You redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.

**Psalms 30:7**

You hated those keeping worthless vanities for nothing, but I hoped upon Lord.

**Psalms 30:8**

I will rejoice and be glad in your mercy, because you looked upon my humiliation; you saved my soul from necessities.

**Psalms 30:9**

And you did not shut me up into enemy hands; you set my feet in broad place.

**Psalms 30:10**

Have mercy on me, Lord, because I am afflicted; my eye was troubled in anger, my soul and my belly.

**Psalms 30:11**

Because my life failed in pain and my years in groanings; my strength weakened in poverty and my bones were troubled.

**Psalms 30:12**

Beyond all my enemies I became reproach, and greatly to my neighbors, and fear to those known to me; those seeing me outside fled from me.

**Psalms 30:13**

I was forgotten like dead man from heart; I became like ruined vessel.

**Psalms 30:14**

Because I heard blame of many dwelling around, when they gathered together against me, they planned to take my soul.

**Psalms 30:15**

But I hoped upon you, Lord; I said, You are my God.

**Psalms 30:16**

My times in your hands. Rescue me from hand of my enemies and from those pursuing me.

**Psalms 30:17**

Shine your face upon your servant; save me in your mercy.

**Psalms 30:18**

Lord, may I not be ashamed, because I called upon you. Let ungodly men be ashamed and brought down into Hades.

**Psalms 30:19**

Let deceitful lips become dumb, those speaking lawlessness against righteous man in pride and contempt.

**Psalms 30:20**

How much the multitude of your goodness, Lord, which you hid for those fearing you; you worked it out for those hoping upon you before sons of men.

**Psalms 30:21**

You will hide them in hidden place of your face from disturbance of men; you will shelter them in tent from contradiction of tongues.

**Psalms 30:22**

Blessed Lord, because he made his mercy wondrous in city of enclosure.

**Psalms 30:23**

But I said in my ecstasy, So then I am cast away from face of your eyes. Because of this you heard voice of my petition when I cried out to you.

**Psalms 30:24**

Love Lord, all his holy ones, because Lord seeks truths and repays those doing pride beyond measure.

**Psalms 30:25**

Act like men and let your heart be strengthened, all hoping upon Lord.

### Chapter 31

**Psalms 31:1**

Of David. Of understanding. Blessed those whose lawless acts were forgiven and whose sins were covered.

**Psalms 31:2**

Blessed man to whom Lord will by no means count sin, nor is deceit in his mouth.

**Psalms 31:3**

Because I was silent, my bones grew old from my crying all day.

**Psalms 31:4**

Because day and night your hand grew heavy upon me; I was turned into misery when thorn was fixed in. Interlude.

**Psalms 31:5**

My sin I made known, and my lawlessness I did not cover. I said, I will confess against myself my lawlessness to Lord, and you forgave ungodliness of my sin. Interlude.

**Psalms 31:6**

Because of this every holy one will pray to you in fitting season. Yet in flood of many waters they will not come near him.

**Psalms 31:7**

You are my refuge from affliction surrounding me, my joy. Redeem me from those encircling me. Interlude.

**Psalms 31:8**

I will make you understand and instruct you in this way which you will go; I will fix my eyes upon you.

**Psalms 31:9**

Do not become like horse and mule, which have no understanding, in bridle and bit to clamp their jaws, of those not drawing near to you.

**Psalms 31:10**

Many scourges belong to sinner, but mercy will encircle one hoping upon Lord.

**Psalms 31:11**

Be glad in Lord and rejoice, righteous ones, and boast, all upright in heart.

### Chapter 32

**Psalms 32:1**

Of David. Rejoice in Lord, righteous ones; praise is fitting for upright ones.

**Psalms 32:2**

Confess to Lord with harp; with ten-stringed psaltery sing to him.

**Psalms 32:3**

Sing to him new song; play well with shouting.

**Psalms 32:4**

Because word of Lord straight, and all his works in faithfulness.

**Psalms 32:5**

He loves mercy and judgment; earth full of mercy of Lord.

**Psalms 32:6**

By word of Lord heavens were made firm, and by spirit of his mouth all their power.

**Psalms 32:7**

Gathering waters of sea like wineskin, putting deeps in treasuries.

**Psalms 32:8**

Let all earth fear Lord, and from him let all dwelling inhabited world be shaken,

**Psalms 32:9**

because he said and they came to be; he commanded and they were created.

**Psalms 32:10**

Lord scatters counsels of nations, sets aside reasonings of peoples, and sets aside counsels of rulers.

**Psalms 32:11**

But counsel of Lord remains into age, reasonings of his heart from generation to generation.

**Psalms 32:12**

Blessed nation whose God is Lord, people whom he chose for inheritance to himself.

**Psalms 32:13**

From heaven Lord looked down; he saw all sons of men.

**Psalms 32:14**

From his prepared dwelling he looked upon all dwelling earth,

**Psalms 32:15**

he who formed their hearts one by one, he who understands all their works.

**Psalms 32:16**

King is not saved by much power, and giant will not be saved by multitude of his strength.

**Psalms 32:17**

Horse false thing for salvation, and in multitude of its power it will not be saved.

**Psalms 32:18**

Behold, eyes of Lord upon those fearing him, those hoping upon his mercy,

**Psalms 32:19**

to rescue their souls from death and nourish them in famine.

**Psalms 32:20**

Our soul endures for Lord, because he is our helper and defender.

**Psalms 32:21**

Because in him our heart will be gladdened, and in his holy name we hoped.

**Psalms 32:22**

Let your mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we hoped upon you.

### Chapter 33

**Psalms 33:1**

Of David, when he altered his face before Abimelech, and he released him and he went away.

**Psalms 33:2**

I will bless Lord in every season; continually his praise in my mouth.

**Psalms 33:3**

In Lord my soul will be praised; let meek hear and be glad.

**Psalms 33:4**

Magnify Lord with me, and let us lift up his name together.

**Psalms 33:5**

I sought out Lord, and he heard me, and rescued me from all my sojournings.

**Psalms 33:6**

Draw near to him and be enlightened, and your faces will by no means be ashamed.

**Psalms 33:7**

This poor man cried out, and Lord heard him and saved him from all his afflictions.

**Psalms 33:8**

Angel of Lord will encamp around those fearing him and will rescue them.

**Psalms 33:9**

Taste and see that Lord good; blessed man who hopes upon him.

**Psalms 33:10**

Fear Lord, his holy ones, because there is no lack to those fearing him.

**Psalms 33:11**

Rich men became poor and hungry, but those seeking Lord will not be diminished of any good thing. Interlude.

**Psalms 33:12**

Come, children, hear me; fear of Lord I will teach you.

**Psalms 33:13**

Who is man wanting life, loving days to see good things?

**Psalms 33:14**

Stop your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.

**Psalms 33:15**

Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

**Psalms 33:16**

Eyes of Lord upon righteous ones and his ears toward their petition.

**Psalms 33:17**

But face of Lord against those doing evils, to destroy their memorial from earth.

**Psalms 33:18**

Righteous ones cried out and Lord heard them, and rescued them from all their afflictions.

**Psalms 33:19**

Lord near to those crushed in heart, and he will save humble in spirit.

**Psalms 33:20**

Many afflictions of righteous ones, and from all of them he will rescue them.

**Psalms 33:21**

Lord guards all their bones; not one of them will be broken.

**Psalms 33:22**

Death of sinners evil, and those hating righteous man will go astray.

**Psalms 33:23**

Lord will redeem souls of his servants, and all hoping upon him will by no means go astray.

### Chapter 34

**Psalms 34:1**

Of David. Judge, Lord, those doing me injustice; war against those warring against me.

**Psalms 34:2**

Take hold of weapon and shield, and rise up for my help.

**Psalms 34:3**

Pour out sword and shut off those opposite my pursuers; say to my soul, I am your salvation.

**Psalms 34:4**

Let those seeking my soul be ashamed and put to shame; let those devising evils for me turn backward and be ashamed.

**Psalms 34:5**

Let them become like chaff before wind, and angel of Lord afflicting them.

**Psalms 34:6**

Let their way become darkness and slipperiness, and angel of Lord pursuing them.

**Psalms 34:7**

Because without cause they hid for me destruction of their snare; in vain they reproached my soul.

**Psalms 34:8**

Let snare come upon them which they do not know, and hunt which they hid catch them, and in that snare let them fall.

**Psalms 34:9**

But my soul will rejoice in Lord, delighting in his salvation.

**Psalms 34:10**

All my bones will say, Lord, who like you, rescuing poor man from hand of those stronger than he, and poor and needy from those plundering him?

**Psalms 34:11**

Unjust witnesses rising up asked me things I did not know.

**Psalms 34:12**

They repaid me evils for good things and childlessness to my soul.

**Psalms 34:13**

But when they troubled me, I clothed myself in sackcloth and humbled my soul in fasting, and my prayer will return into my bosom.

**Psalms 34:14**

Like neighbor, like our brother, so I was pleasing; like mourning and glooming, so I humbled myself.

**Psalms 34:15**

And against me they rejoiced and gathered together; scourges gathered upon me and I did not know; they were torn apart and were not pierced through.

**Psalms 34:16**

They tested me, mocked me with mocking, gnashed their teeth at me.

**Psalms 34:17**

Lord, when will you look? Restore my soul from their villainies, my only one from lions.

**Psalms 34:18**

I will confess to you, Lord, in great assembly; among heavy people I will praise you.

**Psalms 34:19**

Let those hating me unjustly not rejoice over me, those hating me without cause and winking with eyes,

**Psalms 34:20**

because to me they spoke peaceful things, and in anger they devised deceits.

**Psalms 34:21**

And they opened wide their mouth upon me; they said, Good, good, our eyes saw.

**Psalms 34:22**

You saw, Lord; do not be silent. Lord, do not stand far from me.

**Psalms 34:23**

Wake up, Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my case.

**Psalms 34:24**

Judge me according to your righteousness, Lord my God, and let them not rejoice over me.

**Psalms 34:25**

Let them not say in their hearts, Good, good, to our soul, nor say, We swallowed him up.

**Psalms 34:26**

Let those rejoicing at my evils be ashamed and put to shame together; let those speaking great things against me be clothed with shame and embarrassment.

**Psalms 34:27**

Let those wanting my righteousness rejoice and be glad, and let them always say, Let Lord be magnified, those wanting peace of his servant.

**Psalms 34:28**

And my tongue will meditate your righteousness, all day your praise.

### Chapter 35

**Psalms 35:1**

For end. To servant of Lord, David.

**Psalms 35:2**

Lawless man says of sinning within himself, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

**Psalms 35:3**

Because he dealt deceitfully before him, to find his lawlessness and hate it.

**Psalms 35:4**

Words of his mouth lawlessness and deceit; he did not wish to understand so as to do good.

**Psalms 35:5**

He devised lawlessness upon his bed; he stood upon every way not good, and he did not loathe evil.

**Psalms 35:6**

Lord, in heaven your mercy and your truth up to clouds.

**Psalms 35:7**

Your righteousness like mountains of God; your judgments great deep. Men and cattle you will save, Lord.

**Psalms 35:8**

How you multiplied your mercy, God; but sons of men will hope in shelter of your wings.

**Psalms 35:9**

They will be intoxicated from richness of your house, and you will give them drink from torrent of your delight.

**Psalms 35:10**

Because with you spring of life; in your light we will see light.

**Psalms 35:11**

Stretch out your mercy to those knowing you and your righteousness to upright in heart.

**Psalms 35:12**

Let foot of pride not come to me, and hand of sinners not shake me.

**Psalms 35:13**

There workers of lawlessness fell; they were thrust out and will not be able to stand.

### Chapter 36

**Psalms 36:1**

Of David. Do not be jealous among evildoers, nor envy those doing lawlessness,

**Psalms 36:2**

because like grass they will quickly dry up, and like green herbs they will quickly fall away.

**Psalms 36:3**

Hope upon Lord and do kindness, and dwell in earth, and you will be shepherded upon its wealth.

**Psalms 36:4**

Take delight in Lord, and he will give you requests of your heart.

**Psalms 36:5**

Reveal your way to Lord and hope upon him, and he will do it.

**Psalms 36:6**

And he will bring out your righteousness like light and your judgment like noonday.

**Psalms 36:7**

Be subjected to Lord and entreat him. Do not be jealous in one prospering in his way, in man doing lawless things.

**Psalms 36:8**

Cease from anger and leave wrath behind; do not be jealous so as to do evil.

**Psalms 36:9**

Because evildoers will be utterly destroyed, but those enduring Lord, they will inherit earth.

**Psalms 36:10**

And still a little, and sinner will by no means exist; and you will seek his place and by no means find it.

**Psalms 36:11**

But meek ones will inherit earth and take delight in abundance of peace.

**Psalms 36:12**

Sinner will watch righteous man and gnash his teeth upon him.

**Psalms 36:13**

But Lord will laugh at him, because he foresees that his day will come.

**Psalms 36:14**

Sinners drew sword and stretched their bow, to cast down poor and needy, to slaughter upright in heart.

**Psalms 36:15**

Their sword may enter into their heart, and their bows may be broken.

**Psalms 36:16**

Better little thing to righteous man than much wealth of sinners,

**Psalms 36:17**

because arms of sinners will be broken, but Lord supports righteous ones.

**Psalms 36:18**

Lord knows ways of blameless ones, and their inheritance will be into age.

**Psalms 36:19**

They will not be ashamed in evil season, and in days of famine they will be filled.

**Psalms 36:20**

Because sinners will perish, and enemies of Lord, when they are glorified and lifted up, failing away like smoke they failed away.

**Psalms 36:21**

Sinner borrows and will not repay, but righteous man has compassion and gives.

**Psalms 36:22**

Because those blessing him will inherit earth, but those cursing him will be utterly destroyed.

**Psalms 36:23**

From Lord steps of man are directed straight, and he will desire his way.

**Psalms 36:24**

When he falls, he will not be dashed down, because Lord supports his hand.

**Psalms 36:25**

I became younger and indeed I grew old, and I did not see righteous man forsaken, nor his seed seeking breads.

**Psalms 36:26**

All day he has mercy and lends, and his seed will be into blessing.

**Psalms 36:27**

Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell into age of age,

**Psalms 36:28**

because Lord loves judgment and will not forsake his holy ones. Into age they will be guarded, but lawless men will be driven out, and seed of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.

**Psalms 36:29**

But righteous ones will inherit earth and dwell upon it into age of age.

**Psalms 36:30**

Mouth of righteous man will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment.

**Psalms 36:31**

Law of his God in his heart, and his steps will not be tripped up.

**Psalms 36:32**

Sinner watches righteous man and seeks to put him to death.

**Psalms 36:33**

But Lord will by no means forsake him into his hands, nor by any means condemn him when judgment comes to him.

**Psalms 36:34**

Endure Lord and keep his way, and he will lift you up to inherit earth; when sinners are utterly destroyed you will see.

**Psalms 36:35**

I saw ungodly man highly exalted and lifted up like cedars of Lebanon.

**Psalms 36:36**

And I passed by, and behold, he was not; and I sought him, and his place was not found.

**Psalms 36:37**

Guard innocence and see uprightness, because there is remnant for peaceful man.

**Psalms 36:38**

But lawless men will be utterly destroyed together; remnants of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.

**Psalms 36:39**

But salvation of righteous ones from Lord, and he is their defender in time of affliction.

**Psalms 36:40**

And Lord will help them and rescue them and deliver them from sinners and save them, because they hoped upon him.

### Chapter 37

**Psalms 37:1**

Psalm of David, for remembrance concerning Sabbath.

**Psalms 37:2**

Lord, do not reprove me in your fury, nor discipline me in your anger,

**Psalms 37:3**

because your arrows were fixed in me and you set your hand firmly upon me.

**Psalms 37:4**

There is no healing in my flesh from face of your wrath; no peace to my bones from face of my sins.

**Psalms 37:5**

Because my lawless acts rose above my head; like heavy burden they weighed heavily upon me.

**Psalms 37:6**

My wounds stank and rotted from face of my foolishness.

**Psalms 37:7**

I was miserable and bent down to end; all day mourning-faced I went about.

**Psalms 37:8**

Because my loins were filled with mockings, and there is no healing in my flesh.

**Psalms 37:9**

I was afflicted and humbled beyond measure; I roared from groaning of my heart.

**Psalms 37:10**

Lord, all my desire before you, and my groaning was not hidden from you.

**Psalms 37:11**

My heart was troubled; my strength forsook me, and light of my eyes, even this not with me.

**Psalms 37:12**

My friends and my neighbors drew near opposite me and stood, and my near ones stood far off.

**Psalms 37:13**

And those seeking my soul used violence, and those seeking my evils spoke vanities and meditated deceits all day.

**Psalms 37:14**

But I like deaf man was not hearing, and like mute not opening his mouth.

**Psalms 37:15**

And I became like man not hearing and not having reproofs in his mouth.

**Psalms 37:16**

Because upon you, Lord, I hoped; you will hear, Lord my God.

**Psalms 37:17**

Because I said, Lest my enemies rejoice over me, and when my feet are shaken they spoke great things against me.

**Psalms 37:18**

Because I am ready for scourges, and my pain before me always.

**Psalms 37:19**

Because my lawlessness I will announce, and I will be anxious concerning my sin.

**Psalms 37:20**

But my enemies live and are stronger than I, and those hating me unjustly were multiplied.

**Psalms 37:21**

Those repaying evil for good slandered me because I pursued righteousness and cast me away, beloved one, like dead man abhorred.

**Psalms 37:22**

Do not forsake me, Lord my God; do not stand far from me.

**Psalms 37:23**

Attend to my help, Lord of my salvation.

### Chapter 38

**Psalms 38:1**

For end. To Idithoun. Song of David.

**Psalms 38:2**

I said, I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue; I set guard for my mouth when sinner stood opposite me.

**Psalms 38:3**

I became mute and humbled and was silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.

**Psalms 38:4**

My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation fire will blaze; I spoke with my tongue,

**Psalms 38:5**

Make known to me, Lord, my end and number of my days, what it is, that I may know what I lack.

**Psalms 38:6**

Behold, you made my days old-span lengths, and my existence like nothing before you. Yet all things vanity, every living man. Interlude.

**Psalms 38:7**

Surely man passes by in image; yet in vain they are troubled; he stores up and does not know for whom he will gather them.

**Psalms 38:8**

And now what is my endurance? Is it not Lord? And my substance is from you.

**Psalms 38:9**

From all my lawless acts rescue me; you gave me as reproach to fool.

**Psalms 38:10**

I became mute and did not open my mouth, because you are one who made me.

**Psalms 38:11**

Remove your scourges from me; from strength of your hand I failed away.

**Psalms 38:12**

With reproofs over lawlessness you disciplined man and melted his soul like spider. Yet in vain every man is troubled. Interlude.

**Psalms 38:13**

Hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my petition. Do not be silent at my tears, because I am sojourner with you and passing resident, like all my fathers.

**Psalms 38:14**

Leave me, that I may be refreshed before I depart and no longer exist.

### Chapter 39

**Psalms 39:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 39:2**

Waiting, I waited for Lord, and he attended to me and heard my petition.

**Psalms 39:3**

And he brought me up from pit of misery and from mud of mire and set my feet upon rock and straightened my steps.

**Psalms 39:4**

And he threw into my mouth new song, hymn to our God. Many will see and fear and hope upon Lord.

**Psalms 39:5**

Blessed man whose hope is name of Lord, and did not look toward vanities and false frenzies.

**Psalms 39:6**

Many things you did, Lord my God, your wonders; and in your reasonings there is none who will be likened to you. I declared and spoke; they were multiplied beyond number.

**Psalms 39:7**

Sacrifice and offering you did not want, but ears you fitted for me; whole burnt offering and concerning sin you did not ask.

**Psalms 39:8**

Then I said, Behold, I came. In head-roll of book it is written concerning me.

**Psalms 39:9**

To do your will, O my God, I wanted, and your law in midst of my belly.

**Psalms 39:10**

I proclaimed righteousness in great assembly; behold, my lips I will by no means restrain. Lord, you knew.

**Psalms 39:11**

Your righteousness I did not hide in my heart; your truth and your salvation I spoke; I did not hide your mercy and your truth from great gathering.

**Psalms 39:12**

But you, Lord, do not keep your compassions far from me; your mercy and your truth always supported me.

**Psalms 39:13**

Because evils without number enclosed me; my lawless acts overtook me and I was not able to look. They were multiplied beyond hairs of my head, and my heart forsook me.

**Psalms 39:14**

Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, attend to help me.

**Psalms 39:15**

Let those seeking my soul to take it away be ashamed and put to shame together; let those wanting evils for me turn backward and be put to shame.

**Psalms 39:16**

Let those saying to me, Good, good, carry away at once their shame.

**Psalms 39:17**

Let all seeking you rejoice and be glad upon you, Lord, and let those loving your salvation always say, Let Lord be magnified.

**Psalms 39:18**

But I am poor and needy; Lord will care for me. My helper and my defender are you; my God, do not delay.

### Chapter 40

**Psalms 40:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 40:2**

Blessed one understanding concerning poor and needy man; in evil day Lord will rescue him.

**Psalms 40:3**

Lord guard him and make him live and bless him in earth and not hand him over into hands of his enemy.

**Psalms 40:4**

**Psalms 40:5**

I said, Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, because I sinned against you.

**Psalms 40:6**

My enemies spoke evils to me: When will he die and his name perish?

**Psalms 40:7**

And if he entered to see, he spoke vain things; his heart gathered lawlessness to itself; he went outside and spoke.

**Psalms 40:8**

Together all my enemies whispered against me; against me they reasoned evils for me:

**Psalms 40:9**

**Psalms 40:10**

**Psalms 40:11**

But you, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.

**Psalms 40:12**

**Psalms 40:13**

But of me, because of my innocence, you took hold and established me before you into age.

**Psalms 40:14**

Blessed Lord God of Israel from age and into age. Let it be, let it be.

### Chapter 41

**Psalms 41:1**

For end, for understanding, for sons of Korah.

**Psalms 41:2**

As deer longs for springs of waters, so my soul longs for you, O God.

**Psalms 41:3**

My soul thirsted for living God; when will I come and appear before face of God?

**Psalms 41:4**

My tears became bread to me day and night, while they say to me each day, Where is your God?

**Psalms 41:5**

**Psalms 41:6**

Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.

**Psalms 41:7**

**Psalms 41:8**

**Psalms 41:9**

**Psalms 41:10**

**Psalms 41:11**

**Psalms 41:12**

Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.

### Chapter 42

**Psalms 42:1**

Psalm of David. Judge me, O God, and judge my case from nation not holy; from unjust and deceitful man rescue me.

**Psalms 42:2**

Because you are God, my strength. Why did you reject me? Why do I go gloomy when enemy afflicts me?

**Psalms 42:3**

Send out your light and your truth; they guided me and brought me to your holy mountain and to your tabernacles.

**Psalms 42:4**

And I will go in to altar of God, to God gladdening my youth; I will confess to you with harp, O God, my God.

**Psalms 42:5**

Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.

### Chapter 43

**Psalms 43:1**

For end, for sons of Korah, for understanding, psalm.

**Psalms 43:2**

O God, with our ears we heard; our fathers told us work you worked in their days, in ancient days.

**Psalms 43:3**

Your hand destroyed nations, and you planted them; you afflicted peoples and cast them out.

**Psalms 43:4**

Because not by their sword did they inherit land, and their arm did not save them, but your right hand and your arm and light of your face, because you took pleasure in them.

**Psalms 43:5**

You are same my king and my God, one commanding salvations of Jacob.

**Psalms 43:6**

In you we will gore our enemies, and in your name we will despise those rising against us.

**Psalms 43:7**

Because not in my bow will I hope, and my sword will not save me.

**Psalms 43:8**

Because you saved us from those afflicting us, and those hating us you shamed.

**Psalms 43:9**

In God we will boast whole day, and in your name we will confess forever. Interlude.

**Psalms 43:10**

But now you rejected and shamed us, and you will not go out with our powers.

**Psalms 43:11**

You turned us back before our enemies, and those hating us plundered for themselves.

**Psalms 43:12**

You gave us like sheep for food, and among nations you scattered us.

**Psalms 43:13**

You sold your people without price, and there was no multitude in their exchanges.

**Psalms 43:14**

You made us reproach to our neighbors, mockery and derision to those around us.

**Psalms 43:15**

You made us proverb among nations, shaking of head among peoples.

**Psalms 43:16**

Whole day my shame before me, and shame of my face covered me,

**Psalms 43:17**

**Psalms 43:18**

All these things came upon us, and we did not forget you, and we did not act unjustly in your covenant.

**Psalms 43:19**

And our heart did not turn back, and you turned our paths aside from your way,

**Psalms 43:20**

**Psalms 43:21**

If we forgot name of our God and stretched out our hands to strange god,

**Psalms 43:22**

**Psalms 43:23**

Because for your sake we are put to death whole day; we were counted as sheep of slaughter.

**Psalms 43:24**

Awake. Why do you sleep, Lord? Rise up and do not reject to end.

**Psalms 43:25**

Why do you turn away your face, forgetting our poverty and our affliction?

**Psalms 43:26**

Because our soul was humbled into dust; our belly clung to earth.

**Psalms 43:27**

Rise up, Lord, help us, and redeem us for sake of your name.

### Chapter 44

**Psalms 44:1**

For end, concerning those to be changed, for sons of Korah, for understanding, song concerning beloved.

**Psalms 44:2**

**Psalms 44:3**

**Psalms 44:4**

**Psalms 44:7**

**Psalms 44:8**

**Psalms 44:10**

**Psalms 44:11**

**Psalms 44:12**

**Psalms 44:13**

**Psalms 44:14**

**Psalms 44:15**

**Psalms 44:16**

**Psalms 44:17**

**Psalms 44:18**

### Chapter 45

**Psalms 45:1**

For end, for sons of Korah, concerning hidden things, psalm.

**Psalms 45:2**

**Psalms 45:5**

**Psalms 45:6**

**Psalms 45:10**

**Psalms 45:11**

**Psalms 45:12**

Lord of hosts with us; our supporter God of Jacob.

### Chapter 46

**Psalms 46:1**

For end, for sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 46:2**

**Psalms 46:3**

**Psalms 46:4**

**Psalms 46:5**

**Psalms 46:6**

God went up in shout, Lord in voice of trumpet.

**Psalms 46:7**

Sing to our God, sing; sing to our king, sing.

**Psalms 46:8**

**Psalms 46:9**

**Psalms 46:10**

### Chapter 47

**Psalms 47:1**

Psalm of song for sons of Korah, second of Sabbath.

**Psalms 47:2**

**Psalms 47:3**

**Psalms 47:4**

**Psalms 47:5**

**Psalms 47:6**

**Psalms 47:7**

**Psalms 47:8**

**Psalms 47:9**

**Psalms 47:10**

**Psalms 47:11**

**Psalms 47:12**

**Psalms 47:13**

**Psalms 47:14**

**Psalms 47:15**

### Chapter 48

**Psalms 48:1**

For end, for sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 48:2**

Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all inhabiting world,

**Psalms 48:3**

**Psalms 48:4**

**Psalms 48:5**

**Psalms 48:6**

**Psalms 48:7**

**Psalms 48:9**

**Psalms 48:10**

**Psalms 48:11**

**Psalms 48:12**

**Psalms 48:13**

**Psalms 48:14**

**Psalms 48:15**

**Psalms 48:17**

**Psalms 48:18**

**Psalms 48:19**

**Psalms 48:20**

**Psalms 48:21**

Man in honor did not understand; he was compared with mindless cattle and was made like them.

### Chapter 49

**Psalms 49:1**

Psalm of Asaph. God of gods, Lord, spoke and called earth from rising of sun to its setting.

**Psalms 49:2**

**Psalms 49:3**

**Psalms 49:4**

**Psalms 49:5**

**Psalms 49:6**

**Psalms 49:7**

**Psalms 49:9**

**Psalms 49:10**

**Psalms 49:11**

**Psalms 49:12**

**Psalms 49:13**

**Psalms 49:14**

**Psalms 49:15**

**Psalms 49:16**

**Psalms 49:17**

**Psalms 49:18**

**Psalms 49:19**

**Psalms 49:20**

**Psalms 49:21**

**Psalms 49:22**

**Psalms 49:23**

### Chapter 50

**Psalms 50:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 50:2**

**Psalms 50:3**

**Psalms 50:4**

**Psalms 50:5**

**Psalms 50:6**

**Psalms 50:7**

**Psalms 50:8**

**Psalms 50:9**

**Psalms 50:11**

**Psalms 50:12**

**Psalms 50:13**

**Psalms 50:14**

**Psalms 50:15**

**Psalms 50:16**

**Psalms 50:17**

**Psalms 50:18**

**Psalms 50:19**

**Psalms 50:20**

**Psalms 50:21**

### Chapter 51

**Psalms 51:1**

For end. For understanding. Of David.

**Psalms 51:2**

**Psalms 51:3**

**Psalms 51:4**

**Psalms 51:5**

**Psalms 51:6**

**Psalms 51:7**

**Psalms 51:10**

**Psalms 52:1**

For end, concerning Maeleth. For understanding. Of David.

**Psalms 53:1**

For end, in hymns. For understanding. Of David.

**Psalms 55:1**

**Psalms 55:6**

**Psalms 55:7**

**Psalms 55:11**

In God I will praise word; in Lord I will praise saying.

**Psalms 55:12**

In God I hoped; I will not fear what man will do to me.

**Psalms 55:13**

**Psalms 55:14**

### Chapter 56

**Psalms 56:1**

For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when he fled from face of Saul into cave.

**Psalms 56:4**

**Psalms 56:6**

**Psalms 56:7**

**Psalms 56:8**

**Psalms 56:12**

### Chapter 57

**Psalms 57:1**

For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription.

**Psalms 57:2**

**Psalms 57:8**

### Chapter 58

**Psalms 58:1**

For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when Saul sent and watched his house to kill him.

**Psalms 58:3**

**Psalms 58:11**

**Psalms 58:14**

**Psalms 58:16**

**Psalms 58:17**

**Psalms 58:18**

### Chapter 59

**Psalms 59:1**

For end, concerning those to be changed, yet for inscription, of David, for teaching.

**Psalms 59:2**

**Psalms 59:4**

**Psalms 59:5**

**Psalms 59:6**

**Psalms 59:7**

**Psalms 59:11**

**Psalms 59:12**

**Psalms 59:13**

**Psalms 59:14**

### Chapter 60

**Psalms 60:1**

For end, in hymns. Of David.

**Psalms 60:2**

Hear, O God, my supplication; attend to my prayer.

**Psalms 60:3**

**Psalms 60:4**

**Psalms 60:6**

**Psalms 61:1**

For end, concerning Jeduthun. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 61:2**

**Psalms 61:3**

**Psalms 62:1**

**Psalms 62:4**

### Chapter 68

**Psalms 68:1**

For end, concerning those to be changed. Of David.

**Psalms 68:34**

**Psalms 68:35**

**Psalms 68:37**

### Chapter 69

**Psalms 69:1**

For end. Of David, for remembrance.

**Psalms 69:2**

### Chapter 70

**Psalms 70:1**

**Psalms 70:13**

Let those slandering my soul be shamed and fail; let those seeking evils for me be clothed with shame and dishonor.

**Psalms 70:14**

But I will hope continually and will add upon all your praise.

**Psalms 70:15**

My mouth will declare your righteousness, all day your salvation, because I did not know writings.

**Psalms 70:16**

I will go in by dominion of Lord, Lord; I will remember your righteousness, yours alone.

**Psalms 70:17**

You taught me, O God, from my youth, and until now I declare your wonders.

**Psalms 70:18**

And until old age and gray hair, O God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to every coming generation, your dominion and your righteousness,

**Psalms 70:19**

O God, unto heights, what great things you did; O God, who like you?

**Psalms 70:20**

How many afflictions, many and evil, you showed me; and turning back, you made me live, and from depths of earth again you brought me up.

**Psalms 70:21**

You multiplied your greatness, and turning back you comforted me, and from depths of earth again you brought me up.

**Psalms 70:22**

And indeed I will confess to you with instrument of psalm your truth, O God; I will sing to you with lyre, Holy One of Israel.

**Psalms 70:23**

My lips will exult when I sing to you, and my soul which you redeemed.

**Psalms 70:24**

And still my tongue all day will meditate on your righteousness, when those seeking evils for me are shamed and disgraced.

### Chapter 71

**Psalms 71:1**

Of Solomon. O God, give your judgment to king and your righteousness to son of king,

**Psalms 71:2**

**Psalms 71:3**

**Psalms 71:4**

**Psalms 71:5**

**Psalms 71:6**

**Psalms 71:7**

**Psalms 71:8**

**Psalms 71:9**

**Psalms 71:10**

**Psalms 71:11**

**Psalms 71:12**

**Psalms 71:13**

**Psalms 71:14**

**Psalms 71:15**

**Psalms 71:16**

**Psalms 71:17**

**Psalms 71:18**

**Psalms 71:19**

**Psalms 71:20**

### Chapter 72

**Psalms 72:1**

Psalm of Asaph. How good God to Israel, to those straight in heart.

**Psalms 72:2**

But as for me, my feet were almost shaken; my steps all but poured out.

**Psalms 72:3**

Because I was jealous over lawless ones, seeing peace of sinners.

**Psalms 72:4**

Because there is no relenting in their death and firmness in their scourge.

**Psalms 72:5**

In labors of men they are not, and with men they will not be scourged.

**Psalms 72:6**

Therefore pride took hold of them; they clothed themselves with their injustice and ungodliness.

**Psalms 72:7**

Their injustice will go out as from fatness; they passed into purpose of heart.

**Psalms 72:8**

They thought and spoke in evil, they spoke injustice on high.

**Psalms 72:9**

They set their mouth into heaven, and their tongue passed through earth.

**Psalms 72:10**

Therefore my people will return here, and full days will be found for them.

**Psalms 72:11**

And they said, How did God know? And is there knowledge in Most High?

**Psalms 72:12**

**Psalms 72:13**

**Psalms 72:14**

And I became scourged whole day, and my reproof unto mornings.

**Psalms 72:15**

If I said, I will tell thus, behold, against generation of your sons I acted treacherously.

**Psalms 72:16**

And I undertook to know this; it is trouble before me,

**Psalms 72:17**

**Psalms 72:18**

Surely because of their deceits you set things for them; you cast them down in their being lifted up.

**Psalms 72:19**

**Psalms 72:20**

Like dream of one waking, Lord, in your city you will despise their image.

**Psalms 72:21**

Because my heart burned and my kidneys were altered,

**Psalms 72:22**

and I, being despised, did not know; I became beastlike beside you.

**Psalms 72:23**

And I continually with you; you held my right hand.

**Psalms 72:24**

In your counsel you guided me, and with glory you received me.

**Psalms 72:25**

**Psalms 72:26**

My heart and my flesh failed; God of my heart and my portion, God forever.

**Psalms 72:27**

Because behold, those distancing themselves from you will perish; you destroyed everyone prostituting himself away from you.

**Psalms 72:28**

But for me, clinging to God good; to place hope in Lord, to declare all your praises in gates of daughter of Zion.

### Chapter 73

**Psalms 73:1**

For understanding. Of Asaph. Why, O God, did you reject to end? Your anger burned against sheep of your pasture.

**Psalms 73:2**

Remember your congregation which you acquired from beginning; you redeemed rod of your inheritance, this Mount Zion in which you dwelt.

**Psalms 73:3**

**Psalms 73:4**

**Psalms 73:5**

**Psalms 73:6**

**Psalms 73:7**

**Psalms 73:8**

**Psalms 73:9**

**Psalms 73:10**

How long, O God, will enemy reproach? Will adversary provoke your name to end?

**Psalms 73:11**

**Psalms 73:12**

**Psalms 73:13**

**Psalms 73:14**

**Psalms 73:15**

You split open springs and torrents; you dried up rivers of Etham.

**Psalms 73:16**

Yours day and yours night; you prepared light and sun.

**Psalms 73:17**

You made all boundaries of earth; summer and spring you formed them.

**Psalms 73:18**

**Psalms 73:19**

Do not hand over to beasts soul confessing to you; souls of your poor ones do not forget to end.

**Psalms 73:20**

**Psalms 73:21**

Let humbled one not turn back shamed; poor and needy will praise your name.

**Psalms 73:22**

Rise up, O God, judge your case; remember your reproaches from fool all day.

**Psalms 73:23**

### Chapter 74

**Psalms 74:1**

For end, do not destroy. Psalm of Asaph. Song.

**Psalms 74:2**

We will confess to you, O God, we will confess, and we will call on your name.

**Psalms 74:3**

I will tell all your wonders when I receive appointed time; I will judge uprightnesses.

**Psalms 74:4**

Earth melted, and all inhabiting it; I strengthened its pillars. Interlude.

**Psalms 74:5**

**Psalms 74:6**

**Psalms 74:7**

**Psalms 74:8**

**Psalms 74:9**

**Psalms 74:10**

**Psalms 74:11**

### Chapter 75

**Psalms 75:1**

For end, in hymns. Psalm of Asaph. Song against Assyrian.

**Psalms 75:2**

**Psalms 75:3**

**Psalms 75:5**

**Psalms 75:6**

**Psalms 75:7**

**Psalms 75:8**

### Chapter 76

**Psalms 76:1**

For end, concerning Jeduthun. Of Asaph. Psalm.

**Psalms 76:2**

My voice cried to Lord, my voice to God, and he attended to me.

**Psalms 76:3**

**Psalms 76:4**

**Psalms 76:5**

My eyes seized first watches; I was troubled and did not speak.

**Psalms 76:6**

**Psalms 76:7**

**Psalms 76:8**

**Psalms 76:9**

**Psalms 76:10**

**Psalms 76:11**

**Psalms 76:12**

**Psalms 76:13**

**Psalms 76:14**

O God, your way in holy place; what god great as our God?

**Psalms 76:15**

**Psalms 76:16**

**Psalms 76:17**

**Psalms 76:18**

**Psalms 76:19**

**Psalms 76:20**

**Psalms 76:21**

You guided your people like sheep by hand of Moses and Aaron.

### Chapter 77

**Psalms 77:1**

For understanding. Of Asaph. Attend, my people, to my law; incline your ear to words of my mouth.

**Psalms 77:2**

I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter riddles from beginning,

**Psalms 77:3**

**Psalms 77:4**

**Psalms 77:5**

**Psalms 77:6**

**Psalms 77:7**

**Psalms 77:8**

**Psalms 77:9**

Sons of Ephraim, stringing and shooting bows, turned back in day of war.

**Psalms 77:10**

They did not keep covenant of God and did not want to walk in his law.

**Psalms 77:11**

And they forgot his good deeds and his wonders which he showed them,

**Psalms 77:12**

things he did wondrously before their fathers in land of Egypt, in plain of Tanis.

**Psalms 77:13**

He split sea and led them through; he made waters stand like wineskin.

**Psalms 77:14**

And he guided them in cloud by day and all night in light of fire.

**Psalms 77:15**

He split rock in wilderness and gave them drink as from great deep.

**Psalms 77:16**

And he brought water out from rock and brought waters down like rivers.

**Psalms 77:17**

And they added still to sin against him; they provoked Most High in waterless place.

**Psalms 77:18**

And they tested God in their hearts by asking foods for their souls.

**Psalms 77:19**

And they spoke against God and said, Will God be able to prepare table in wilderness?

**Psalms 77:20**

Since he struck rock and waters flowed and torrents overflowed, can he also give bread or prepare table for his people?

**Psalms 77:21**

Therefore Lord heard and deferred, and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath rose upon Israel,

**Psalms 77:22**

because they did not believe in God nor hope on his salvation.

**Psalms 77:23**

And he commanded clouds above and opened doors of heaven,

**Psalms 77:24**

and rained manna on them to eat and gave them bread of heaven.

**Psalms 77:25**

Man ate bread of angels; he sent them provision unto fullness.

**Psalms 77:26**

He lifted south wind from heaven and brought in by his dominion southwest wind.

**Psalms 77:27**

And he rained flesh upon them like dust and winged birds like sand of seas.

**Psalms 77:28**

And they fell into midst of their camp, around their tents.

**Psalms 77:29**

And they ate and were filled exceedingly, and he brought them their desire.

**Psalms 77:30**

They were not deprived of their desire; while their food was still in their mouth,

**Psalms 77:31**

wrath of God rose upon them and killed among their fat ones and hamstrung chosen ones of Israel.

**Psalms 77:32**

In all these things they still sinned and did not believe in his wonders.

**Psalms 77:33**

And their days failed in vanity and their years in haste.

**Psalms 77:34**

When he killed them, they sought him, and returned and rose early toward God.

**Psalms 77:35**

And they remembered that God is their helper and God Most High their redeemer.

**Psalms 77:36**

And they deceived him with their mouth and lied to him with their tongue.

**Psalms 77:37**

But their heart was not straight with him, nor were they faithful in his covenant.

**Psalms 77:38**

But he compassionate and will propitiate their sins and not destroy, and he will multiply turning away his wrath and will not kindle all his anger.

**Psalms 77:39**

And he remembered that they are flesh, spirit going and not returning.

**Psalms 77:40**

How often they provoked him in wilderness, angered him in waterless land.

**Psalms 77:41**

And they turned and tested God and provoked Holy One of Israel.

**Psalms 77:42**

They did not remember his hand, day when he redeemed them from hand of afflicter,

**Psalms 77:43**

how he set his signs in Egypt and his wonders in plain of Tanis,

**Psalms 77:44**

and turned their rivers into blood and their rainfalls so they might not drink.

**Psalms 77:45**

He sent upon them dog-fly and it devoured them, and frog and it ruined them.

**Psalms 77:46**

And he gave their fruit to mildew and their labors to locust.

**Psalms 77:47**

He killed their vine with hail and their sycamores with frost.

**Psalms 77:48**

And he handed over their cattle to hail and their possessions to fire.

**Psalms 77:49**

He sent upon them wrath of his anger, anger and fury and affliction, dispatch by evil angels.

**Psalms 77:50**

He made way for his anger; he did not spare their souls from death and enclosed their cattle in death.

**Psalms 77:51**

And he struck every firstborn in Egypt, first fruits of their labors in tents of Ham.

**Psalms 77:52**

And he lifted up his people like sheep and led them like flock in wilderness.

**Psalms 77:53**

And he guided them in hope and they did not fear, and sea covered their enemies.

**Psalms 77:54**

And he brought them into boundary of his sanctuary, this mountain which his right hand acquired.

**Psalms 77:55**

And he cast out nations from before them and gave them inheritance by measuring line and made tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.

**Psalms 77:56**

And they tested and provoked God Most High, and his testimonies they did not keep.

**Psalms 77:57**

And they turned back and broke covenant just as their fathers, and were twisted into crooked bow.

**Psalms 77:58**

And they angered him with their hills and with their carved images stirred him to jealousy.

**Psalms 77:59**

God heard and disregarded and greatly despised Israel.

**Psalms 77:60**

And he rejected tent of Shilom, his tabernacle where he dwelt among men.

**Psalms 77:61**

And he gave their strength into captivity and their beauty into hand of enemy.

**Psalms 77:62**

And he enclosed his people to sword and disregarded his inheritance.

**Psalms 77:63**

Fire devoured their young men, and their virgins were not mourned.

**Psalms 77:64**

Their priests fell by sword, and their widows will not be wept.

**Psalms 77:65**

And Lord awoke like one sleeping, like mighty man sobered from wine.

**Psalms 77:66**

And he struck his enemies backward; everlasting reproach he gave them.

**Psalms 77:67**

And he rejected tent of Joseph, and tribe of Ephraim he did not choose.

**Psalms 77:68**

And he chose tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

**Psalms 77:69**

And he built his sanctuary like unicorns; on earth he founded it forever.

**Psalms 77:70**

And he chose David his servant and took him up from flocks of sheep.

**Psalms 77:71**

From behind nursing ones he took him to shepherd Jacob his people and Israel his inheritance.

**Psalms 77:72**

And he shepherded them in innocence of his heart and guided them in understandings of his hands.

### Chapter 78

**Psalms 78:1**

Psalm of Asaph. O God, nations came into your inheritance; they defiled your holy temple; they made Jerusalem into orchard-watch hut.

**Psalms 78:2**

They set dead bodies of your servants as food to birds of heaven, flesh of your holy ones to beasts of earth.

**Psalms 78:3**

**Psalms 78:4**

**Psalms 78:5**

**Psalms 78:6**

**Psalms 78:7**

**Psalms 78:8**

**Psalms 78:9**

**Psalms 78:10**

**Psalms 78:11**

**Psalms 78:12**

**Psalms 78:13**

### Chapter 79

**Psalms 79:1**

**Psalms 79:20**

### Chapter 80

Song of psalm of Asaph.

tents of Idumeans and Ishmaelites, Moab and Hagarenes,

**Psalms 82:8**

Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, foreigners with those dwelling in Tyre.

**Psalms 82:9**

For Asshur also came along with them; they became support to sons of Lot. Interlude.

**Psalms 82:10**

Do to them as to Midian and to Sisera, as to Jabin at torrent Kishon.

**Psalms 82:11**

They were destroyed at Endor; they became like dung for earth.

**Psalms 82:12**

Make their rulers like Oreb and Zeeb and Zebee and Salmana, all their rulers,

**Psalms 82:13**

who said, Let us inherit sanctuary of God for ourselves.

**Psalms 82:14**

My God, make them like wheel, like stubble before wind,

**Psalms 82:15**

as fire kindles forest, as flame burns mountains,

**Psalms 82:16**

so you will pursue them in your storm, and in your anger you will trouble them.

**Psalms 82:17**

Fill their faces with dishonor, and they will seek your name, Lord.

**Psalms 82:18**

Let them be shamed and troubled forever and ever, and let them be disgraced and perish.

**Psalms 82:19**

And let them know that your name Lord, you alone Most High over all earth.

### Chapter 83

**Psalms 83:1**

For end, concerning winepresses, for sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 83:2**

How beloved your tabernacles, Lord of hosts.

**Psalms 83:3**

My soul longs and fails for courts of Lord; my heart and my flesh exulted in living God.

**Psalms 83:4**

For even sparrow found house for itself, and turtledove nest for herself where she may place her nestlings: your altars, Lord of hosts, my king and my God.

**Psalms 83:5**

Blessed those dwelling in your house; forever and ever they will praise you. Interlude.

**Psalms 83:6**

Blessed man whose support is from you, Lord; ascents in his heart he arranged,

**Psalms 83:7**

in valley of weeping, into place he appointed; for lawgiver will also give blessings.

**Psalms 83:8**

They will go from strength to strength; God of gods will be seen in Zion.

**Psalms 83:9**

Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Interlude.

**Psalms 83:10**

Our defender, see, O God, and look upon face of your anointed.

**Psalms 83:11**

Because one day in your courts better than thousands; I chose to be cast aside in house of God rather than dwell in tents of sinners.

**Psalms 83:12**

Because the Lord God loves mercy and truth; the Lord will give grace and glory; he will not withhold good things from those walking in innocence.

**Psalms 83:13**

Lord of hosts, blessed man hoping on you.

### Chapter 84

**Psalms 84:1**

For end, for sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 84:2**

You took pleasure, Lord, in your land; you turned back captivity of Jacob.

**Psalms 84:3**

You forgave lawlessnesses of your people; you covered all their sins. Interlude.

**Psalms 84:4**

You stopped all your anger; you turned back from wrath of your anger.

**Psalms 84:5**

Turn us back, God of our salvations, and turn your anger away from us.

**Psalms 84:6**

Will you be angry with us forever, or stretch your anger from generation to generation?

**Psalms 84:7**

O God, you, turning back, will make us live, and your people will rejoice in you.

**Psalms 84:8**

Show us, Lord, your mercy, and give us your salvation.

**Psalms 84:9**

I will hear what Lord God will speak in me, because he will speak peace upon his people and upon his holy ones and upon those turning heart toward him.

**Psalms 84:10**

Surely his salvation near those fearing him, so that glory may dwell in our land.

**Psalms 84:11**

Mercy and truth met together; righteousness and peace kissed.

**Psalms 84:12**

Truth rose from earth, and righteousness looked down from heaven.

**Psalms 84:13**

For Lord will give goodness, and our land will give its fruit.

**Psalms 84:14**

Righteousness will go before him and set his footsteps in way.

### Chapter 85

**Psalms 85:1**

Prayer of David. Incline your ear, Lord, and hear me, because I poor and needy.

**Psalms 85:2**

Guard my soul, because I holy; save your servant, my God, hoping on you.

**Psalms 85:3**

Have mercy on me, Lord, because to you I will cry whole day.

**Psalms 85:4**

Gladden soul of your servant, because to you, Lord, I lifted my soul.

**Psalms 85:5**

Because you, Lord, kind and gentle and rich in mercy to all calling on you.

**Psalms 85:6**

Give ear, Lord, to my prayer and attend to voice of my supplication.

**Psalms 85:7**

In day of my affliction I cried to you, because you heard me.

**Psalms 85:8**

There is none like you among gods, Lord, and none according to your works.

**Psalms 85:9**

All nations, as many as you made, will come and worship before you, Lord, and will glorify your name.

**Psalms 85:10**

Because you great and doing wonders; you alone the great God.

**Psalms 85:11**

Guide me, Lord, in your way, and I will walk in your truth; let my heart rejoice to fear your name.

**Psalms 85:12**

I will confess to you, Lord my God, with whole heart, and I will glorify your name forever.

**Psalms 85:13**

Because your mercy great upon me, and you rescued my soul from lowest Hades.

**Psalms 85:14**

O God, lawless men rose against me, and gathering of strong men sought my soul, and they did not set you before them.

**Psalms 85:15**

But you, Lord God, compassionate and merciful, long-suffering and rich in mercy and true.

**Psalms 85:16**

Look upon me and have mercy on me; give your strength to your child and save son of your handmaid.

**Psalms 85:17**

Do with me sign for good, and let those hating me see and be shamed, because you, Lord, helped me and comforted me.

### Chapter 86

**Psalms 86:1**

For sons of Korah. Psalm of song. His foundations in holy mountains.

**Psalms 86:2**

Lord loves gates of Zion above all tabernacles of Jacob.

**Psalms 86:3**

Glorious things were spoken concerning you, city of God. Interlude.

**Psalms 86:4**

I will remember Rahab and Babylon to those knowing me; behold, foreigners and Tyre and people of Ethiopians, these were born there.

**Psalms 86:5**

Mother Zion, man will say, and man was born in her, and Most High himself founded her.

**Psalms 86:6**

Lord will recount in writing of peoples and rulers, these who were born in her. Interlude.

**Psalms 86:7**

As of all rejoicing ones, dwelling in you.

### Chapter 87

**Psalms 87:1**

Song of psalm for sons of Korah, for end, concerning Maeleth, for answering, for understanding, of Heman the Israelite.

**Psalms 87:2**

Lord God of my salvation, by day I cried and by night before you.

**Psalms 87:3**

Let my prayer enter before you; incline your ear to my supplication, Lord.

**Psalms 87:4**

Because my soul was filled with evils, and my life drew near to Hades.

**Psalms 87:5**

I was counted with those going down into pit; I became like helpless man among dead, free,

**Psalms 87:6**

like wounded ones cast down, sleeping in tomb, whom you no longer remembered and they were thrust away from your hand.

**Psalms 87:7**

They set me in lowest pit, in dark places and in shadow of death.

**Psalms 87:8**

Your wrath was fixed upon me, and all your surges you brought upon me. Interlude.

**Psalms 87:9**

You removed my acquaintances from me; they made me abomination to themselves. I was handed over and did not go out.

**Psalms 87:10**

My eyes grew weak from poverty; I cried to you, Lord, whole day; I spread out my hands to you.

**Psalms 87:11**

Will you do wonders for dead, or will physicians raise them and confess to you?

**Psalms 87:12**

Will anyone recount your mercy in tomb, and your truth in destruction?

**Psalms 87:13**

Will your wonders be known in darkness and your righteousness in forgotten land?

**Psalms 87:14**

But I cried to you, Lord, and in morning my prayer will go before you.

**Psalms 87:15**

Why, Lord, do you reject my soul? You turn your face away from me.

**Psalms 87:16**

I poor and in labors from my youth; having been exalted, I was humbled and came to despair.

**Psalms 87:17**

Your angers passed over me, and your terrors troubled me.

**Psalms 87:18**

They encircled me like water whole day; together they surrounded me.

**Psalms 87:19**

You removed friend and neighbor from me and my acquaintances from misery.

### Chapter 88

**Psalms 88:1**

For understanding. Of Ethan the Israelite.

**Psalms 88:2**

Your mercies, Lord, forever I will sing; from generation to generation I will declare your truth with my mouth.

**Psalms 88:3**

Because you said, Mercy will be built forever; in heavens your truth will be prepared.

**Psalms 88:4**

I arranged covenant with my chosen ones; I swore to David my servant,

**Psalms 88:5**

Until age I will prepare your seed and build your throne to generation and generation. Interlude.

**Psalms 88:6**

Heavens will confess your wonders, Lord, and your truth in assembly of holy ones.

**Psalms 88:7**

Because who in clouds will be made equal to Lord, and who will be likened to Lord among sons of God?

**Psalms 88:8**

God glorified in council of holy ones, great and fearful above all around him.

**Psalms 88:9**

Lord God of hosts, who like you? Mighty are you, Lord, and your truth around you.

**Psalms 88:10**

You rule power of sea, and disturbance of its waves you calm.

**Psalms 88:11**

You humbled proud one like wounded man, and with arm of your power you scattered your enemies.

**Psalms 88:12**

Yours the heavens and yours the earth; inhabited world and its fullness, you founded them.

**Psalms 88:13**

North and seas you created; Tabor and Hermon will exult in your name.

**Psalms 88:14**

Yours the arm with dominion; let your hand be strengthened; let your right hand be exalted.

**Psalms 88:15**

Righteousness and judgment preparation of your throne; mercy and truth will go before your face.

**Psalms 88:16**

Blessed people knowing shout; Lord, in light of your face they will walk.

**Psalms 88:17**

And in your name they will exult whole day, and in your righteousness they will be exalted.

**Psalms 88:18**

Because you boast of their power, and in your good pleasure our horn will be exalted.

**Psalms 88:19**

Because support belongs to Lord, and to Holy One of Israel, our king.

**Psalms 88:20**

Then you spoke in vision to your holy ones and said, I set help upon mighty one; I exalted chosen one from my people.

**Psalms 88:21**

I found David my servant; with my holy oil I anointed him.

**Psalms 88:22**

For my hand will support him, and my arm will strengthen him.

**Psalms 88:23**

Enemy will not profit in him, and son of lawlessness will not add to harm him.

**Psalms 88:24**

And I will cut down his enemies from before him, and those hating him I will rout.

**Psalms 88:25**

And my truth and my mercy with him, and in my name his horn will be exalted.

**Psalms 88:26**

And I will set his hand in sea and his right hand in rivers.

**Psalms 88:27**

He will call upon me, You are my father, my God and supporter of my salvation.

**Psalms 88:28**

And I will set him firstborn, high above kings of earth.

**Psalms 88:29**

Forever I will keep my mercy for him, and my covenant faithful to him.

**Psalms 88:30**

And I will set his seed forever and ever and his throne as days of heaven.

**Psalms 88:31**

If his sons forsake my law and do not walk in my judgments,

**Psalms 88:32**

if they profane my ordinances and do not keep my commandments,

**Psalms 88:33**

I will visit their lawlessnesses with rod and their sins with whips.

**Psalms 88:34**

But my mercy I will certainly not scatter from him, nor will I act unjustly in my truth.

**Psalms 88:35**

Nor will I profane my covenant, and what goes out through my lips I will certainly not set aside.

**Psalms 88:36**

Once I swore in my holy place: will I lie to David?

**Psalms 88:37**

His seed remains forever, and his throne as sun before me,

**Psalms 88:38**

and as moon established forever, and witness in heaven faithful. Interlude.

**Psalms 88:39**

But you rejected and despised; you deferred your anointed.

**Psalms 88:40**

You overturned covenant of your servant; you profaned his sanctuary to earth.

**Psalms 88:41**

You pulled down all his fences; you made his strongholds fear.

**Psalms 88:42**

All passing by road plundered him; he became reproach to his neighbors.

**Psalms 88:43**

You exalted right hand of his enemies; you gladdened all his enemies.

**Psalms 88:44**

You turned back help of his sword and did not support him in war.

**Psalms 88:45**

You dissolved him from cleansing; his throne you shattered to earth.

**Psalms 88:46**

You shortened days of his time; you poured out shame upon him. Interlude.

**Psalms 88:47**

How long, Lord? Will you turn away to end? Will your anger burn like fire?

**Psalms 88:48**

Remember what my substance is; for not in vain did you create all sons of men.

**Psalms 88:49**

Who is man who will live and not see death? Will he rescue his soul from hand of Hades? Interlude.

**Psalms 88:50**

Where are your former mercies, Lord, which you swore to David in your truth?

**Psalms 88:51**

Remember, Lord, reproach of your servants, which I bore in my bosom from many nations,

**Psalms 88:52**

with which your enemies reproached, Lord, with which they reproached exchange of your anointed.

**Psalms 88:53**

Blessed Lord forever. Amen, amen.

### Chapter 89

**Psalms 89:1**

Prayer of Moses, man of God. Lord, you became refuge to us in generation and generation.

**Psalms 89:2**

Before mountains were born and earth and inhabited world were formed, from age until age you are.

**Psalms 89:3**

Do not turn man away into humiliation; and you said, Return, sons of men.

**Psalms 89:4**

Because thousand years in your eyes like yesterday day that passed and like watch in night.

**Psalms 89:5**

Their despised things will be years; in morning like grass let it pass away.

**Psalms 89:6**

In morning let it flower and pass away; in evening let it fall, grow hard, and dry up.

**Psalms 89:7**

Because we failed in your anger and in your fury we were troubled.

**Psalms 89:8**

You set our lawlessnesses before you, our age in light of your face.

**Psalms 89:9**

Because all our days failed, and in your anger we failed; our years I kept meditating like spider.

**Psalms 89:10**

Days of our years, in them seventy years; and if in dominions, eighty years; and more of them labor and pain, because meekness came upon us and we will be disciplined.

**Psalms 89:11**

Who knows strength of your anger and from your fear your fury?

**Psalms 89:12**

To number your right hand, thus make known, and those bound in heart in wisdom.

**Psalms 89:13**

Turn back, Lord, how long, and be comforted over your servants.

**Psalms 89:14**

We were filled in morning with your mercy, and we exulted and rejoiced in all our days.

**Psalms 89:15**

We rejoiced for days in which you humbled us, years in which we saw evils.

**Psalms 89:16**

And look upon your servants and your works and guide their sons.

**Psalms 89:17**

And let brightness of Lord our God be upon us, and works of our hands direct upon us.

### Chapter 90

**Psalms 90:1**

Praise, song of David. One dwelling in help of Most High will lodge in shelter of God of heaven.

**Psalms 90:2**

He will say to Lord, You are my supporter and my refuge, my God; I will hope on him.

**Psalms 90:3**

Because he will rescue me from snare of hunters and from troubled word.

**Psalms 90:4**

With his shoulders he will overshadow you, and under his wings you will hope; his truth will encircle you with shield.

**Psalms 90:5**

You will not fear from night fear, from arrow flying by day,

**Psalms 90:6**

from thing passing in darkness, from mishap and midday demon.

**Psalms 90:7**

A thousand will fall from your side and ten thousand from your right, but it will not come near you.

**Psalms 90:8**

Only with your eyes you will observe and see repayment of sinners.

**Psalms 90:9**

Because you, Lord, my hope; you made Most High your refuge.

**Psalms 90:10**

Evils will not come near you, and scourge will not draw near your tent.

**Psalms 90:11**

Because he will command his angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.

**Psalms 90:12**

On hands they will carry you, lest you strike your foot against stone.

**Psalms 90:13**

You will step on asp and basilisk and trample lion and dragon.

**Psalms 90:14**

Because he hoped on me, and I will rescue him; I will shelter him, because he knew my name.

**Psalms 90:15**

He will call upon me, and I will hear him; I am with him in affliction, and I will deliver and glorify him.

**Psalms 90:16**

With length of days I will fill him and show him my salvation.

### Chapter 91

**Psalms 91:1**

Psalm, song for day of Sabbath.

**Psalms 91:2**

Good thing to confess to Lord and sing to your name, Most High,

**Psalms 91:3**

to proclaim in morning your mercy and your truth by night,

**Psalms 91:4**

on ten-stringed psaltery, with song on lyre.

**Psalms 91:5**

Because you gladdened me, Lord, in your workmanship, and in works of your hands I will exult.

**Psalms 91:6**

How your works were magnified, Lord; your thoughts were made very deep.

**Psalms 91:7**

Foolish man will not know, and senseless man will not understand these things:

**Psalms 91:8**

when sinners spring up like grass and all workers of lawlessness peered out, so that they might be destroyed forever and ever.

**Psalms 91:9**

But you, Most High forever, Lord.

**Psalms 91:10**

Because behold, your enemies will perish, and all workers of lawlessness will be scattered.

**Psalms 91:11**

And my horn will be exalted like unicorn, and my old age in rich oil.

**Psalms 91:12**

And my eye looked upon my enemies, and on those rising against me doing evil my ear will hear.

**Psalms 91:13**

Righteous one will flower like palm tree; like cedar in Lebanon he will multiply.

**Psalms 91:14**

Planted in house of Lord, in courts of our God they will flower.

**Psalms 91:15**

They will still multiply in rich old age and be prospering,

**Psalms 91:16**

to declare that Lord my God upright, and there is no injustice in him.

### Chapter 92

**Psalms 92:1**

For day before Sabbath, when earth was settled. Praise, song of David. Lord reigned; he clothed himself with beauty, Lord clothed himself with power and girded himself; for he also made firm inhabited world which will not be shaken.

**Psalms 92:2**

Your throne ready from then; from age you are.

**Psalms 92:3**

Rivers lifted up, Lord, rivers lifted up their voices.

**Psalms 92:4**

From voices of many waters, wondrous the surges of sea; wondrous in heights Lord.

**Psalms 92:5**

Your testimonies were made very faithful; holiness fits your house, Lord, for length of days.

### Chapter 93

**Psalms 93:1**

Psalm of David, fourth of Sabbaths. God of vengeances, Lord; God of vengeances spoke openly.

**Psalms 93:2**

Be exalted, judge of earth; repay recompense to proud ones.

**Psalms 93:3**

How long, sinners, Lord, how long will sinners boast?

**Psalms 93:4**

They will utter and speak injustice; all workers of lawlessness will speak.

**Psalms 93:5**

Your people, Lord, they humbled, and your inheritance they afflicted.

**Psalms 93:6**

Widow and sojourner they killed, and orphans they murdered.

**Psalms 93:7**

And they said, Lord will not see, nor will God of Jacob understand.

**Psalms 93:8**

Understand now, foolish ones among people, and senseless ones, when will you understand?

**Psalms 93:9**

One planting ear, does he not hear? One forming eye, does he not perceive?

**Psalms 93:10**

One disciplining nations, will he not reprove? One teaching man knowledge?

**Psalms 93:11**

Lord knows thoughts of men, that they are vain.

**Psalms 93:12**

Blessed man whom you discipline, Lord, and teach from your law,

**Psalms 93:13**

to make him gentle away from evil days until pit be dug for sinner.

**Psalms 93:14**

Because Lord will not reject his people and will not forsake his inheritance,

**Psalms 93:15**

until righteousness returns to judgment, and all straight in heart close behind it. Interlude.

**Psalms 93:16**

Who will rise for me against evil-doers, or who will stand with me against workers of lawlessness?

**Psalms 93:17**

If not that Lord helped me, my soul would almost have dwelt in Hades.

**Psalms 93:18**

If I said, My foot was shaken, your mercy, Lord, was helping me.

**Psalms 93:19**

Lord, according to multitude of my pains in my heart, your comforts loved my soul.

**Psalms 93:20**

Will throne of lawlessness join itself with you, one fashioning labor by ordinance?

**Psalms 93:21**

They will hunt against soul of righteous man and condemn innocent blood.

**Psalms 93:22**

And Lord became refuge to me, and my God helper of my hope.

**Psalms 93:23**

And he will repay them their lawlessness and in their evil he will destroy them, Lord our God.

### Chapter 94

**Psalms 94:1**

Praise, song of David. Come, let us exult in Lord; let us shout to God our savior.

**Psalms 94:2**

Let us come before his face in confession, and in psalms let us shout to him.

**Psalms 94:3**

Because great God Lord and great king over all gods,

**Psalms 94:4**

because ends of earth in his hand and heights of mountains his.

**Psalms 94:5**

Because sea his and he made it, and dry land his hands formed.

**Psalms 94:6**

Come, let us worship and fall down before him and weep before Lord who made us,

**Psalms 94:7**

because he our God and we people of his pasture and sheep of his hand. Today, if you hear his voice,

**Psalms 94:8**

do not harden your hearts as in provocation, according to day of testing in wilderness,

**Psalms 94:9**

where your fathers tested me, tried me, and saw my works.

**Psalms 94:10**

Forty years I felt loathing toward that generation and said, They always go astray in heart, and they did not know my ways,

**Psalms 94:11**

as I swore in my anger, They will not enter into my rest.

### Chapter 95

**Psalms 95:1**

When house was being built after captivity. Song of David. Sing to Lord new song; sing to Lord, all earth.

**Psalms 95:2**

Sing to Lord; bless his name; bring good news day from day of his salvation.

**Psalms 95:3**

Declare among nations his glory, among all peoples his wonders.

**Psalms 95:4**

Because great Lord and greatly praised; fearful he over all gods.

**Psalms 95:5**

Because all gods of nations demons, but Lord made heavens.

**Psalms 95:6**

Confession and beauty before him, holiness and magnificence in his sanctuary.

**Psalms 95:7**

Bring to Lord, families of nations, bring to Lord glory and honor.

**Psalms 95:8**

Bring to Lord glory to his name; take sacrifices and enter into his courts.

**Psalms 95:9**

Worship Lord in his holy court; let all earth be shaken from before him.

**Psalms 95:10**

Say among nations, Lord reigned, for he also set inhabited world straight, which will not be shaken; he will judge peoples in uprightness.

**Psalms 95:11**

Let heavens rejoice and earth exult; let sea be shaken and its fullness.

**Psalms 95:12**

Fields will be glad and all things in them; then all trees of forest will exult

**Psalms 95:13**

### Chapter 96

**Psalms 96:1**

Of David, when his land is established. Lord reigned; let earth exult; let many islands rejoice.

**Psalms 96:2**

Cloud and gloom around him; righteousness and judgment correction of his throne.

**Psalms 96:3**

Fire will go before him and flame around his enemies.

**Psalms 96:4**

His lightnings shone to inhabited world; earth saw and was shaken.

**Psalms 96:5**

Mountains melted like wax from face of Lord, from face of Lord of all earth.

**Psalms 96:6**

Heavens declared his righteousness, and all peoples saw his glory.

**Psalms 96:7**

**Psalms 96:8**

**Psalms 96:9**

**Psalms 96:10**

You loving Lord, hate evil; Lord guards souls of his holy ones; from hand of sinners he will rescue them.

**Psalms 96:11**

**Psalms 96:12**

Rejoice, righteous ones, in Lord, and confess to memory of his holiness.

### Chapter 97

**Psalms 97:1**

Psalm of David. Sing to Lord new song, because Lord did wondrous things; his right hand saved for him, and his holy arm.

**Psalms 97:2**

Lord made known his salvation; before nations he revealed his righteousness.

**Psalms 97:3**

He remembered his mercy to Jacob and his truth to house of Israel; all ends of earth saw salvation of our God.

**Psalms 97:4**

Shout to God, all earth; sing and exult and make melody.

**Psalms 97:5**

Make melody to Lord with lyre, with lyre and voice of psalm,

**Psalms 97:6**

with hammered trumpets and voice of horn trumpet; shout before king, Lord.

**Psalms 97:7**

Let sea be shaken and its fullness, inhabited world and those dwelling in it.

**Psalms 97:8**

Rivers will clap with hand; together mountains will exult,

**Psalms 97:9**

because he comes to judge earth; he will judge inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in uprightness.

### Chapter 98

**Psalms 98:1**

Psalm of David. Lord reigned; let peoples be angry; one sitting upon cherubim, let earth be shaken.

**Psalms 98:2**

Lord great in Zion and high over all peoples.

**Psalms 98:3**

Let them confess to your name, the great one, because it fearful and holy.

**Psalms 98:4**

And honor of king loves judgment. You prepared uprightnesses; judgment and righteousness in Jacob you did.

**Psalms 98:5**

Exalt Lord our God and worship at footstool of his feet, because holy he is.

**Psalms 98:6**

Moses and Aaron among his priests and Samuel among those calling on his name; they called on Lord, and he heard them.

**Psalms 98:7**

**Psalms 98:8**

### Chapter 99

**Psalms 99:1**

Psalm for confession. Shout to Lord, all earth.

**Psalms 99:2**

**Psalms 99:3**

**Psalms 99:4**

**Psalms 99:5**

Because Lord kind; forever his mercy, and unto generation and generation his truth.

### Chapter 100

**Psalms 100:1**

Of David. Psalm. Mercy and judgment I will sing to you, Lord.

**Psalms 100:2**

I will sing and understand in blameless way. When will you come to me? I walked in innocence of my heart in midst of my house.

**Psalms 100:3**

I did not set before my eyes lawless thing; those doing transgressions I hated.

**Psalms 100:4**

Crooked heart did not cling to me; when evil one turned away from me, I did not know him.

**Psalms 100:5**

One slandering his neighbor secretly, this one I drove out; one with proud eye and insatiable heart, with this one I did not eat.

**Psalms 100:6**

My eyes upon faithful ones of earth, so that they may sit with me; one walking in blameless way, this one served me.

**Psalms 100:7**

One doing pride did not dwell in midst of my house; one speaking unjust things did not go straight before my eyes.

**Psalms 100:8**

In mornings I killed all sinners of earth, to destroy from city of Lord all workers of lawlessness.

### Chapter 101

**Psalms 101:1**

Prayer for poor man, when he grows faint and pours out his supplication before Lord.

**Psalms 101:2**

Hear, Lord, my prayer, and let my cry come to you.

**Psalms 101:3**

Do not turn your face from me in whatever day I am afflicted; incline your ear to me; in whatever day I call on you, quickly hear me.

**Psalms 101:4**

Because my days failed like smoke, and my bones were scorched like brushwood.

**Psalms 101:5**

My heart was struck like grass and dried up, because I forgot to eat my bread.

**Psalms 101:6**

From voice of my groaning, my bone clung to my flesh.

**Psalms 101:7**

I became like desert pelican; I became like night-raven in ruined place.

**Psalms 101:8**

I kept watch and became like sparrow solitary on housetop.

**Psalms 101:9**

Whole day my enemies reproached me, and those praising me swore against me.

**Psalms 101:10**

Because I ate ash like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,

**Psalms 101:11**

**Psalms 101:12**

My days declined like shadow, and I dried up like grass.

**Psalms 101:13**

But you, Lord, remain forever, and your memorial to generation and generation.

**Psalms 101:14**

You, rising up, will have compassion on Zion, because time to pity her, because time came.

**Psalms 101:15**

**Psalms 101:16**

And nations will fear name of Lord, and all kings of earth your glory.

**Psalms 101:17**

Because Lord will build Zion and will be seen in his glory.

**Psalms 101:18**

He looked upon prayer of humble ones and did not despise their supplication.

**Psalms 101:19**

Let this be written for another generation, and people being created will praise Lord,

**Psalms 101:20**

because he looked down from height of his holy place; Lord from heaven looked upon earth,

**Psalms 101:21**

to hear groaning of chained ones, to loose sons of those put to death,

**Psalms 101:22**

to declare in Zion name of Lord and his praise in Jerusalem,

**Psalms 101:23**

when peoples are gathered together and kingdoms to serve Lord.

**Psalms 101:24**

He answered him in way of his strength, Tell me fewness of my days.

**Psalms 101:25**

Do not bring me up in half of my days; your years through generations of generations.

**Psalms 101:26**

At beginnings, you, Lord, founded earth, and heavens works of your hands.

**Psalms 101:27**

They will perish, but you remain; and all will grow old like garment, and like cloak you will change them, and they will be changed.

**Psalms 101:28**

But you same, and your years will not fail.

**Psalms 101:29**

Sons of your servants will dwell, and their seed will be directed forever.

### Chapter 102

**Psalms 102:1**

Of David. Bless Lord, my soul, and all within me, his holy name.

**Psalms 102:2**

Bless Lord, my soul, and do not forget all his repayments,

**Psalms 102:3**

the one propitiating all your lawlessnesses, the one healing all your diseases,

**Psalms 102:4**

**Psalms 102:5**

**Psalms 102:6**

Lord doing mercies and judgment for all suffering injustice.

**Psalms 102:7**

**Psalms 102:8**

**Psalms 102:9**

**Psalms 102:10**

**Psalms 102:11**

**Psalms 102:12**

**Psalms 102:13**

**Psalms 102:14**

**Psalms 102:15**

Man, his days like grass; like flower of field, so he will flower.

**Psalms 102:16**

**Psalms 102:17**

But mercy of Lord from age and until age upon those fearing him, and his righteousness upon sons of sons,

**Psalms 102:18**

**Psalms 102:19**

Lord prepared his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules all.

**Psalms 102:20**

Bless Lord, all his angels, mighty in strength, doing his word, to hear voice of his words.

**Psalms 102:21**

Bless Lord, all his powers, his ministers doing his will.

**Psalms 102:22**

Bless Lord, all his works, in every place of his lordship; bless Lord, my soul.

### Chapter 103

**Psalms 103:1**

Of David. Bless Lord, my soul. Lord my God, you were made exceedingly great; confession and beauty you clothed yourself with,

**Psalms 103:2**

wrapping yourself in light like garment, stretching out heaven like skin,

**Psalms 103:3**

roofing his upper rooms in waters, setting clouds as his ascent, walking on wings of winds,

**Psalms 103:4**

making his angels spirits and his ministers flaming fire,

**Psalms 103:5**

who founded earth on its security; it will not be inclined forever and ever.

**Psalms 103:6**

Deep like garment its covering; on mountains waters will stand.

**Psalms 103:7**

From your rebuke they will flee; from voice of your thunder they will fear.

**Psalms 103:8**

**Psalms 103:9**

You set boundary they will not pass, nor return to cover earth.

**Psalms 103:10**

One sending out springs in valleys; among mountains waters will pass.

**Psalms 103:11**

They give drink to all beasts of field; wild donkeys will receive for their thirst.

**Psalms 103:12**

Upon them birds of heaven will dwell; from midst of rocks they will give voice.

**Psalms 103:13**

One watering mountains from his upper rooms; from fruit of your works earth will be satisfied.

**Psalms 103:14**

One causing grass to spring up for cattle and green plant for service of men, to bring bread out of earth,

**Psalms 103:15**

**Psalms 103:16**

Trees of plain will be filled, cedars of Lebanon which he planted.

**Psalms 103:17**

There sparrows will nest; house of stork leads them.

**Psalms 103:18**

**Psalms 103:19**

**Psalms 103:20**

**Psalms 103:21**

**Psalms 103:22**

**Psalms 103:23**

Man will go out to his work and to his labor until evening.

**Psalms 103:24**
