**Ezekiel 6:10**

And they will know that I, Lord, have spoken.

**Ezekiel 6:11**

Thus says Lord: Clap with hand and stamp with foot and say, Alas, alas, over all abominations of house of Israel. By sword and by death and by famine they will fall.

**Ezekiel 6:12**

One near will fall by sword, one far off will die by pestilence, and one hemmed in will be finished by famine, and I will spend my wrath on them.

**Ezekiel 6:13**

And you will know that I am Lord when your slain are in midst of your idols, around your altars, on every high hill and under every leafy tree, where they gave there fragrant smell to all their idols.

**Ezekiel 6:14**

And I will stretch out my hand against them and make land into desolation and ruin, from wilderness to Deblatha, in all their dwelling places, and they will know that I am Lord.

### Chapter 7

**Ezekiel 7:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 7:2**

And you, son of man, say, Thus says Lord to land of Israel: End has come; end has come upon four wings of land.

**Ezekiel 7:3**

End has come.

**Ezekiel 7:4**

Upon you, one dwelling land, time has come; day has drawn near, not with tumult nor with birth-pains.

**Ezekiel 7:5**

Now from near I pour out my wrath upon you and complete my anger in you, and I will judge you in your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.

**Ezekiel 7:6**

My eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy, because I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am Lord, one striking.

**Ezekiel 7:7**

Now end comes toward you, and I send it upon you, and I will avenge you in your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.

**Ezekiel 7:8**

My eye will not spare you, nor will I show mercy, because I will bring your way upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 7:9**

For thus says Lord.

**Ezekiel 7:10**

Behold, end has come. Behold, day of Lord. See, rod has blossomed; insolence has sprung up.

**Ezekiel 7:11**

And it will break support of lawlessness, not with tumult nor with haste.

**Ezekiel 7:12**

Time has come; behold, day. Buyer must not rejoice, and seller must not mourn.

**Ezekiel 7:13**

**Ezekiel 7:14**

**Ezekiel 7:15**

War with sword outside, and famine and death inside. One in field will die by sword, but famine and death will finish those in city.

**Ezekiel 7:16**

And those rescued from them will be saved and be on mountains. I will kill them all, each in his injustices.

**Ezekiel 7:17**

All hands will grow weak, and all thighs will be defiled with wetness.

**Ezekiel 7:18**

And they will gird on sackcloth, and stupor will cover them, and upon every face shame, and upon every head baldness.

**Ezekiel 7:19**

Their silver will be thrown into streets and their gold will be despised. Their souls will not be filled and their bellies will not be satisfied, because it became torment of their injustices.

**Ezekiel 7:20**

Their chosen ornaments they set for pride, and images of their abominations they made from them; because of this I gave them over to uncleanness.

**Ezekiel 7:21**

And I will hand them over into hands of strangers to plunder them, and to scourges of earth for spoil, and they will profane them.

**Ezekiel 7:22**

And I will turn my face away from them, and they will defile my visitation, and they will enter into it unguarded and profane it.

**Ezekiel 7:23**

And they will make confusion, because land is full of many peoples and city is full of lawlessness.

**Ezekiel 7:24**

And I will turn away arrogance of their strength, and their holy things will be defiled.

**Ezekiel 7:25**

Appeasement will come, and they will seek peace, and it will not be.

**Ezekiel 7:26**

Woe upon woe will be, and report upon report will be, and vision will be sought from prophet, and law will perish from priest and counsel from elders.

**Ezekiel 7:27**

Ruler will put on desolation, and hands of people of land will be paralyzed. According to their ways I will deal with them, and by their judgments I will avenge them, and they will know that I am Lord.

### Chapter 8

**Ezekiel 8:1**

And it happened in sixth year, in fifth month, on fifth of month, I sat in house and elders of Judah sat before me, and hand of Lord came upon me.

**Ezekiel 8:2**

And I saw, and behold, likeness of man: from his loins and downward, fire, and from his loins upward like appearance of electrum.

**Ezekiel 8:3**

And he stretched out likeness of hand and took me by top of my head, and spirit lifted me between earth and heaven and brought me to Jerusalem in vision of God, to forecourt of inner gate facing north, where pillar of the possessor was.

**Ezekiel 8:4**

And behold, there was glory of Lord God of Israel, according to vision I saw in plain.

**Ezekiel 8:5**

And he said to me, Son of man, lift your eyes toward north. And I lifted my eyes toward north, and behold, from north, by gate toward east.

**Ezekiel 8:6**

And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what these are doing? Great lawless deeds they do here, so that I should withdraw from my holy things, and still you will see greater lawless deeds.

**Ezekiel 8:7**

And he brought me to forecourt of court.

**Ezekiel 8:8**

And he said to me, Son of man, dig. And I dug, and behold, one door.

**Ezekiel 8:9**

And he said to me, Enter and see lawless deeds they do here.

**Ezekiel 8:10**

And I entered and saw, and behold, vain abominations and all idols of house of Israel engraved on it all around.

**Ezekiel 8:11**

And seventy men from elders of house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan in midst of them, stood before them, and each had his censer in his hand, and vapor of incense rose up.

**Ezekiel 8:12**

And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what elders of house of Israel do, each in his hidden chamber? For they said, Lord does not see; Lord has abandoned land.

**Ezekiel 8:13**

And he said to me, You will yet see greater lawless deeds that they do.

**Ezekiel 8:14**

And he brought me to forecourt of gate of house of Lord facing north, and behold, there women sat lamenting Tammuz.

**Ezekiel 8:15**

And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen? You will yet see practices greater than these.

**Ezekiel 8:16**

And he brought me into inner court of house of Lord, and behold, at forecourt of temple of Lord, between porch and between altar, about twenty men, their backs toward temple of Lord and their faces opposite, and these were bowing to sun.

**Ezekiel 8:17**

And he said to me, Have you seen, son of man? Is it small thing for house of Judah to do lawless deeds they have done here? For they filled land with lawlessness, and behold, they are like those mocking.

**Ezekiel 8:18**

And I also will act in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy.

### Chapter 9

**Ezekiel 9:1**

And he cried into my ears with loud voice, saying, Near has come vengeance of city, and each had instrument of destruction in his hand.

**Ezekiel 9:2**

And behold, six men came from way of upper gate facing north, and each one had his axe in his hand, and one man in midst of them, clothed in full-length robe, and sapphire belt on his loins; and they entered and stood beside bronze altar.

**Ezekiel 9:3**

And glory of God of Israel went up from cherubim that was upon them to forecourt of house, and he called man clothed in full-length robe who had belt upon his loins.

**Ezekiel 9:4**

And he said to him, Pass through midst of Jerusalem and put mark on foreheads of men groaning and grieving over all lawless deeds done in her midst.

**Ezekiel 9:5**

And to these he said, while I heard, Go after him into city and strike. Let not your eyes spare, and do not show mercy.

**Ezekiel 9:6**

Kill old man and young man and virgin and little children and women, to wiping out, but do not come near any on whom mark is, and begin from my holy things. And they began from elder men who were inside house.

**Ezekiel 9:7**

And he said to them, Defile house and fill ways with dead. Go out and strike.

**Ezekiel 9:8**

And it happened, while they were striking, I fell on my face and cried out and said, Alas, Lord, do you wipe out remnant of Israel when you pour out your wrath upon Jerusalem?

**Ezekiel 9:9**

And he said to me, Injustice of house of Israel and Judah has grown exceedingly, exceedingly, because land was filled with many peoples and city filled with injustice and uncleanness, because they said, Lord has abandoned land; Lord does not see.

**Ezekiel 9:10**

And my eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy. I have put their ways on their heads.

**Ezekiel 9:11**

And behold, man clothed in full-length robe, with belt around his loins, answered saying, I have done just as you commanded me.

### Chapter 10

**Ezekiel 10:1**

And I saw, and behold, above firmament over heads of cherubim, like sapphire stone, likeness of throne upon them.

**Ezekiel 10:2**

And he said to man clothed in robe, Enter into midst of wheels beneath cherubim and fill your hands with coals of fire from midst of cherubim and scatter over city. And he entered before me.

**Ezekiel 10:3**

And cherubim stood on right of house when man went in, and cloud filled inner court.

**Ezekiel 10:4**

And glory of Lord went up from cherubim to forecourt of house, and cloud filled house, and court was filled with brightness of glory of Lord.

**Ezekiel 10:5**

And sound of wings of cherubim was heard as far as outer court, like voice of God Shaddai speaking.

**Ezekiel 10:6**

And it happened when he commanded man clothed in holy robe, saying, Take fire from midst of wheels, from midst of cherubim, and he went in and stood beside wheels.

**Ezekiel 10:7**

And one stretched out his hand into midst of fire that was in midst of cherubim and took and gave into hands of one clothed in holy robe, and he took and went out.

**Ezekiel 10:8**

And I saw on cherubim likeness of human hands beneath their wings.

**Ezekiel 10:9**

And I saw, and behold, four wheels stood beside cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and appearance of wheels like appearance of carbuncle stone.

**Ezekiel 10:10**

And their appearance was one likeness in the four, like wheel within wheel.

**Ezekiel 10:11**

When they went, they went on their four sides; they did not turn when they went, because to place where one leadership looked, they went, and did not turn when they went.

**Ezekiel 10:12**

And their backs and their hands and their wings and their wheels were full of eyes all around, for the four wheels.

**Ezekiel 10:13**

And as for these wheels, they were called Whirling, as I heard.

**Ezekiel 10:15**

And cherubim were lifted up. This was living creature I saw by river Chobar.

**Ezekiel 10:16**

And when cherubim went, wheels went beside them, and when cherubim lifted their wings to rise from earth, their wheels did not turn.

**Ezekiel 10:17**

When they stood, these stood, and when they were lifted up, these were lifted with them, because spirit of life was in them.

**Ezekiel 10:18**

And glory of Lord went out from house and settled on cherubim.

**Ezekiel 10:19**

And cherubim lifted their wings and were raised from earth before me when they went out, and wheels were beside them, and they stood at forecourt of gate of house of Lord opposite, and glory of God of Israel was above them.

**Ezekiel 10:20**

This is living creature I saw beneath God of Israel by river Chobar, and I knew that they are cherubim.

**Ezekiel 10:21**

Four faces to each one, and eight wings to each one, and likeness of human hands beneath their wings.

**Ezekiel 10:22**

And likeness of their faces: these are faces I saw beneath glory of God of Israel by river Chobar, and each went straight before its face.

### Chapter 11

**Ezekiel 11:1**

And spirit took me up and brought me to gate of house of Lord opposite, facing east, and behold, at forecourt of gate about twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of people.

**Ezekiel 11:2**

And Lord said to me, Son of man, these are men thinking vain things and counseling evil counsel in this city,

**Ezekiel 11:3**

those saying, Were houses not built recently? This is cooking pot; we are flesh.

**Ezekiel 11:4**

Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man.

**Ezekiel 11:5**

And spirit of Lord fell upon me and said to me, Say, Thus says Lord: Thus you said, house of Israel, and plans of your spirit I know.

**Ezekiel 11:6**

You multiplied your dead in this city and filled its streets with slain.

**Ezekiel 11:7**

Therefore thus says Lord: Your dead, whom you struck in its midst, these are flesh and this is cooking pot, but you I will bring out from its midst.

**Ezekiel 11:8**

You fear sword, and sword I will bring upon you, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 11:9**

And I will bring you out from its midst and hand you over into hands of strangers, and I will perform judgments among you.

**Ezekiel 11:10**

By sword you will fall. On borders of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 11:11**

This will not be cooking pot for you, and you will never become flesh in its midst. On borders of Israel I will judge you,

**Ezekiel 11:12**

and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 11:13**

And it happened, while I prophesied, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died, and I fell on my face and cried out with loud voice and said, Alas, alas, Lord, are you bringing remnant of Israel to an end?

**Ezekiel 11:14**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 11:15**

Son of man, your brothers, your kinsmen, men of your captivity, and all house of Israel, all of it, are those to whom inhabitants of Jerusalem said, Keep far from Lord; to us land was given for inheritance.

**Ezekiel 11:16**

Therefore say, Thus says Lord: Though I thrust them away among nations and scatter them into all the earth, yet I will be to them a little sanctuary in lands where they enter.

**Ezekiel 11:17**

Therefore say, Thus says Lord: I will welcome them from nations and gather them from lands where I scattered them, and I will give them land of Israel.

**Ezekiel 11:18**

And they will enter there and remove all its abominations and all its lawless deeds from it.

**Ezekiel 11:19**

And I will give them another heart, and new spirit I will give in them, and I will pull out the stone heart from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,

**Ezekiel 11:20**

so that they may walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them, and they will be to me for people and I will be to them for God.

**Ezekiel 11:21**

But those whose heart went after their abominations and their lawless deeds, I have put their ways on their heads, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 11:22**

And cherubim lifted their wings, and wheels beside them, and glory of God of Israel was above them.

**Ezekiel 11:23**

And glory of Lord went up from midst of city and stood upon mountain opposite city.

**Ezekiel 11:24**

And spirit took me up and brought me to land of Chaldeans, to captivity, in vision, in Spirit of God, and I came up from vision that I saw.

**Ezekiel 11:25**

And I spoke to captivity all words of Lord that he showed me.

### Chapter 12

**Ezekiel 12:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 12:2**

Son of man, in midst of their injustices you dwell, those who have eyes to see and do not see, and ears to hear and do not hear, because they are provoking house.

**Ezekiel 12:3**

And you, son of man, make for yourself baggage of captivity by day before them, and you will go into captivity from your place to another place before them, so that they may see, because they are provoking house.

**Ezekiel 12:4**

And you will bring out your baggage, like baggage of captivity, by day in their sight, and you will go out at evening, as captive goes out.

**Ezekiel 12:5**

In their sight dig for yourself through wall, and you will go out through it.

**Ezekiel 12:6**

In their sight you will be lifted on shoulders and go out hidden. You will cover your face so that you do not see land, because I gave you for wonder to house of Israel.

**Ezekiel 12:7**

And I did so, according to everything commanded me, and I brought out baggage like baggage of captivity by day, and at evening I dug through wall for myself, and hidden I went out; on shoulders I was lifted in their sight.

**Ezekiel 12:8**

And word of Lord came to me in morning, saying,

**Ezekiel 12:9**

Son of man, did not house of Israel, the provoking house, say to you, What are you doing?

**Ezekiel 12:10**

Say to them, Thus says Lord God to ruler and leader in Jerusalem and to all house of Israel who are in their midst.

**Ezekiel 12:11**

Say, I do signs in her midst. As I have done, so it will be to them; in migration and captivity they will go.

**Ezekiel 12:12**

And ruler in their midst will be lifted on shoulders and will go out hidden. Through wall he will dig to go out through it. He will cover his face so that he is not seen by eye, and he will not see land.

**Ezekiel 12:13**

And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my enclosure, and I will bring him to Babylon, to land of Chaldeans, and he will not see it, and there he will die.

**Ezekiel 12:14**

And all around him, his helpers and all supporting him, I will scatter to every wind, and sword I will draw out behind them.

**Ezekiel 12:15**

And they will know that I am Lord, when I scatter them among nations and disperse them in lands.

**Ezekiel 12:16**

And I will leave from them men few in number, from sword and famine and death, so that they may recount all their lawless deeds among nations where they entered, and they will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 12:17**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 12:18**

Son of man, you will eat your bread with pain, and your water with torment and distress you will drink.

**Ezekiel 12:19**

And you will say to people of land, Thus says Lord to those dwelling in Jerusalem upon land of Israel: They will eat their bread with want and drink their water with desolation, so that land may be desolated with its fullness, because of impiety of all dwelling in it.

**Ezekiel 12:20**

And their inhabited cities will be laid waste, and land will become desolation, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 12:21**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 12:22**

Son of man, what is this proverb among you on land of Israel, saying, Days are far off; vision has perished?

**Ezekiel 12:23**

Therefore say to them, Thus says Lord: I will turn away this proverb, and house of Israel will no longer speak this proverb. But speak to them, Days have drawn near, and word of every vision.

**Ezekiel 12:24**

For there will no longer be any false vision and flattering diviner in midst of sons of Israel.

**Ezekiel 12:25**

Because I am Lord. I will speak my words, and I will do them, and I will delay no longer, because in your days, provoking house, I will speak word and do it, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 12:26**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 12:27**

Son of man, behold, rebel house of Israel says, The vision he sees is for many days, and for distant times he prophesies.

**Ezekiel 12:28**

Therefore say to them, Thus says Lord: None of my words will be delayed any longer. Whatever words I speak, I will speak and do, says Lord.

### Chapter 13

**Ezekiel 13:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 13:2**

Son of man, prophesy against prophets of Israel, and you will prophesy and say to them, Hear word of Lord.

**Ezekiel 13:3**

Thus says Lord: Woe to those prophesying from their own heart and seeing nothing at all.

**Ezekiel 13:4**

Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in deserts.

**Ezekiel 13:5**

You did not stand in firm place and did not gather flocks over house of Israel; they did not rise, those speaking, in day of Lord.

**Ezekiel 13:6**

Seeing falsehood and divining vanity, those saying, Lord says, though Lord did not send them, and they began to uphold a word.

**Ezekiel 13:7**

Did you not see false vision and speak vain divinations?

**Ezekiel 13:8**

Therefore thus says Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 13:9**

And I will stretch out my hand against prophets seeing false things and uttering vanities. In assembly of my people they will not be, nor will they be written in record of house of Israel, nor will they enter into land of Israel, and they will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 13:10**

Because they led my people astray, saying, Peace, peace, and there was no peace, and one builds wall and they smear it, if it will fall.

**Ezekiel 13:11**

Say to those smearing it, It will fall, and there will be flooding rain, and I will give hailstones against their bindings, and storming wind will burst forth.

**Ezekiel 13:12**

And behold, wall has fallen, and will they not say to you, Where is your plaster that you smeared?

**Ezekiel 13:13**

Therefore thus says Lord: I will burst storming wind in my wrath, and flooding rain will come in my anger, and hailstones in wrath I will bring for destruction.

**Ezekiel 13:14**

And I will tear down wall that you smeared, and it will fall, and I will lay it on ground, and its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be finished with reproofs, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 13:15**

And I will complete my wrath against wall and against those smearing it, and it will fall, and I will say to you, Wall is not, and those smearing it are not,

**Ezekiel 13:16**

the prophets of Israel prophesying concerning Jerusalem and seeing peace for her, though there is no peace, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 13:17**

And you, son of man, set your face against daughters of your people who prophesy from their own hearts, and prophesy against them,

**Ezekiel 13:18**

and say, Thus says Lord: Woe to those stitching cushions on every elbow of hand and making veils over every head of every age, to twist souls. Souls of my people were twisted, and they kept souls alive for themselves.

**Ezekiel 13:19**

And you profaned me before my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill souls that should not die and to keep souls alive that should not live, when you utter to people listening vain utterances.

**Ezekiel 13:20**

Therefore thus says Lord God: Behold, I am against your cushions on which you twist souls there, and I will tear them from your arms and send away the souls that you twist, their souls into scattering.

**Ezekiel 13:21**

And I will tear your veils and rescue my people from your hand, and they will no longer be in your hands for twisting, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 13:22**

Because you twisted the heart of righteous one unjustly, and I did not twist him, and because you strengthened hands of lawless one so that he not turn at all from his evil way and live,

**Ezekiel 13:23**

therefore false things you will never see, and divinations you will never divine again, and I will rescue my people from your hand, and you will know that I am Lord.

### Chapter 14

**Ezekiel 14:1**

And men from elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

**Ezekiel 14:2**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 14:3**

Son of man, these men set their thoughts on their hearts and placed punishment of their injustice before their face. Shall I indeed answer them?

**Ezekiel 14:4**

Therefore speak to them and say to them, Thus says Lord: Any man, any man from house of Israel, who sets his thoughts on his heart and places punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to prophet, I, Lord, will answer him in things wherein his mind is entangled,

**Ezekiel 14:5**

so as to turn aside house of Israel according to their hearts, hearts alienated from me in their thoughts.

**Ezekiel 14:6**

Therefore say to house of Israel, Thus says Lord God: Turn back and turn away from your practices and from all your impieties, and turn your faces back.

**Ezekiel 14:7**

Because any man, any man from house of Israel and from proselytes proselyting in Israel, who becomes alienated from me and sets his thoughts on his heart and places punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to prophet to inquire of him in me, I, Lord, will answer him in that wherein he is entangled within himself.

**Ezekiel 14:8**

And I will set my face against that man and make him desolation and ruin, and I will remove him from midst of my people, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 14:9**

And if prophet is led astray and speaks, I, Lord, have led that prophet astray, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from midst of my people Israel.

**Ezekiel 14:10**

And they will bear their injustice; like offense of one inquiring, so offense of prophet will be,

**Ezekiel 14:11**

so that house of Israel may no longer wander from me, and so that they may no longer be defiled in all their trespasses, and they will be to me for people and I will be to them for God, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 14:12**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 14:13**

Son of man, if land sins against me by committing offense, and I stretch out my hand against it and break its support of bread and send famine upon it and remove from it man and cattle,

**Ezekiel 14:14**

and if these three men are in its midst, Noah and Daniel and Job, they will be saved by their righteousness, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 14:15**

And if I bring evil beasts upon land and punish it, and it becomes desolation and there is no passerby because of beasts,

**Ezekiel 14:16**

and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says Lord, neither sons nor daughters will be saved; only they themselves will be saved, but land will become ruin.

**Ezekiel 14:17**

Or if I bring sword upon that land and say, Let sword pass through land, and I remove from it man and cattle,

**Ezekiel 14:18**

and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says Lord, they will never rescue sons or daughters; only they themselves will be saved.

**Ezekiel 14:19**

Or if I send death upon that land and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to destroy from it man and cattle,

**Ezekiel 14:20**

and Noah and Daniel and Job are in its midst, as I live, says Lord, even if sons or daughters are left behind, they will rescue their own souls by their righteousness.

**Ezekiel 14:21**

Thus says Lord: Even if I send my four evil punishments, sword and famine and evil beasts and death, against Jerusalem, to destroy from it man and cattle,

**Ezekiel 14:22**

yet behold, survivors are left in it, its rescued ones, who bring out sons and daughters from it. Behold, they come out to you, and you will see their ways and their thoughts, and you will repent over evils that I brought upon Jerusalem, all evils that I brought upon her.

**Ezekiel 14:23**

And they will comfort you, because you will see their ways and their thoughts, and you will know that I did not do everything that I did in it in vain, says Lord.

### Chapter 15

**Ezekiel 15:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 15:2**

And you, son of man, what becomes of vine-wood beyond all woods, branches among trees of forest?

**Ezekiel 15:3**

Will wood be taken from it to make something for work? Will peg be taken from it to hang any vessel on it?

**Ezekiel 15:4**

Except it is given to fire for consuming; fire consumes the yearly pruning from it, and it fails completely. Will it be useful for work?

**Ezekiel 15:5**

Even while it is still whole, it is not useful for work; much less if fire consumes it completely, will it still be useful for work?

**Ezekiel 15:6**

Therefore thus says Lord: As vine-wood among trees of forest, which I gave to fire for consuming, so I have given inhabitants of Jerusalem.

**Ezekiel 15:7**

And I will set my face against them. From fire they will go out, and fire will consume them, and they will know that I am Lord when I set my face against them.

**Ezekiel 15:8**

And I will make land desolation, because they committed offense, says Lord.

### Chapter 16

**Ezekiel 16:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 16:2**

Son of man, bear witness to Jerusalem concerning her lawless deeds,

**Ezekiel 16:3**

and say, Thus says Lord to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from land of Canaan; your father was Amorite and your mother Hittite.

**Ezekiel 16:4**

And as for your birth, on day you were born they did not bind your breasts, and you were not washed in water, nor rubbed with salt, nor wrapped in swaddling-cloths.

**Ezekiel 16:5**

No eye spared you, to do one of all these things for you, to feel anything for you, and you were thrown on face of plain, in perversity of your life, on day you were born.

**Ezekiel 16:6**

And I passed by you and saw you mixed in your blood, and I said to you, In your blood, live.

**Ezekiel 16:7**

Multiply, as growth of field, I made you, and you multiplied and grew great and entered into cities of cities. Your breasts were raised and your hair sprang up, but you were naked and unseemly.

**Ezekiel 16:8**

And I passed through you and saw you, and behold, your time, a time of bedding. And I spread my wings over you and covered your nakedness and swore to you and entered into covenant with you, says Lord, and you became mine.

**Ezekiel 16:9**

And I washed you with water and washed away your blood from you and anointed you with oil.

**Ezekiel 16:10**

And I clothed you with embroidered things and shod you with hyacinth and girded you with fine linen and wrapped you with hair-woven cloth.

**Ezekiel 16:11**

And I adorned you with jewelry and put bracelets on your hands and a necklace around your neck.

**Ezekiel 16:12**

And I put an earring on your nose and little wheels on your ears and a crown of boasting on your head.

**Ezekiel 16:13**

And you were adorned with gold and silver, and your garments were fine linen and hair-woven and embroidered. You ate fine flour and oil and honey, and you became exceedingly beautiful.

**Ezekiel 16:14**

And your name went out among nations because of your beauty, because it was completed in splendor, in beauty that I set upon you, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 16:15**

And you trusted in your beauty and whored because of your name and poured out your whoring on every passerby, which should not be.

**Ezekiel 16:16**

And you took from your garments and made for yourself stitched idols and whored on them, which must never enter nor happen.

**Ezekiel 16:17**

And you took vessels of your boasting from my gold and my silver, from what I gave you, and made for yourself male images and whored in them.

**Ezekiel 16:18**

And you took your embroidered garment and clothed them, and my oil and my incense you set before them.

**Ezekiel 16:19**

And my breads that I gave you, fine flour and oil and honey with which I fed you, you set before them for fragrant smell, and it happened, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 16:20**

And you took your sons and your daughters whom you bore and sacrificed them to them for consumption. Was your whoring a small thing?

**Ezekiel 16:21**

And you slaughtered your children and gave them when you offered them up among them.

**Ezekiel 16:22**

Along with all your whoring, you did not remember days of your infancy, when you were naked and unseemly, and having been mixed in your blood, you lived.

**Ezekiel 16:23**

And it happened after all your evils, says Lord,

**Ezekiel 16:24**

that you built for yourself house of prostitution and made for yourself display-place in every square.

**Ezekiel 16:25**

And at head of every road you built your brothel and ruined your beauty and spread your legs to every passerby and multiplied your whoring.

**Ezekiel 16:26**

And you whored with sons of Egypt, your neighbors, great of flesh, and you whored often to provoke me.

**Ezekiel 16:27**

And if I stretch out my hand against you and remove your lawful dues and hand you over to souls of those hating you, daughters of foreigners, who turned you from your way in which you acted impiously,

**Ezekiel 16:28**

then you whored with daughters of Assur, and not even thus were you satisfied, and you whored, and still were not filled.

**Ezekiel 16:29**

And you multiplied your covenants toward land of Chaldeans, and not even with these were you satisfied.

**Ezekiel 16:30**

What shall I do with your daughter, says Lord, when you do all these works of shameless whore, and you whored threefold?

**Ezekiel 16:31**

In your daughters you built your brothel at head of every road and made your base in every square, and you were not like prostitute gathering wages.

**Ezekiel 16:32**

An adulterous woman like you, taking wages instead of her husband.

**Ezekiel 16:33**

To all prostitutes men gave wages, but you gave wages to all your lovers and loaded them down to come to you from all around in your whoring.

**Ezekiel 16:34**

And in you there came to be a reversal beyond women in your whoring: after you they did not whore, and in your giving wages, and no wages being given to you, reversal came to be in you.

**Ezekiel 16:35**

Therefore, whore, hear word of Lord.

**Ezekiel 16:36**

Thus says Lord: Because you poured out your bronze and your shame will be uncovered in your whoring toward your lovers and toward all thoughts of your lawless deeds and in blood of your children whom you gave to them,

**Ezekiel 16:37**

therefore behold, I gather all your lovers with whom you mixed, and all whom you loved, with all whom you hated, and I will gather them against you from all around and uncover your evils before them, and they will see all your shame.

**Ezekiel 16:38**

And I will avenge you with vengeance of adulteress and blood-shedder, and I will set you in blood of wrath and jealousy.

**Ezekiel 16:39**

And I will hand you over into their hands, and they will tear down your brothel and pull down your base and strip you of your garments and take vessels of your boasting and leave you naked and unseemly.

**Ezekiel 16:40**

And they will bring crowds against you and stone you with stones and butcher you with their swords.

**Ezekiel 16:41**

And they will burn your houses with fire and do vengeance on you before many women, and I will turn you from your whoring, and you will give wages no longer.

**Ezekiel 16:42**

And I will let my wrath rest on you and my jealousy will depart from you, and I will rest and no longer be troubled.

**Ezekiel 16:43**

Because you did not remember day of your infancy and grieved me in all these things, behold, I also have put your ways on your head, says Lord, and so you did impiety on top of all your lawless deeds.

**Ezekiel 16:44**

These are all things spoken against you in proverb, saying, Like mother, like daughter.

**Ezekiel 16:45**

You are daughter of your mother, who rejected her husband and her children, and sister of your sisters, who rejected their husbands and their children. Your mother was Hittite, and your father Amorite.

**Ezekiel 16:46**

Your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters dwelling on your left, and your younger sister dwelling on your right is Sodom and her daughters.

**Ezekiel 16:47**

And not in their ways did you walk, nor did you act according to their lawless deeds. It was a small thing, and you surpassed them in all your ways.

**Ezekiel 16:48**

As I live, says Lord, Sodom your sister and her daughters did not do as you and your daughters did.

**Ezekiel 16:49**

Except this was lawlessness of Sodom your sister: pride, fullness of bread, and lavish ease of wine belonged to her and her daughters, and hand of poor and needy they did not support.

**Ezekiel 16:50**

And they were haughty and did lawless things before me, and I removed them as I saw.

**Ezekiel 16:51**

And Samaria did not sin half your sins, and you multiplied your lawless deeds beyond them and justified your sisters by all your lawless deeds that you did.

**Ezekiel 16:52**

And you bear your torment, in that you corrupted your sisters in your sins by which you acted more lawlessly than they, and you justified them beyond yourself. And you, be ashamed and bear your dishonor in justifying your sisters.

**Ezekiel 16:53**

And I will turn back their turning back, turning back of Sodom and her daughters, and I will turn back turning back of Samaria and her daughters, and I will turn back your turning back in their midst,

**Ezekiel 16:54**

so that you bear your torment and be dishonored from everything you did in provoking me.

**Ezekiel 16:55**

And your sister Sodom and her daughters will be restored as they were from beginning, and Samaria and her daughters will be restored as they were from beginning, and you and your daughters will be restored as you were from beginning.

**Ezekiel 16:56**

And if Sodom your sister was not a report in your mouth in days of your pride,

**Ezekiel 16:57**

before your evils were uncovered, as now you are reproach of daughters of Syria and of all around her, daughters of foreigners encircling you around,

**Ezekiel 16:58**

your impieties and your lawless deeds, you have borne them, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 16:59**

Thus says Lord: I will act in you as you acted, as you dishonored these things by transgressing my covenant.

**Ezekiel 16:60**

And I will remember my covenant with you in days of your infancy and raise up for you everlasting covenant.

**Ezekiel 16:61**

And you will remember your way and be dishonored when you receive your older sisters with your younger ones, and I will give them to you for building, and not from your covenant.

**Ezekiel 16:62**

And I will raise my covenant with you, and you will know that I am Lord,

**Ezekiel 16:63**

so that you remember and be ashamed and no longer have it in you to open your mouth because of your dishonor, when I make propitiation for you according to all that you did, says Lord.

### Chapter 17

**Ezekiel 17:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 17:2**

Son of man, tell tale and speak parable to house of Israel,

**Ezekiel 17:3**

and say, Thus says Lord: Great eagle, large-winged, long in spread, full of claws, having power to enter Lebanon, came and took choice things of cedar.

**Ezekiel 17:4**

He clipped off tips of its tenderness and brought them into land of Canaan; in fortified city he set them.

**Ezekiel 17:5**

**Ezekiel 17:6**

**Ezekiel 17:7**

And there was another great eagle, large-winged and many-clawed, and behold, this vine was entwined toward him, and its roots toward him, and its branches it sent out toward him so that he might water it with clod of its planting.

**Ezekiel 17:8**

In good field by much water it fattens, to make shoots and bear fruit, to become great vine.

**Ezekiel 17:9**

Therefore say, Thus says Lord: Will it prosper? Will he not strip away its tender roots, and its fruit will rot, and all its first sproutings will dry up? Not with great arm, nor with many people, to pull it from its roots.

**Ezekiel 17:10**

And behold, it fattens. Will it prosper? Will it not dry in drought as soon as scorching wind touches it? With clod of its rising it will dry up.

**Ezekiel 17:11**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 17:12**

Son of man, now say to provoking house, Do you not understand what these things were? Say, When king of Babylon comes against Jerusalem and takes its king and its rulers and brings them to himself in Babylon,

**Ezekiel 17:13**

then he will take from seed of kingdom and make covenant with him and bring him under curse, and he will take leaders of land,

**Ezekiel 17:14**

**Ezekiel 17:15**

**Ezekiel 17:16**

As I live, says Lord, surely in place of king who made him king, whose oath he dishonored and whose covenant he transgressed with him, in midst of Babylon he will die.

**Ezekiel 17:17**

**Ezekiel 17:18**

**Ezekiel 17:19**

Therefore thus says Lord: As I live, surely my covenant that he transgressed and my oath that he dishonored, I will put them on his head.

**Ezekiel 17:20**

**Ezekiel 17:21**

In all his battle line they will fall by sword, and those left I will scatter to every wind, and you will know that I, Lord, have spoken.

**Ezekiel 17:22**

**Ezekiel 17:23**

**Ezekiel 17:24**

### Chapter 18

**Ezekiel 18:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 18:2**

Son of man, what is this proverb among sons of Israel, saying, Fathers ate unripe grape, and children’s teeth were set on edge?

**Ezekiel 18:3**

As I live, says Lord, this proverb will no longer be spoken in Israel.

**Ezekiel 18:4**

Because all souls are mine; as soul of father, so also soul of son, both are mine. Soul sinning, that one will die.

**Ezekiel 18:5**

And man who is righteous, doing judgment and righteousness,

**Ezekiel 18:6**

will not eat on mountains and will not lift his eyes to thoughts of house of Israel, and will not defile wife of his neighbor, and will not approach woman in her monthly flow.

**Ezekiel 18:7**

And he will not oppress a man, he will return pledge of debtor, he will not seize plunder, he will give his bread to hungry one, and clothe naked one with garment.

**Ezekiel 18:8**

And he will not give his money on interest, nor take excess, and he will turn his hand away from injustice; he will do righteous judgment between man and his neighbor.

**Ezekiel 18:9**

And he has walked in my ordinances and kept my judgments to do them. This one is righteous; living he will live, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 18:10**

And if he fathers violent son, shedding blood and committing sins,

**Ezekiel 18:11**

who did not walk in way of his righteous father, but also ate on mountains and defiled wife of his neighbor,

**Ezekiel 18:12**

and oppressed poor and needy and seized plunder and did not return pledge, and set his eyes on idols and did lawlessness,

**Ezekiel 18:13**

and gave with interest and took excess, shall this one live? He will not live. He did all these lawless things; by death he will be put to death. His blood will be upon him.

**Ezekiel 18:14**

And if he fathers son and he sees all sins of his father that he did and fears and does not do according to them,

**Ezekiel 18:15**

he has not eaten on mountains and has not set his eyes on thoughts of house of Israel and has not defiled wife of his neighbor,

**Ezekiel 18:16**

and has not oppressed a man and has not exacted a pledge and has not seized plunder; he gave his bread to hungry one and clothed naked one,

**Ezekiel 18:17**

and turned his hand away from injustice and did not take interest nor excess, and did righteousness and walked in my ordinances, this one will not die in injustices of his father; living he will live.

**Ezekiel 18:18**

But his father, if he oppresses with oppression and seizes plunder and did opposites in midst of my people, he will die in his injustice.

**Ezekiel 18:19**

And you will say, Why has son not taken injustice of his father? Because son did righteousness and mercy and kept all my ordinances and did them; living he will live.

**Ezekiel 18:20**

And soul sinning will die, but son will not bear injustice of his father, nor father bear injustice of his son. Righteousness of righteous one will be upon him, and lawlessness of lawless one will be upon him.

**Ezekiel 18:21**

And if lawless one turns from all his lawless deeds that he did and keeps all my commandments and does righteousness and mercy, living he will live; he will not die.

**Ezekiel 18:22**

All his trespasses that he did will not be remembered; in his righteousness that he did he will live.

**Ezekiel 18:23**

Do I at all desire death of lawless one, says Lord, rather than his turning from evil way and his living?

**Ezekiel 18:24**

But when righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice, according to all lawless things that lawless one did, none of his righteous deeds that he did will be remembered. In trespass by which he trespassed and in sins by which he sinned, in them he will die.

**Ezekiel 18:25**

And you said, Way of Lord is not straight. Hear now, all house of Israel: Is my way not straight? Is it not your way that is not straight?

**Ezekiel 18:26**

When righteous one turns from his righteousness and does trespass and dies, in trespass that he did, in it he will die.

**Ezekiel 18:27**

And when lawless one turns from his lawlessness that he did and does judgment and righteousness, this one has preserved his soul.

**Ezekiel 18:28**

And he turned away from all his impieties that he did; living he will live; he will not die.

**Ezekiel 18:29**

And house of Israel says, Way of Lord is not right. Is my way not right, house of Israel? Is it not your way that is not right?

**Ezekiel 18:30**

Each one according to his way I will judge you, house of Israel, says Lord. Turn back and turn away from all your impieties, and they will not become to you punishment of injustice.

**Ezekiel 18:31**

Throw away from yourselves all your impieties by which you acted impiously against me and make for yourselves new heart and new spirit. And why are you dying, house of Israel?

**Ezekiel 18:32**

Because I do not want death of dying one, says Lord.

### Chapter 19

**Ezekiel 19:1**

And you, take lamentation for ruler of Israel,

Your mother was like vine, like blossom in pomegranate, planted by water; its fruit and its shoot came from much water.

### Chapter 20

**Ezekiel 20:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, speak to elders of Israel and say to them, Thus says Lord: Is it to inquire of me that you come? As I live, I will not answer you, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 20:4**

**Ezekiel 20:7**

And I said to them, Let each cast away abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with practices of Egypt. I am Lord your God.

**Ezekiel 20:8**

And they rebelled against me and did not want to listen to me. They did not cast away abominations of their eyes, and they did not leave behind practices of Egypt, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to complete my anger in them in midst of land of Egypt.

**Ezekiel 20:9**

And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before nations among whom they were, among whom I was made known to them before them, to bring them out from land of Egypt.

**Ezekiel 20:10**

And I brought them out from land of Egypt and led them into wilderness.

**Ezekiel 20:11**

And I gave them my ordinances, and my judgments I made known to them, which if man does them, he will live in them.

**Ezekiel 20:12**

And my Sabbaths I gave them, to be sign between me and them, so that they might know that I am Lord who sanctifies them.

**Ezekiel 20:13**

And I said to house of Israel in wilderness, In my ordinances walk, yet they did not walk, and my judgments they rejected, which if man does them, he will live in them, and my Sabbaths they greatly profaned, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in wilderness to consume them.

**Ezekiel 20:14**

And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.

**Ezekiel 20:15**

And I lifted my hand against them in wilderness, not at all to bring them into land that I gave them, land flowing milk and honey, a honeycomb beyond every land,

**Ezekiel 20:16**

because they rejected my judgments and did not walk in my ordinances and profaned my Sabbaths, and after thoughts of their hearts they went.

**Ezekiel 20:17**

And my eye spared them from wiping them out, and I did not make end of them in wilderness.

**Ezekiel 20:18**

And I said to their children in wilderness, Do not walk in statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their judgments, and do not mix yourselves with their practices, and do not defile yourselves.

**Ezekiel 20:19**

I am Lord your God. Walk in my ordinances, and keep my judgments and do them,

**Ezekiel 20:20**

and sanctify my Sabbaths, and let them be sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Lord your God.

**Ezekiel 20:21**

And their children provoked me. In my ordinances they did not walk, and my judgments they did not keep to do them, which if man does them, he will live in them, and my Sabbaths they profaned, and I said I would pour out my wrath on them in wilderness to complete my anger upon them.

**Ezekiel 20:22**

And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.

**Ezekiel 20:23**

And I lifted my hand against them in wilderness, to scatter them among nations and disperse them in lands,

**Ezekiel 20:24**

because they did not do my judgments and rejected my ordinances and profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after thoughts of their fathers.

**Ezekiel 20:25**

And I also gave them ordinances not good and judgments in which they will not live.

**Ezekiel 20:26**

And I defiled them in their gifts, in my causing every opener of womb to pass through, so that I might destroy them.

**Ezekiel 20:27**

Therefore speak to house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, Thus says Lord: Up to this point your fathers provoked me in their trespasses by which they trespassed against me.

**Ezekiel 20:28**

And I brought them into land about which I lifted my hand to give it to them, and they saw every high hill and every shady tree and there they sacrificed to their gods and set there fragrant smell and poured out there their drink offerings.

**Ezekiel 20:29**

And I said to them, What is Abama, that you enter there? And its name was called Abama until this day.

**Ezekiel 20:30**

Therefore say to house of Israel, Thus says Lord: Are you defiling yourselves in lawless deeds of your fathers, and after their abominations are you whoring?

**Ezekiel 20:31**

And in firstfruits of your gifts, in your separations, you are defiling yourselves in all your thoughts until this day, and shall I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says Lord, I will not answer you, and this that rises on your spirit.

**Ezekiel 20:32**

And it will not be in way that you say, We will be like nations and like tribes of earth, serving wood and stone.

**Ezekiel 20:33**

Therefore as I live, says Lord, with strong hand and uplifted arm and wrath poured out I will reign over you.

**Ezekiel 20:34**

And I will bring you out from peoples and welcome you from lands where you were scattered, with strong hand and uplifted arm and wrath poured out.

**Ezekiel 20:35**

And I will bring you into wilderness of peoples and judge with you there face to face.

**Ezekiel 20:36**

As I judged with your fathers in wilderness of land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 20:37**

And I will bring you under my rod and bring you in by number.

**Ezekiel 20:38**

And I will pick out from you impious ones and rebels, because I will bring them out from their sojourning, but into land of Israel they will not enter, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 20:39**

And you, house of Israel, thus says Lord God: Each one, cast away his practices, and after these things, if you do not listen to me, you will no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and with your practices.

**Ezekiel 20:40**

Because on my holy mountain, on high mountain, says Lord God, there all house of Israel, to the end, will serve me, and there I will receive them, and there I will visit your firstfruits and firstfruits of your separations in all your holy things.

**Ezekiel 20:41**

In fragrant aroma I will receive you, when I bring you out from peoples and welcome you from lands in which you were scattered, and I will be sanctified in you before eyes of nations.

**Ezekiel 20:42**

And you will know that I am Lord when I bring you into land of Israel, into land concerning which I lifted my hand to give it to your fathers.

**Ezekiel 20:43**

And there you will remember your ways and your practices by which you were defiled in them, and you will strike your faces over all your evils.

**Ezekiel 20:44**

And you will know that I am Lord when I act thus with you, so that my name may not be profaned, not according to your evil ways and not according to your corrupt practices, says Lord.

### Chapter 21

**Ezekiel 21:1**

**Ezekiel 21:4**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 21:8**

And you will say to land of Israel, Behold, I am against you and will draw my dagger from its sheath and destroy from you righteous and lawless.

**Ezekiel 21:10**

**Ezekiel 21:11**

And you, son of man, groan with breaking of your loins, and with pains you will groan before their eyes.

**Ezekiel 21:12**

And it will be, if they say to you, Because of what do you groan? then you will say, Because of report, for it comes, and every heart will be broken and all hands paralyzed, and all flesh will faint and every spirit, and all thighs will be defiled with wetness. Behold, it comes and will happen, says Lord God.

**Ezekiel 21:13**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 21:14**

Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says Lord. Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and be enraged.

So that you may slaughter victims, be sharpened; so that it may be ready for gleaming, ready for paralysis. Slaughter. Despise; push away every tree.

**Ezekiel 21:17**

Cry out and howl, son of man, because it came upon my people, upon all leaders of Israel. They will sojourn under sword; it came upon my people. Therefore clap upon your hand.

**Ezekiel 21:18**

**Ezekiel 21:19**

And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand to hand and double sword, a third sword. It is sword of slain, the great sword of the slain, and it will throw them into panic.

So that heart may be crushed and weak ones multiplied, at all their gates they are handed over to slaughter of sword. Well made for slaughter, well made for gleaming.

**Ezekiel 21:21**

**Ezekiel 21:22**

And I too will clap my hand to my hand and let my wrath rest. I, Lord, have spoken.

**Ezekiel 21:23**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 21:24**

And you, son of man, appoint for yourself two ways for sword of king of Babylon to enter. From one land both will come out, and hand at beginning of road, at beginning of city’s road.

**Ezekiel 21:25**

You will set road for sword to enter upon Rabbath of sons of Ammon and upon Judea and upon Jerusalem in her midst.

**Ezekiel 21:26**

Because king of Babylon will stand on old road, at beginning of two roads, to divine divination, to shake rod, and inquire by carved things and inspect liver. On his right

**Ezekiel 21:27**

**Ezekiel 21:28**

And he will be to them like one divining divination before them, and he himself reminding them of his injustices, to be remembered.

**Ezekiel 21:29**

Therefore thus says Lord: Because you brought your injustices to remembrance, when your impieties were uncovered, so that your sins were seen in all your impieties and in your practices, because you were remembered in these things, in them you will be captured.

**Ezekiel 21:30**

And you, profane lawless leader of Israel, whose day has come in time of injustice of the end,

**Ezekiel 21:31**

thus says Lord: Remove turban and take off crown. This will not stay this way. You humbled high thing and exalted low thing.

**Ezekiel 21:32**

Injustice, injustice, I will make it. Even this will not be until one comes whose right it is, and I will give it to him.

**Ezekiel 21:33**

And you, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says Lord concerning sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach. And you will say, Sword, sword, drawn for slaughter and drawn for complete destruction. Rise up so that you may flash,

**Ezekiel 21:34**

while in your vain vision and your false divination, to hand you over on necks of slain lawless ones whose day has come in time of injustice of the end.

**Ezekiel 21:35**

Turn back. Do not camp here. In place where you were born, in your own land, I will judge you.

**Ezekiel 21:36**

And I will pour out my anger upon you; in fire of my wrath I will blow upon you and hand you over into hands of barbarous men, crafting destruction.

**Ezekiel 21:37**

In fire you will be food for devouring; your blood will be in midst of your land. There will be no remembrance of you, because I, Lord, have spoken.

### Chapter 22

**Ezekiel 22:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 22:2**

those near you and those far from you. They will mock you, unclean, well known, and great in lawless deeds.

**Ezekiel 22:7**

**Ezekiel 22:8**

**Ezekiel 22:9**

**Ezekiel 22:10**

**Ezekiel 22:11**

**Ezekiel 22:15**

**Ezekiel 22:16**

And I will inherit in you before eyes of nations, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 22:17**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 22:19**

**Ezekiel 22:20**

As silver and bronze and iron and tin and lead are gathered into midst of furnace, to blow fire into it so as to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and draw you together and melt you.

**Ezekiel 22:21**

And I will blow upon you in fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in her midst.

**Ezekiel 22:22**

As silver is melted in midst of furnace, so you will be melted in her midst, and you will know that I, Lord, poured out my wrath upon you.

**Ezekiel 22:23**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 22:24**

Son of man, say to her, You are land not rained on, nor did rain come upon you in day of wrath.

**Ezekiel 22:25**

Whose rulers in her midst are like roaring lions seizing plunder, eating souls in oppression, taking honors in injustice, and your widows were multiplied in your midst.

**Ezekiel 22:26**

And her priests rejected my law and profaned my holy things; between holy and profane they did not distinguish, and between unclean and clean they did not distinguish, and from my Sabbaths they covered their eyes, and I was profaned in their midst.

**Ezekiel 22:27**

Her rulers in her midst are like wolves seizing plunder, to pour out blood, so that greedily they may gain greed.

**Ezekiel 22:28**

And her prophets smearing them over will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, Thus says Lord, and Lord has not spoken.

**Ezekiel 22:29**

People of land, oppressing with injustice and plundering plunder, oppressing poor and needy, and toward sojourner not behaving with judgment.

**Ezekiel 22:30**

And I sought from them a man walking uprightly and standing wholly before me in time for land, so as not to wipe it out completely, and I did not find one.

**Ezekiel 22:31**

And I poured out my wrath upon it; in fire of my anger, to complete, I have put their ways on their heads, says Lord God.

### Chapter 23

**Ezekiel 23:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 23:2**

Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.

**Ezekiel 23:3**

And they whored in Egypt, in their youth. There their breasts fell, there they were deflowered.

**Ezekiel 23:4**

And their names were Oola the elder and Ooliba her sister, and they became mine and bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria was Oola and Jerusalem Ooliba.

**Ezekiel 23:5**

And Oola whored away from me and set herself on her lovers, on Assyrians near her,

**Ezekiel 23:6**

clothed in blue, leaders and generals, choice young men all, horsemen mounted on horses.

**Ezekiel 23:7**

And she gave her whoring to them, all choice sons of Assyria, and with all on whom she set herself, with all her thoughts, she was defiled.

**Ezekiel 23:8**

And her whoring from Egypt she did not leave, because with her they lay in her youth and they deflowered her and poured out their whoring on her.

**Ezekiel 23:9**

Because of this I gave her into hands of her lovers, into hands of sons of Assyria on whom she set herself.

**Ezekiel 23:10**

They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters, and killed her by sword, and she became a byword among women, and they did vengeance in her among the daughters.

**Ezekiel 23:11**

And her sister Ooliba saw and corrupted her desire beyond her and her whoring beyond whoring of her sister.

**Ezekiel 23:12**

She set herself on sons of Assyria, leaders and generals near her, clothed with fine border, horsemen riding on horses, choice young men all.

**Ezekiel 23:13**

And I saw that they were defiled; one way belonged to both.

**Ezekiel 23:14**

And she added to her whoring, and saw men painted on wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with stylus,

**Ezekiel 23:15**

girded with patterned belts on their loins and dyed tiaras on their heads, all with princely appearance, likeness of sons of Chaldea, their native land.

**Ezekiel 23:16**

And she set herself on them at sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them into land of Chaldeans.

**Ezekiel 23:17**

And sons of Babylon came to her into bed of lying down and defiled her in her whoring, and she was defiled by them, and her soul turned away from them.

**Ezekiel 23:18**

And she uncovered her whoring and uncovered her shame, and my soul turned away from her, as my soul turned away from her sister.

**Ezekiel 23:19**

And you multiplied your whoring, to remember days of your youth in which you whored in Egypt.

**Ezekiel 23:20**

And you desired Chaldeans, whose flesh was like flesh of donkeys and whose genitals were genitals of horses.

**Ezekiel 23:21**

And you visited lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt, in your lodging, where breasts of your youth were.

**Ezekiel 23:22**

Therefore, Ooliba, thus says Lord: Behold, I stir up your lovers against you, those from whom your soul turned away, and I will bring them upon you from all around,

**Ezekiel 23:23**

sons of Babylon and all Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all sons of Assyria with them, choice young men, governors and generals, all nobles and men of name, riding on horses.

**Ezekiel 23:24**

And all will come against you from north, chariots and wheels with crowd of peoples; shield and buckler and they will set guard against you around, and I will set judgment before them and they will avenge you by their judgments.

**Ezekiel 23:25**

And I will set my jealousy in you, and they will act with you in fury of wrath. Your nose and your ears they will remove, and your remnant they will cast down by sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and your remnant fire will devour.

**Ezekiel 23:26**

And they will strip you of your garments and take vessels of your boasting.

**Ezekiel 23:27**

And I will turn your impieties away from you and your whoring from land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will remember no more.

**Ezekiel 23:28**

Because thus says Lord God: Behold, I hand you over into hands of those you hate, from whom your soul turned away,

**Ezekiel 23:29**

and they will deal with you in hatred and take all your gains and your toil, and you will be naked and unseemly, and shame of your whoring will be uncovered, and your impiety and your whoring.

**Ezekiel 23:30**

These things were done to you because you whored after nations and were defiled in their thoughts.

**Ezekiel 23:31**

In way of your sister you walked, and I will put her cup in your hands.

**Ezekiel 23:32**

Thus says Lord: Cup of your sister you will drink, deep and broad, overflowing so as to destroy.

**Ezekiel 23:33**

With drunkenness and collapse you will be filled, cup of desolation, cup of your sister Samaria.

**Ezekiel 23:34**

And you will drink it, and her feasts and her new moons I will turn away, because I have spoken, says Lord.

**Ezekiel 23:35**

Therefore thus says Lord: Because you forgot me and threw me behind your body, you also bear your impiety and your whoring.

**Ezekiel 23:36**

And Lord said to me, Son of man, will you not judge Oola and Ooliba and announce to them their lawless deeds?

**Ezekiel 23:37**

Because they committed adultery, and blood was in their hands. With their thoughts they committed adultery, and their children whom they bore to me they passed through fire for them.

**Ezekiel 23:38**

And these things they did to me: my holy things they defiled and my Sabbaths they profaned.

**Ezekiel 23:39**

And when they slaughtered their children to their idols, they entered into my holy places to profane them, and so they acted in midst of my house.

**Ezekiel 23:40**

And they sent messengers to men coming from far away, and as soon as they came you washed and painted your eyes with stibium and adorned yourself with ornament.

**Ezekiel 23:41**

And you sat on bed spread out, and table adorned before it, and my incense and my oil rejoiced among them.

**Ezekiel 23:42**

And sound of harmony they struck up, and to men from multitude of people coming from wilderness they put bracelets on their hands and crown of boasting on their heads.

**Ezekiel 23:43**

And I said, Are they committing adultery in these things? Works of prostitute, and she whored.

**Ezekiel 23:44**

And they went in to her as they go in to prostitute woman; so they went in to Oola and to Ooliba, to do lawlessness.

**Ezekiel 23:45**

And righteous men, they will avenge them with vengeance of adulteress and vengeance of blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is in their hands.

**Ezekiel 23:46**

Thus says Lord God: Bring up against them crowd and give in them turmoil and plundering.

**Ezekiel 23:47**

And stone them with stones of crowds and spear them with their swords. Their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.

**Ezekiel 23:48**

And I will turn impiety away from land, and all women will be instructed and will not do according to their impieties.

**Ezekiel 23:49**

And your impiety will be given upon you, and sins of your thoughts you will bear, and you will know that I am Lord.

### Chapter 24

**Ezekiel 24:1**

And word of Lord came to me in ninth year, in tenth month, on tenth of month, saying,

**Ezekiel 24:2**

Son of man, write for yourself this day, from this day from which king of Babylon pressed hard against Jerusalem, from this very day.

**Ezekiel 24:3**

And speak to provoking house a parable, and say to them, Thus says Lord: Set on the cooking pot and pour water into it,

**Ezekiel 24:4**

and put into it the pieces, every good piece, thigh and shoulder, stripped from bones.

**Ezekiel 24:5**

Taken from choice cattle, and kindle the bones under them. It boiled, boiled, and its bones were cooked in its midst.

**Ezekiel 24:6**

Therefore thus says Lord: O city of bloods, pot in which there is rust in it and its rust did not go out from it. Piece by piece it was brought out; lot did not fall on it.

**Ezekiel 24:7**

Because her blood is in her midst. Upon bare rock I placed it; I did not pour it on ground to cover earth over it.

**Ezekiel 24:8**

So that wrath might rise for vengeance, to be avenged, I gave her blood upon bare rock, so that it should not be covered.

**Ezekiel 24:9**

Therefore thus says Lord: I too will magnify the pile.

**Ezekiel 24:10**

And I will multiply the wood and kindle the fire so that the flesh may melt and the broth be diminished.

**Ezekiel 24:11**

And set it upon the coals so that its bronze may burn and become hot and its uncleanness may melt within it and its rust fail away.

**Ezekiel 24:12**

And her much rust will not go out from her; her rust will be put to shame.

**Ezekiel 24:13**

Because you were defiling yourself, and if you will not be cleansed any longer until I fill up my wrath,

**Ezekiel 24:14**

I, Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will do it. I will not delay, nor will I show mercy. According to your ways and according to your thoughts I judge you, says Lord. Therefore I judge you according to your bloods and according to your thoughts, you unclean one, well-known and much provoking.

**Ezekiel 24:15**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 24:16**

Son of man, behold, I take from you desire of your eyes in ordered stroke. You must not mourn, nor must you weep.

**Ezekiel 24:17**

Groaning of blood of your loins is mourning; it will not be. Your hair will not be braided upon you and your sandals will be on your feet. You will not be comforted by their lips, and bread of men you will not eat.

**Ezekiel 24:18**

And I spoke to people in morning as it was commanded me, and my wife died at evening, and I did in morning as it was ordered me.

**Ezekiel 24:19**

And people said to me, Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?

**Ezekiel 24:20**

And I said to them, Word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 24:21**

Say to house of Israel, Thus says Lord: Behold, I profane my holy things, arrogance of your strength, desire of your eyes and what your souls spare, and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by sword.

**Ezekiel 24:22**

And you will do as I did. You will not be comforted from their mouth, and bread of men you will not eat.

**Ezekiel 24:23**

And your hair will be on your head and your sandals on your feet. You will neither mourn nor weep, and you will melt away in your injustices and each will comfort his brother.

**Ezekiel 24:24**

And Ezekiel will be for you a sign; according to all that he did you will do when these things come, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 24:25**

And you, son of man, is it not on day when I take from them their strength, raising up of their boasting, desire of their eyes and raising up of their soul, their sons and their daughters,

**Ezekiel 24:26**

on that day one escaping will come to you to announce it in your ears?

**Ezekiel 24:27**

On that day your mouth will be opened toward one escaping, and you will speak and no longer be mute, and you will be to them for sign, and they will know that I am Lord.

### Chapter 25

**Ezekiel 25:1**

And word of Lord came to me, saying,

**Ezekiel 25:2**

Son of man, set your face toward sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,

**Ezekiel 25:3**

and say to sons of Ammon, Hear word of Lord. Thus says Lord: Because you rejoiced over my holy things that they were profaned, and over land of Israel that it was destroyed, and over house of Judah that they went into captivity,

therefore behold, I give you to sons of Kedem for inheritance, and they will camp in their equipment in you and set their tents in you. They will eat your fruits, and they will drink your richness.

And I will give city of Ammon for pasture of camels and sons of Ammon for pasture of sheep, and you will know that I am Lord.

**Ezekiel 25:6**

**Ezekiel 25:7**

**Ezekiel 25:8**

Thus says Lord: Because Moab said, Behold, house of Israel and Judah is like all nations,

**Ezekiel 25:9**

therefore behold, I weaken shoulder of Moab from cities, from its borders, the chosen land, house of Asimouth above spring of city by the sea,

**Ezekiel 25:10**
